0207ee012c038b2e.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Ireland.

About Product Management:
As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.

Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.

Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes. You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers. This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

Your scope will include:

OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution

Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.

This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.

AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.

The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

What You’ll Be Doing:
Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation
Extend beyond product delivery to how the OpenTelemetry experience is positioned and brought to market. In partnership with Product Marketing and go-to-market teams, you’ll help define the product narrative, sharpen out differentiation, and develop launches, technical content, adoption programs, and campaigns that create demand and accelerate customer activation.
Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams to deliver and communicate a differentiated OpenTelemetry experience
Represent Grafana Labs and its customers in relevant OpenTelemetry ecosystem discussions
What makes you a great fit:
5+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong track record in developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data platforms, or another technically complex B2B product domain
Experience leading strategy and execution across multiple engineering teams or product areas without relying on direct organizational authority
Strong working knowledge of OpenTelemetry, including SDK instrumentation, OTLP, Collector pipelines, telemetry context, and semantic conventions
Experience using or building instrumentation systems, agents, telemetry collectors, configuration products, or related infrastructure
An understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and operating software across Kubernetes, virtual machines, and public cloud environments
Experience turning complex onboarding, configuration, and troubleshooting workflows into clear and approachable product experiences
A history of using customer research and product data to make decisions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points:

Experience contributing to or building products around the OpenTelemetry or broader open source observability ecosystem
Experience with automatic instrumentation, eBPF, or runtime-based instrumentation
Firsthand experience as an SRE, platform engineer, developer, or observability practitioner
Experience building product-led onboarding, configuration-validation, or telemetry-health experiences at scale

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 133,600 - EUR 160,320. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

About the role
Coordinate and support delivery of Data Centre projects and programmes, from technical reviews and documentation through to stakeholder alignment across the client, suppliers, and AE/EoR firms. The scope of ownership you take on can range from coordinating project workstreams to owning end-to-end programme delivery. This will scale with your experience level.


Location
Remote or Hybrid with travel to European client sites as required. Locations include Dublin, Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Portugal and the Nordics.


Key Responsibilities
Technical Review & Documentation

- Schedule, run, and document technical review meetings between client, suppliers, and AE/EoR firms, spanning disciplines such as MEP, controls, networking, structural, fire, and safety as relevant.
- Maintain document control and issue/action logs, ensuring compliance with AE/EoR sign-off requirements.
- Ensure design packages, RFIs, submittals, and change bulletins are routed promptly and progressed to AE/EoR sign-off within programme SLAs.
Project & Programme Delivery

- Coordinate, and with experience manage, portfolios of Data Centre projects involving multiple stakeholders (engineering, procurement, networking, operations).
- Track programme, cost, and risk; prepare status reports, dashboards, and risk/decision logs for stakeholders, escalating issues as required.
- Support contractor and vendor procurement strategy in coordination with the Procurement & Cost Manager.
Stakeholder Coordination

- Liaise with internal engineering teams, external vendors, and AE/EoR firms to resolve issues promptly.
- Lead cross-functional alignment across design engineering, construction, networking, procurement, and operations as scope grows.
Quality, Compliance & Tooling

- Support compliance with client standards, document lifecycle controls, and jurisdictional codes.
- Use relevant programme and data tools to manage workflows, artefacts, and reporting; contribute to continuous improvement of DC delivery processes.


About You

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction/Project Management, or a related field.
- 2–8 years' experience in project or programme coordination, technical support, or delivery of construction, engineering, or data centre projects.
- Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, and document management systems; growing familiarity with MEP systems, networking infrastructure, and commercial/cost-control principles expected with experience.
- Awareness of relevant industry standards (Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA, ISO) is an advantage.
- Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in the European Union and be able to provide evidence of their work authorization if requested.


Preferred Certifications

- PMP, Prince2 (Foundation through Practitioner), or Lean Six Sigma, commensurate with experience.
- CIPS Level 3–4 for procurement exposure, where applicable.


Preferred

- Prior hyperscale data centre experience.
- Experience with AE/EoR delivery models, RFIs/submittals, design bulletins, and change-control workflows.
- Familiarity with energy/power interfaces (utility/substation/transmission) is a plus.


Remuneration
Remuneration will be competitive and will be set in line with the successful candidate's level of experience, reflecting current market benchmarks for specialist data centre engineering talent in Europe.


Package & Benefits

- Pension contribution
- Hybrid/flexible working model
- Direct mentorship from ZeroOne's founding Directors
- Structured support toward relevant professional certification (e.g., Chartered Engineer, MRICS, PMP/Prince2, CIPS)
- Travel and expenses covered for client-site visits across Europe


About ZeroOne
ZeroOne is a specialist MEP Design Solutions Company focused exclusively on the European Data Centre sector. Founded by industry leaders who have collectively delivered over 2GW of Data Centre capacity across the EMEA region, we combine deep technical expertise with an agile, client-focused approach. Job Description & Summary

We are seeking an experienced senior project leader (Associate Director / Director level) to join our Consulting practice, with a focus on the transport sector. The role offers the opportunity to lead multidisciplinary teams in the delivery of major transport and infrastructure programmes, providing strategic advisory, programme oversight and assurance services that support successful investment and delivery outcomes.

We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive experience advising on and leading major transport and infrastructure programmes. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping clients establish effective governance, manage programme risks and dependencies and deliver complex capital investments in line with strategic, financial and operational objectives.

Embrace the possibility to apply – at Grant Thornton we are constantly upskilling our staff. If you do not meet all of the listed requirements, please do not be discouraged from applying. We value a growth-oriented mindset and are dedicated to supporting you in reaching your full potential.

Roles & Responsibilities

Collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team to successfully deliver and manage projects across a range of key transport sector initiatives, including:

Project Management Delivery

Leading and advising on major transport and infrastructure programmes, supporting client organisations and senior leadership teams to strengthen programme governance, assurance and delivery performance across major capital investments.

Defining and driving projects across all stages of the project life cycle, from initiation to delivery, implementation and benefits realisation.

Establishing and overseeing programme-wide governance, monitoring and assurance frameworks while managing complex interfaces, interdependencies and multi-contract delivery arrangements across large-scale infrastructure programmes.

Leading and mentoring multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaboration across client organisations, delivery partners, contractors, regulators and other key stakeholders.

Developing and maintaining robust integrated assurance strategies encompassing governance, risk, cost, schedule, design, change control, benefits realisation and programme performance.

Leading the assessment of procurement and delivery models, supporting clients in identifying appropriate approaches for the successful delivery of complex infrastructure and capital investment programmes.

Producing executive, board-level and stakeholder reporting, translating complex programme information into clear, evidence-based insights to support decision-making.

Embedding proactive risk management, programme controls and governance practices that support successful programme delivery and long-term investment outcomes.

Business Development

Building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across the transport and infrastructure sector, positioning Grant Thornton as a strategic advisor and partner of choice.

Leading client engagement activities, facilitating discussions, workshops and strategic planning sessions to identify client priorities, shape solutions and develop opportunities for future collaboration.

Engaging senior executives, sponsoring organisations, government bodies, regulators, delivery agencies and industry stakeholders to support successful programme outcomes and sustainable client relationships.

Developing and expanding key client accounts across the across the transport and infrastructure sector, identifying opportunities to support clients in the delivery, oversight, governance and assurance of major capital investment programmes.

Leading and directing business development initiatives, including the preparation of proposals and tenders for new transport and infrastructure sector opportunities.

Collaborating with colleagues across Advisory and the wider firm to develop integrated solutions that address programme, infrastructure and investment challenges across the transport sector.

Skills and Experience

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field; Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, APM) strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience working within large-scale capital investment and infrastructure delivery environments, including knowledge of programme governance, assurance frameworks and stage-gated approval processes.

8+ years' experience for Associate Director level, or 10+ years' experience for Director level, leading major transport and infrastructure programmes, with demonstrable expertise in programme governance, oversight, assurance, controls and the management of complex, multi-stakeholder delivery environments.

Skills and Competencies

Strong project and programme management experience leading and managing large multi-disciplinary teams comprised of clients, consultants, contractors and third-party delivery partners.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transport and infrastructure programmes, including the establishment and operation of programme governance, oversight, monitoring, assurance and programme controls frameworks.
Extensive experience working across the transport and infrastructure sector, with a strong understanding of the governance, regulatory, funding and delivery landscape associated with major capital investment programmes.
Proven ability to direct and deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programmes across the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and business case development through to implementation, assurance and benefits realisation.
Experience developing and implementing programme management approaches, including programme controls, risk management, change control, performance monitoring and continuous improvement frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives, programme sponsors and strategic stakeholders, shaping programme strategy while supporting successful delivery outcomes.
Strong organisational and multi-tasking abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities and delivering in complex, high-profile and fast-paced environments.
Significant experience in originating, leading and closing business development opportunities, including major transport and infrastructure sector tenders, frameworks and complex multi-stakeholder bids.
Expertise in senior stakeholder engagement, including government departments, transport authorities, infrastructure owners, regulators, delivery agencies and executive leadership teams.
An ability to balance big-picture thinking with acute attention to detail, translating long-term objectives into practical and deliverable solutions.
A strong interest in the future of transport and infrastructure, with an understanding of the opportunities and challenges associated with major capital investment, infrastructure delivery and programme assurance.
Experience developing and growing client accounts within the within the transport and infrastructure sector, with an established professional network and a strong understanding of market trends, client priorities and emerging investment opportunities.
A creative, problem-solving mindset and initiative-driven approach.

Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack's AI-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR's impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.

Founder-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do.

We're looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help enable the broader engineering organization to do high-impact work by building and improving the infrastructure, tooling, and deployment systems they rely on every day. You'll contribute to the development of standardized infrastructure and "paved paths" that make it easier to provision, deploy, and operate services reliably at scale.

You'll collaborate closely with application engineering teams to ensure our container-based infrastructure is scalable, cost-efficient, and dependable across a wide range of workloads.

What You'll Do
Partner with DevOps and application engineering teams to design and improve standardized infrastructure, deployment workflows, and CI/CD pipelines
Build, operate, and continuously improve our containerized infrastructure, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency
Bring deep expertise in Kubernetes and its ecosystem, helping define best practices and support adoption across engineering teams
Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure on AWS, including compute, networking, and storage systems
Improve observability, monitoring, and incident readiness across production systems
Participate in a shared on-call rotation (approximately 1 week every 5 weeks), responding to and resolving production incidents
Mentor teammates and share knowledge to improve engineering practices and operational maturity across the organization
To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have
5+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering roles
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform
Solid experience working with AWS (e.g., EKS, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC, Route53)
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, or Argo CD
Experience working with containerized systems such as Docker and containerd
Familiarity with cloud security best practices and modern approaches to securing infrastructure, including shift-left principles
Experience operating and scaling high-traffic systems and large-scale data platforms in production environments
Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging and system design
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a distributed environment
If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity
Experience improving developer workflows and reducing friction in deployment and infrastructure processes
Familiarity with tools in the Kubernetes ecosystem such as Helm, Argo CD, and Karpenter
Experience enhancing observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging systems
Experience contributing to infrastructure documentation and internal enablement efforts
Interest in continuously evaluating and adopting new technologies where they provide clear value
In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who
Take ownership of their work and proactively identify opportunities for improvement
Collaborate effectively across teams and contribute to a strong engineering culture
Balance speed and pragmatism with long-term system reliability and maintainability
Are comfortable working independently while staying aligned with a distributed team
Communicate clearly, give and receive feedback, and support teammates when needed
Proactively incorporate AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery
Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

Intro call with a member of our Talent Team
A video interview with the Hiring Manager
Peer panels
Executive Interview
Location Preferences

We are currently prioritizing candidates based in Bulgaria. Qualified candidates located in the United Kingdom and Ireland are also encouraged to apply.

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary
The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience.
The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,000+ gross per month, depending on experience.
Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.
Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup
Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership
Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.
Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment
Standardized bonus or commission structure
401(k) with employer contributions
Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents
100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans
24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program
Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits
Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days
13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days
Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion
Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training
Unlimited access to Coursera and O'Reilly
2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives
Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation
Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

Responsibilities

TikTok's SMB team aims to help businesses and brands of all sizes unleash their creative side, connect with our audience, or perhaps be discovered! From executing scaled sales and service delivery programs to ensuring our customers have best-in-class tools and products at their fingertips, our SMB team combines operational expertise and sales acumen with a customer-centric mindset to help businesses achieve their marketing goals on TikTok.

We are looking for a Vendor Sales Specialist to join our SMB EMEA sales team. This role will be responsible for the implementation of key sales programs executed by our vendor partners. These initiatives will span a range of objectives, covering multiple phases of the sales cycle. Our ideal candidate will have demonstrated success in the area of advertising sales, experience working in an outsourced vendor environment and ability to enable teams for success. Additionally, strong project management skills combined with experience working cross-functionally to identify opportunities is preferred.

Responsibilities:

Vendor Performance & Revenue Management:
- Oversee the day-to-day operations of outsourced vendor sales teams to ensure they meet or exceed quarterly revenue and advertiser acquisition targets for the EMEA SMB market.
- Monitor and drive core sales KPIs (e.g., lead conversion rates, active advertiser count, revenue retention) and operational SLAs.

Sales Enablement & Capability Building:

- Conduct regular call calibrations and shadow sessions to ensure high-quality advertiser interactions and brand safety compliance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy:
- Partner closely with internal stakeholders—including Product Operations, Marketing, Sales Strategy, and Data teams—to align vendor execution with overarching EMEA commercialization goals.
- Serve as the bridge between the vendor and internal product teams, establishing a feedback loop to report advertiser pain points, product bugs, and market trends to drive platform improvements.

Data-Driven Insights & Process Optimization:

- Proactively design and test new sales workflows, lead-routing strategies, or incentive structures to improve overall vendor efficiency and ROI.

- 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, vendor management, digital advertising, or sales operations/strategy.

- Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Data) without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Track record of successful collaboration with cross-functional teams

​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. ​

​

​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. About Kinaxis:

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

About the team:

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the UK, France or Germany

About the Role
The Program Manager is a senior member of the Professional Services Delivery organisation, responsible for leading large, complex, multi-workstream client engagements with significant delivery, commercial, and stakeholder complexity. The role provides end-to-end orchestration, governance, and integration across projects, workstreams, and delivery teams—bringing structure to ambiguity and ensuring delivery against committed scope, timelines, and value.
The Program Manager ensures alignment across workstreams, manages cross-project dependencies, and provides program-level governance, risk management, and visibility in complex, fast-moving
environments. By coordinating across teams and stakeholders, the role plays a critical part in enabling
successful delivery outcomes.
As a trusted partner to senior client stakeholders, the Program Manager works closely with internal teams to support the successful execution of Kinaxis’ most complex and high-impact client engagements.

About the role:

Key Responsibilities
• Lead program-level coordination and execution across multiple projects, phases, and delivery
teams to ensure alignment to scope, timelines, and expected outcomes.
• Establish and maintain project governance, including integrated plans, milestone tracking,
reporting cadence, and escalation frameworks.
• Manage cross-project dependencies, risks, and issues, proactively driving resolution in
partnership with Delivery Managers/Directors and key client stakeholders.
• Support senior client and executive stakeholder engagement through clear, structured program
reporting and communication.
• Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, ensuring clarity of roles,
ownership, and execution priorities.
• Monitor project financials, including forecasting, tracking, and variance identification across
workstreams.
• Drive consistency in delivery practices across projects, contributing to program-level standards,
tools, and methodologies.
• Provide guidance and informal mentorship to (Senior) Delivery Managers on complex delivery
scenarios and program coordination.

Primary Skills and Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 10+ years of progressive experience delivering complex software or technology programs in a
professional services or consulting environment.
• Proven experience managing multiple projects with significant scale, interdependencies, and
stakeholder complexity.
• Strong understanding of project governance, delivery frameworks, and risk management across
multi-phase engagements.
• Experience supporting project financials, including forecasting, tracking, and budget oversight.
• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with
competing priorities.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across all
levels of the organization.
• Ability to align cross-functional teams and drive execution without direct authority.
• Solid understanding of enterprise software delivery lifecycles; supply chain domain experience is
an asset.
• Experience with program and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project,
Confluence, SharePoint).
• PMP or equivalent certification is an asset; familiarity with Agile or hybrid delivery models
preferred.
• Willingness to travel as required for client engagements.

We are seeking an experienced Program Lead, FSP Operations (Data Management) to join Parexel's Functional Service Provider organization. Establish frameworks and standardized approaches for FSP service delivery while maintaining flexibility for program specific requirements
Implement quality standards, reporting mechanisms, and performance metrics to evaluate program effectiveness across FSP operations

Identify opportunities to expand FSP services and develop targeted business strategies that support client and organizational objectives

Strong leadership, strategic planning, and operational management skills
Experience leading Data Management FSP programs within a CRO environment
The ability to influence cross functional teams and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels
A customer focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high quality results and operational excellence
Experience with workforce forecasting, resource planning, billing processes, financial tracking, and performance reporting within an FSP environment

Advanced degree in a life sciences, healthcare, business, or related discipline

Familiarity with performance measurement, quality management, and operational process improvement initiatives

Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
Flexible benefit portal
Car or car allowance (only applicable roles)

Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships, and comfortable facilitating change and being accountable for driving success with customers.
Experience in leading, adopting and driving change internally or externally.
Experience in identifying, translating and prioritizing customer issues and needs into business or solution requirements.
Demonstrated success as a trusted advisor to senior executives in large organizations and ability to build success plans.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Sr. Data Product Leader to support our office.

Job Description

HPE Financial Services (HPEFS) is seeking a Data Product Leader to own the day-to-day execution of treating data as a managed, governed, and intentionally designed product across the HPEFS digital ecosystem. Reporting to the Digital Strategy Leader, this role is responsible for ensuring HPEFS data is trusted, governed, reusable, and AI-ready so that it can be consumed reliably across reporting, analytics, automation, AI-enabled experiences, and digital products. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role and serves as the primary business-side voice for data consumers across Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, Compliance, Analytics, and AI-enabled initiatives.

Responsibilities

Data Product Strategy & Roadmap



- Own the data product vision, strategy, and roadmap for HPEFS, aligned to enterprise data-as-a-product direction and broader digital strategy. 
- Define and maintain the enterprise data product portfolio across key business domains, including Customer, Asset, Transaction, Risk, and Operational data. 
- Translate business needs, AI/analytics use cases, and reporting requirements into outcome-based data product requirements using the enterprise Outcome-Based Requirements (OBR) framework. 
- Prioritize the portfolio based on business value potential, reuse, risk reduction, and enablement of downstream analytics, automation, and AI use cases. 
- Align data product priorities with D365, Portals & APIs, Odessa, GPO, Pyramid, and other digital ecosystem initiatives, and continuously reassess the portfolio for new products, enhancements, consolidation, or deprecation. 

Data Product Lifecycle Management



- Own the full data product lifecycle from ideation and design through development, deployment, adoption, iteration, and deprecation. 
- Manage a prioritized backlog with clear acceptance criteria, business outcomes, OKR alignment, and release readiness expectations aligned to enterprise release governance. 
- Define and enforce product standards for quality, SLAs, metadata, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and usage guidance. 
- Ensure data products are reusable, composable, and scalable across consumption channels, including dashboards, APIs, semantic layers, governed datasets, analytical models, and AI-enabled solutions. 

AI & Analytics Enablement



- Ensure HPEFS data products are intentionally designed to support AI, advanced analytics, operational reporting, executive dashboards, automation, and digital product consumption. 
- Define AI-readiness criteria that go beyond baseline data product standards, including semantic clarity, business context, explainability, appropriate-use guidance, and fitness for machine consumption. 
- Ensure consumers understand intended use, known limitations, interpretation guidance, and downstream dependencies for each data product. 
- Translate AI, analytics, and automation needs into practical data product requirements in partnership with business, data science, reporting, and automation teams. 
- Support responsible AI practices by ensuring data used for AI-enabled insights or decisions is traceable, auditable, and risk-aligned. 
- Identify opportunities where trusted data products unlock predictive insights, intelligent workflow automation, customer intelligence, risk visibility, and faster time-to-insight. 

Data Governance & Quality



- Serve as the business-side steward of data governance for assigned domains, ensuring adherence to enterprise policies and standards. 
- Own business glossary definitions, data dictionaries, sensitivity classification, and domain-level metadata for assigned data domains. 
- Define data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, and remediation paths, and drive root cause analysis for issues that impact reporting, AI outputs, or business decisions. 
- Ensure data products comply with regulatory requirements, including AML/KYC, SOX, GDPR, CCPA, and internal audit standards. 
- Partner with the HPE Data Office and IT on governance frameworks, tooling such as Collibra, and enterprise data catalog implementation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement



- Serve as the primary liaison between data consumers (Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, Compliance) and data producers (IT, Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science). 
- Facilitate domain working sessions to capture requirements, validate data product design, and drive alignment on priorities and tradeoffs. 
- Partner with Business Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Process Engineering so data products support end-to-end process and product outcomes. 
- Collaborate with Product Enablement to strengthen data and AI literacy, adoption, and responsible consumption across business teams. 
- Coordinate with the Product Insight/Analytics Lead on shared measurement, dashboards, and value realization reporting; engage external vendors as needed under HPEFS vendor governance. 

Measurement, Adoption & Value Realization



- Define and track KPIs for each data product, including adoption, data quality, consumer satisfaction, time-to-insight, reuse, and business value delivered. 
- Track outcomes tied to enterprise objectives, such as reduced manual reporting, faster insight generation, improved decision confidence, and stronger self-service adoption. 
- Communicate data product updates, roadmap progress, risks, and value realization to the Digital Strategy Leader and senior leadership. 
- Drive product-level continuous improvement through structured feedback loops, usage analytics, and periodic data product reviews. 

Education And Experience Required



- First-level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred (Business, Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field). 
- Typically 7+ years of related experience in product management, data management, or data strategy, preferably within financial services, leasing, or fintech. 
- Prior people management experience required, including leading direct reports, matrixed teams, or cross-functional squads; ability to coach, develop talent, and drive accountability across geographies. 
- Demonstrated experience treating data as a product, including defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, and measuring outcomes. 
- Experience partnering across global teams spanning business, IT, data, analytics, and governance stakeholders. 

Knowledge And Skills



- Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and data catalog concepts. 
- Ability to define AI-ready data product requirements, including semantic clarity, business context, appropriate-use guidance, and fitness for AI, analytics, and reporting consumption. 
- Understanding of responsible AI principles as they relate to governance, privacy, explainability, auditability, and risk management. 
- SQL proficiency and working familiarity with modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric), BI tools, and data catalog/governance tools (e.g., Collibra). 
- Familiarity with AI/ML data consumption patterns, semantic layers, feature stores, vector databases, data APIs, or model-ready datasets. 
- Working knowledge of model risk, data bias, data drift, and explainability concepts. 
- Experience defining common business metrics, semantic models, or reusable analytical datasets across functions. 
- Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to financial services (AML/KYC, SOX, GDPR, CCPA). 
- Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
- Domain knowledge in leasing, asset management, or financial services operations preferred. 
- People leadership skills: coaching, performance management, team development, and driving execution through others. 
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into clear business language and executive-ready narratives. 

Additional Skills

Accountability, Active Listening, Agile Methodology, Business Acumen, Change Management, Coaching, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Governance, Data Product Management, Data Quality, Decision Making, Executive Communication, Growth Mindset, Influencing Skills, Leadership, Managing Ambiguity, Outcome-Based Requirements, People Management, Product Management, Responsible AI, Roadmap Planning, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Thinking, Talent Development.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

About The Role

As a Delivery Manager in our National Security and Safety team at Faculty, you will act as a pivotal commercial and delivery lead, driving high-stakes AI transformation for the UK’s most critical government partners.

You will be a strategic architect, building deep networks of influence and solving complex challenges by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and operational mission needs.

With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will exceed ambitious growth targets while mentoring multidisciplinary teams to ensure every project delivers meaningful, long-term value in a fast-evolving national security landscape.

What You'll Be Doing



- Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation.
- Collaborating with technical teams and government partners to design innovative AI solutions that solve their most pressing mission challenges.
- Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the national security community.
- Forming strong, trusting relationships with customers, internal data scientists, and technical partners to translate research into operational impact.
- Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our footprint and impact across the national security sector.
- Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner and consultant in high-stakes environments.
- Mentoring your peers and taking a proactive role in building robust processes and practices within the team.

Who We're Looking For



- You bring a solid foundation in the National Security domain, with a passionate interest in how AI can transform high-stakes decision-making and public safety.
- You possess experience in consultancy or service-based delivery, allowing you to manage complex project lifecycles and meet critical deadlines under pressure.
- You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption within government.
- You are an exceptional communicator, with outstanding skills in managing senior stakeholders and translating complex concepts for non-technical audiences.
- You are comfortable working with technical teams and have a proven track record of delivering technical projects, ideally in AI.
- You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential risks to national security missions and proactively implementing solutions.

The Interview Process



- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
- Introduction Interview (60 minutes) 
- Case Study Interview (60 minutes) 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some Of Our Standout Benefits



- Unlimited Annual Leave Policy
- Private healthcare and dental
- Enhanced parental leave
- Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working
- Sanctus Coaching
- Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

We are seeking an experienced senior project leader (Associate Director / Director level) to join our Consulting practice, with a focus on the utilities sector. The role offers the opportunity to lead large-scale project delivery and transformation initiatives, supporting utility organisations in delivering strategic transformation, operational improvement and realising innovation-led business outcomes.

We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive experience leading major programmes, projects and transformation initiatives within the utilities sector, including water, electricity and gas. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting clients to address emerging challenges, realise strategic objectives and deliver lasting business value.

Embrace the possibility to apply – at Grant Thornton we are constantly upskilling our staff. If you do not meet all of the listed requirements, please do not be discouraged from applying. We value a growth-oriented mindset and are dedicated to supporting you in reaching your full potential.

Roles & Responsibilities

Collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team to successfully deliver and manage projects across a range of key utilities sector initiatives, including:

Project Management Delivery

Overseeing and providing strategic leadership in the delivery of complex utilities sector projects and programmes, ensuring high-quality outputs and meeting tight deadlines.

Defining and driving projects across all stages of the project life cycle, from initiation to implementation and evaluation.

Leading and mentoring multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaboration across client organisations, delivery partners, regulators and other key stakeholders.

Developing and maintaining robust project governance frameworks, delivery plans, risk management approaches and stakeholder engagement strategies to support successful programme outcomes.

Providing strategic advice to utilities clients on major transformation initiatives, including digital transformation, infrastructure modernisation, operational excellence and organisational change.

Leading the assessment of procurement and delivery models, supporting clients in identifying appropriate approaches for the delivery of complex capital, operational and transformation programmes.

Combining data-driven analysis and industry insight to address critical challenges and opportunities across the utilities sector, translating findings into practical and actionable recommendations.

Business Development

Building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across the utilities sector, positioning Grant Thornton as a strategic advisor and partner of choice.

Leading client engagement activities, facilitating discussions, workshops and strategic planning sessions to identify business needs, shape solutions and develop opportunities for future collaboration.

Engaging senior executives, industry bodies, regulators and delivery partners to drive project momentum and success.

Developing and expanding key client accounts across the water, electricity and gas sectors, identifying opportunities to support clients in addressing strategic, operational and transformation challenges.

Leading and directing business development initiatives, including the preparation of proposals and tenders for new utilities sector opportunities.

Collaborating with colleagues across Advisory and the wider firm to develop integrated solutions that address complex client challenges across the utilities value chain.

Skills and Experience

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field; Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, APM) strongly preferred.

8+ years' experience for Associate Director level, or 10+ years' experience for Director level, leading large-scale projects and programmes within the utilities sector, with a proven track record of leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives and multidisciplinary teams.

Skills and Competencies

Strong project and programme management experience leading and managing large multi-disciplinary teams comprised of clients, consultants, contractors and third-party delivery partners.

Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transformation programmes and change initiatives within the utilities sector, including the establishment and operation of delivery and financial governance frameworks, project quality assurance processes and risk and dependency management approaches.

Extensive experience working in the utilities sector, with knowledge of its regulatory, operational and commercial landscape.

Proven ability to direct and deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programmes across the full project lifecycle, including strategic transformation, operational improvement, and capital investment initiatives within utility organisations.

Experience in process analysis and design, including as-is and to-be process mapping, process performance design, implementation, optimisation and continuous improvement.

Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and strategic stakeholders, shaping strategy as well as delivering operational outcomes.
Strong organisational and multi-tasking abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities and delivering in complex, fast-paced environments.
Significant experience in originating, leading and closing business development opportunities, including utilities sector tenders and complex multi-stakeholder bids.
Expertise in senior stakeholder engagement, including government departments, regulators, industry bodies and C-Suite / Senior Management.
An ability to balance big-picture thinking with acute attention to detail, translating long-term objectives into practical and deliverable solutions.
A strong interest in the future of the utilities sector and in helping clients navigate emerging challenges and opportunities through innovation and transformation.
Experience developing and growing client accounts within the utilities sector, with an established professional network and a strong understanding of market trends, client priorities and emerging opportunities.
A creative, problem-solving mindset and initiative-driven approach.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Reliability & Operations Engineering 👋

Trainline is a fast-growing tech company powering world-class digital journeys for millions of customers. Our platform runs primarily on AWS, built on cloud-native architecture, modern CI/CD pipelines, and strong DevOps and SRE practices.

The Reliability & Operations Engineering team (ReliabilityOps) brings together SRE, Incident Management, and Database Reliability to keep our platform observable, reliable, scalable, and resilient. We partner closely with product engineering teams to enable safe delivery, respond to incidents, and continuously strengthen system reliability.

We’re looking for a mid-level Site Reliability Engineer to help drive this forward. You’ll bring solid production experience, a growth mindset, and a willingness to challenge and be challenged — contributing to platform reliability while developing broader technical ownership with support from senior engineers.



As an SRE at Trainline, you'll be working on...🚄

 - Developing an understanding of system architecture, dependencies, and failure modes across the Trainline platform

 - Participating in production incident response, supporting investigation, mitigation, communication, and coordinated service restoration

 - Contributing to post-incident reviews and follow-up actions to improve reliability, scalability, and resilience

 - Taking part in the SRE on-call rotation

 - Designing, building, and maintaining observability using metrics, logs, events, and traces to support effective detection and diagnosis

 - Improving monitoring and alerting by aligning signals to business and customer impact, reducing noise and improving mean time to detection (MTTD)

 - Ensuring relevant operational data is surfaced quickly and clearly during live incidents

 - Making informed tooling and technology choices using SRE principles, balancing team and business needs

 - Supporting AWS-hosted infrastructure and shared platform services using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling

 - Collaborating with product engineering teams to ensure services are operationally ready and deployed safely

 - Advising on reliability and resilience practices

 - Writing and maintaining reliable, well-structured code and scripts to support reliability and observability goals

 - Prioritising work effectively and collaborating using agile processes to deliver against team and business goals

Our Tech Stack 🔑

 - AWS

 - New Relic

 - ELK stack

 - Grafana

 - Incident.io

 - Docker, ECS

 - Terraform

 - Github Actions

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Experience of SRE concepts such as SLI, SLO and error budgets.

 - Hands-on experience with observability tooling such as New Relic, Elastic (ELK Stack), Influx, Grafana or similar

 - Experience working with cloud providers (preferably AWS).

 - Experience troubleshooting Linux operating systems.

 - Experience of scripting in at least one language (preferably Python)

 - Understanding of load balancing and reverse proxy concepts, upstream config concepts, upstream health checks, worker & data flow concepts.

 - Application architecture concepts (threading, queuing, readiness checks, health checks, circuit breakers, timeouts, exponential backoff, throttling).

 - Experience building, maintaining and evolving time series data, retention, cardinality, deviation, moving averages and other functions.

 - Experience with build, deployment & configuration management tooling such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges.

Role:

At ClearRoute, the Technical Delivery Manager is the operational backbone of an engagement: running governance, managing risk, coordinating delivery teams, and keeping clients and ClearRoute aligned. Working at ClearRoute

We have grown from six founders to 180+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow.



- Real flexibility, in practice. We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included).
- When ClearRoute wins, you win. We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing.
- A community you'll genuinely want to be part of. Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.
- Where meaningful work meets real growth. You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute.

At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis.

We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at join@clearroute.io

In this Technical Principal Program Manager role you will be an integral driver for the Windows Fundamentals Compatibility team’s charter. Our job is to ensure that millions of Windows applications and devices “just work.” This sounds simple, but it’s not an easy charter considering that Windows ships feature changes and security updates monthly to billions of devices. Our job as Windows Compatibility becomes more complex as we drive quality and consistency with app and device behavior alongside changes for our retail and commercial customers.

Compatibility is a deep and broad space that offers many opportunities to learn about the complexity of the OS and how applications interact with it. We are responsible for inbox functionality to mitigate issues, we support services to keep in-market Windows devices healthy, and we play an integral role in shipping each new Windows update to the ecosystem. Across all these areas, we invest and deploy AI effectively to meet our goals. This role requires strategic leadership within the Compatibility team, as well as across the organization.

At the end of the day, you will be ensuring that we’re able to ship the full portfolio of Microsoft operating systems at the highest quality and enable our ecosystem of applications and devices to work seamlessly on this OS.

If improving the experience for over a billion users excites you, if you have a real passion to support customers and understand the complexity of the OS, while growing into a leader within a team of dedicated PMs, then please reach out. We’d love to hear from you!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities



- Support the App Compat charter by determining strategy, planning work, driving cross-team feature work and aligning with internal and external partners. 
- Use data effectively to determine the work needed to ensure in-market customers have few to no compatibility issues. 
- Support our charter to ensure that Windows devices are developed to support compatibility by leading internal education on the value of a compatible OS that results in a highly customer-centric experience. 
- Collaborate with internal and external partners to drive business decisions that lead to high quality OS releases. 
- Determine the best ways to implement AI solutions in all aspects of our work. 
- Provide leadership within a team of Technical Program Managers and Product Managers of diverse levels. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 



- Bachelor's Degree AND strong demonstrated experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.

- OR equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
Preferred Qualifications



- Bachelor's Degree AND strong demonstrated experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.

- OR equivalent experience.
- Strong experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
- 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
- Excellent track record of cross group collaboration. 
- Ambitious, self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented Prefer 5+ years of program management experience working on OS, embedded systems or similarly deep technological areas.
