Summary

The Manager, Learning Product Enablement plays a critical role in advancing Novartis' transformation toward a product-led learning organization. As part of the Learning Strategy & Operations team within the US Skills & Capabilities Training organization, this position is responsible for enabling the design, adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of learning products that support capability development across Commercial Sales, Field Medical, NPS, and Access & Reimbursement teams.

Partnering across US Skills & Capabilities Training, Commercial Operations, CRM, DDIT, vendor partners, and the Global Learning Center of Excellence, this role will help shape scalable, data-driven, and AI-enhanced learning experiences that improve learner engagement, accelerate capability development, and deliver measurable business impact.

The successful candidate will serve as a champion for learner-centric innovation, ensuring that learning products evolve continuously to meet changing business priorities, workforce needs, and the future of commercial learning.

About The Role

Major Accountabilities



- Learning Product Strategy & Innovation
- Support the development and execution of the learning product strategy for Commercial Sales, Field Medical, NPS, and Access & Reimbursement audiences.
- Partner with Skills & Capabilities leaders and business stakeholders to identify capability gaps, learner needs, and future learning opportunities.
- Develop and maintain learning product roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities and workforce capability requirements.
- Evaluate emerging learning technologies, AI-enabled solutions, performance support tools, and digital learning trends to enhance learner experiences.
- Consult on the design of AI-enabled learning ecosystems, learner journeys, and adoption strategies.
- Assess learner feedback, utilization data, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement.
- Develop business cases and recommendations for product enhancements, new learning solutions, and innovation initiatives.
- Support pilot programs and experimentation efforts that improve learning effectiveness, engagement, and personalization.
- Advocate for the learner experience by ensuring learning products are designed around user needs, adoption barriers, and desired business outcomes.
- Product Ownership & Portfolio Governance
- Partner with Learning Measurement & Analytics teams to define success metrics, adoption targets, engagement indicators, and business impact measures.
- Manage learner enhancement requests, feedback processes, and prioritization activities.
- Oversee learning product lifecycle activities from pilot and launch through adoption, optimization, scaling, and retirement.
- Coordinate cross-functionally with Learning Operations, Onboarding, Innovative Learning Design, Project Management, DDIT, CRM, and external vendors to ensure alignment on priorities and delivery timelines.
- Monitor product health and adoption trends through dashboards, analytics, surveys, and learner feedback.
- Support portfolio governance by providing data-driven insights on product performance, learner satisfaction, utilization, and business value.
- Facilitate stakeholder discussions related to product priorities, roadmap decisions, and capability development strategies.
- Ensure learning products remain aligned with broader Commercial Capability objectives and enterprise learning strategies.
- Stakeholder Engagement & Change Enablement
- Build strong partnerships with stakeholders across the US, Mexico City, and global teams operating across multiple time zones.
- Drive adoption and engagement through effective communication, change management, and learner enablement strategies.
- Anticipate stakeholder needs and provide consultative recommendations that support evolving business priorities.
- Influence cross-functional teams and leaders to champion learning product adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You'll Bring To The Role



- Bachelor's degree required.
- 4+ years of experience working within Learning & Development, Learning Technology, Capability Development, or related functions.
- 4+ years of experience leading or contributing to complex learning technology initiatives, digital learning programs, or large-scale capability development projects.
- Experience partnering with IT, DDIT, CRM, or technology teams to implement and optimize learning solutions.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
- Experience leveraging dashboards, reporting tools, and survey platforms to measure learning effectiveness and product adoption.
- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate technical and business concepts to diverse audiences.
- Proven ability to work effectively in matrixed organizations and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong collaboration, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment characterized by ambiguity, change, and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications



- 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
- Experience with AI-enabled learning technologies and integrating AI tools into capability development programs.
- Experience managing external vendors and third-party learning technology partners.
- Knowledge of learning analytics, learner experience design, and product management principles.
- MBA, advanced degree, or relevant technical certification is a plus.
- Familiarity with Power BI and advanced reporting or visualization tools is a plus.
- Knowledge of Kirkpatrick's Four Levels of Training Evaluation is a plus.
- Experience supporting global or multi-regional learning organizations is a plus.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to scale Murphy. We need someone to deploy into new territory, impose order on chaos, and stand up the operation — then do it again in the next market. You'll own the expansion playbook, partners and vendors, product quality and enable x1,000 growth of the company that proved its product-market-fit. This is a founder's right hand on execution and operations, with outsized leverage over where the company goes.

Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're taking it into every market and every adjacent business, and we need someone to own that expansion end to end.

What you'll do



- Productise expansion. Turn a new country from a bespoke project into a repeatable playbook: localised voice, policies, compliance per market, so we go live in weeks, not quarters.
- Be the operating system of the product org. Own the planning cadence, the metrics and the prioritisation across bets, so a small team makes big, fast, well-sequenced calls.
- Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the roots of complex problems, understand all the nuances and design solutions that solve the root cause elegantly.

Who you are



- A builder and an operator. You've converted uncertainty and chaos into a well-oiled execution machine — a process, a team, or a function — whether as a founder, an operations lead, a PM, or a military officer who's stood up and led an operation under pressure.
- You own outcomes, and you never settle. You hold people accountable and demand a high execution excellence bar under speed.
- You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, rigorous with numbers, and have a strong philosophy of a champion.
- AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default — and you know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
- You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up regulation, unit economics and a new market cold, fast.

🤝 What we offer

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

🧩 Real Ownership - Murphy's strategy is yours to drive.

🙌 Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

🗣️ The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office, and 2 days of remote work.

📚 Our Process

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Call with the Founders

Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction.

👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Who We Are

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.



- Seek Excellence.
- Be Selective To Be Effective.
- Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
- Disagree Transparently.
- Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
- Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned, execution-focused Technical Program Manager who thrives in fast-paced environments and brings structure to ambiguity. You are comfortable operating across time zones and functions, partnering with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to drive high-quality delivery—ideally within financial services or retail-facing platforms.

You own the operational side of software delivery, including intake, prioritization, tracking, and stakeholder coordination. You ensure work is clearly defined, appropriately scoped, and consistently progressing. You proactively surface blockers, drive follow-ups, and maintain visibility across teams, taking full accountability for outcomes.

You have the technical depth to understand how systems connect and where risks emerge. While not hands-on coding, you can engage in architecture discussions, navigate dependencies, and confidently represent technical progress to both engineers and business stakeholders.

You are equally comfortable leading complex, multi-team initiatives and diving into execution details—whether refining JIRA boards or delivering concise status updates. You operate with urgency and independence, and can confidently represent globally distributed teams at the executive level.

Based in London, you play a key role in bridging teams across New York and India, enabling consistent communication and execution.

What You’ll Do



- Act as a key execution partner to the India-based Head of Galaxy Retail (G1), supporting multiple engineering teams (20–30 developers across New York and India)
- Serve as the central point of accountability for execution across Retail Engineering, aligning business priorities with technical delivery
- Own the end-to-end intake process for new workstreams—ensuring requests are captured, clearly defined, scoped, and prioritized
- Maintain a real-time view of team resourcing, priorities, and delivery progress, identifying conflicts, risks, and gaps early
- Build and maintain clear, up-to-date reporting (“single pane of glass”) for leadership and stakeholders
- Drive structured execution across time zones, partnering closely with tech leads to maintain consistent delivery rhythms
- Lead complex, cross-team initiatives with multiple dependencies, ensuring alignment and timely delivery
- Coordinate with adjacent teams (infrastructure, security, controls) to manage dependencies and unblock execution
- Proactively identify and resolve blockers, risks, and changes in scope or resourcing
- Deliver clear, concise updates to senior leadership, including the CTO
- Contribute to improving delivery standards and operational maturity across the Technology organization
- Embrace and champion the thoughtful adoption of AI to improve team performance and business outcomes.
- Leverage AI tools (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, data copilots) to improve productivity, decision-making, and output quality in your day-to-day work.

What We’re Looking For



- 7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, with direct involvement in engineering-led delivery
- Strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams and time zones
- Proven ability to manage intake, triage requests, and define scope and priorities with technical stakeholders
- Experience tracking resource allocation across teams and proactively identifying capacity risks or gaps
- Demonstrated ability to drive execution—organizing work, following through, and unblocking teams
- Highly structured, with strong fluency in delivery tooling (JIRA, dashboards, documentation)
- Excellent communicator, able to deliver concise updates to senior stakeholders, including the CTO
- Experience managing large, multi-team initiatives with cross-functional dependencies
- Ability to engage deeply with technical systems, architecture, and dependencies without being hands-on coding
- Operates independently with strong ownership, urgency, and accountability
- Based in London, with the ability to bridge execution across New York and India
- Experience in digital assets and financial markets, including experience delivering technology initiatives in retail finance environments

Bonus Points



- Prior experience as a software engineer or in a hands-on technical role is a strong plus

What We Offer



- Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
- Hybrid working arrangements
- Company-paid health/dental (Bupa) and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
- 4% company pension contribution
- Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace
- Generous paid Parental Leave
- Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
- Free daily snacks and weekly lunches (London office)
- Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
- Employee Resource Groups
- Benefits may vary depending on location.

About the opportunity The ICP Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of electrical infrastructure projects within an Independent Connection Provider (ICP) environment. The role is accountable for managing projects from initial acceptance through to construction, energisation, and final handover, ensuring delivery is safe, compliant, on time, within budget, and to the required standards.

Please note: We are open to UK wide applications, and happy to offer a fully remote working pattern for this opportunity.

What you'll do  You will act as the primary point of contact for clients, Distribution Network Operators (DNOs), Independent Distribution Network Operators (IDNOs), contractors, and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. This is a high throughput role where you will coordinate multidisciplinary teams and manage commercial, technical, operational, and regulatory requirements. The role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and project delivery skills, with a focus on maintaining high standards of safety, customer service, and financial performance whilst driving successful project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities



- Manage the successful delivery of multiple ICP projects from inception to completion. 
- Ensure compliance with all health, safety, environmental, and quality management requirements. 
- Develop, monitor, and maintain project programmes, budgets, and resource plans. 
- Act as the primary customer interface, managing client expectations and maintaining strong relationships. 
- Coordinate design, procurement, commercial and construction activities. 
- Liaise with DNOs, IDNOs, local authorities, and other statutory bodies to secure approvals and project milestones. 
- Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and opportunities. 
- Monitor project financial performance, including cost control, forecasting, and change management. 
- Prepare and present project reports, updates, and performance metrics to senior management and stakeholders. 
- Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the development of project delivery best practices. 

About You You will have proven experience managing electrical infrastructure, utilities, or ICP projects, with a strong understanding of project management methodologies and delivery processes. The following skills and attributes will set you up for success:

Essential Skills & Experience



- Experience managing project budgets, commercial performance, and cost control. 
- Demonstrable understanding of health and safety legislation and CDM requirements. 
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and construction documentation. 
- Experience managing contractors, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary teams. 
- Excellent stakeholder management and client relationship skills. 
- Strong planning, organisational, and problem-solving abilities. 
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management software. 

Desirable Skills And Experience



- Degree or higher qualification in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline. 
- Formal project management qualification (PRINCE2, APM PMQ, PMP, or equivalent). 
- Knowledge of UK electrical distribution networks, connection processes, and industry standards. 
- Experience working with DNOs, IDNOs, and National Grid requirements. 
- Knowledge of HV and LV electrical distribution systems. 
- Understanding of G81 design and adoption standards. 
- Commercial and contractual management experience. 
- Knowledge of utility asset adoption processes. 
- Membership of a relevant professional body (APM, IET, ICE, or equivalent). 

Personal Attributes



- Customer-focused with a commitment to delivering exceptional service. 
- Collaborative team player with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels. 
- Results driven with a commitment to achieving project objectives. 
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
- Proactive and highly organised approach to work. 
- Strong commercial awareness and business acumen. 
- Ability to make informed decisions under pressure. 
- Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic environment. 
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability. 
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and influence others. 

Working Pattern:



- Remote / Home based
- Other: Regular UK wide travel will be required 

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation:



- Salary: £50,000 - £60,000

Benefits:



- Company vehicle
- Pension (Salary Sacrifice)
- Healthcare Scheme
- 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays 
- EV Salary Sacrifice scheme 
- Life Assurance 

At TSG Power UK we fully support and encourage your professional development. This position offers a pathway for ambitious individuals keen to progress to senior roles in project management or HV Operations as well as potential to move within the wider TSG UK businesses, including Charge, Solar or BESS related activities.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion; our commitment to DEI: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

About the job
Job summary

As Programme Director (SCS 1) for Project Gigabit, you will be responsible for delivering DSITs largest GMPP programme and one of the governments major infrastructure programmes. Project Gigabit is central to the government ambitions to kickstart economic growth, reduce the digital divide and ensure that new and existing technologies are safely developed and deployed across the country.

The Programme Director will work closely with DSITs Commercial Lead, BDUKs Head of Strategy and Ministers to deliver the governments key manifesto commitment of achieving 99% gigabit-capable broadband coverage by 2032. You will report to the BDUK CEO and play a key part in BDUKs Senior Leadership Team.

Job description

As Programme Director for Project Gigabit your key responsibilities will include:

Lead the implementation of Project Gigabit and ensure the programme meets its 2032 target, reporting on programme delivery to stakeholders including Ministers, the BDUK Board and NISTA and demonstrating good programme management is in place, and accountable for beneﬁts realisation, ensuring intended outcomes are achieved.

Ensure robust and effective programme governance through the Programme Board and Investment Boards ensuring that risks and issues are managed and addressed  with escalation were necessary and oversee the identification and management of dependencies across delivery partners and programme.

Uses digital tools to analyse data to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and improve efficiency. Uses data insights to make high level decisions to ensure programmes stay on track and deliver outcomes.

Manage the implementation of the plan to reach 99% coverage through programme of contracting through available mechanisms including Gigabit contracts and final voucher projects. Ensuring all remaining in-scope premises are within plans to meet the 2032 target date.

Provide team leadership for the Project Gigabit team ensuring they have the capabilities they need to effectively deliver the programme in response to changing business requirements and ensure strategic workforce and resource planning across the programme.

Support continued improvement and streamlining of systems and processes for procurements and contract changes.

Work with the Devolved Governments to complete the remaining procurements. Ensure that external stakeholders have good information on programme delivery and provide effective support to ministers for external engagement events with MPs and other stakeholders. Maintain high-quality correspondence and that relevant targets are met.

Manage remaining delivery of Superfast and vouchers projects and ensure a tight approach is in place for final Superfast closures and that the plan for voucher project close-down is targeted and effective in implementation.

Ensure effective management of finances for existing projects and programmes including managing spend to meet end year programme spend profiles.

Ensures that environmental and social considerations are embedded in programme design, procurement and monitoring processes.

Person specification

Essential Requirements:

Leadership Capability: Proven experience leading and inspiring diverse teams through change, engaging senior leaders to shape strategy, and aligning stakeholders with the long-term vision..

Stakeholder Management: A track record of building strong, productive relationships with varied stakeholders, resolving complex challenges with clarity, and delivering mutually beneficial outcomes.
Collaboration and inﬂuencing: Skilled at cultivating inclusive team cultures, building strong networks, and actively using feedback to influence decisions and drive results.
Programme Management: Demonstrated experience delivering multi-million pound programmes on time and within budget, with strong risk management and proactive issue resolution.
Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to manage complex, commercially driven programmes that are delivered in partnership with external organisations.

Desirable Skills

Expectation that you will have or be willing to pass the Infrastructure and Projects Authority (IPA) Major Projects Leadership Academy (MPLA) Programme.
Experience in telecoms and/or major infrastructure sectors

2602b13fb9c86693.description:
The Engagement Manager role is a services function role within the TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) Practice Delivery team and is responsible for managing one or more projects/engagements at a time. A successful Engagement Manager possesses skillsets for managing teams, client facing, stakeholder management, delivery processes, issue resolution for all customer engagements. The delivery function responsibilities vary from account to account, but a successful Engagement Manager is responsible for common activities such as on/off boarding of team members, people management, customer management & reporting, finance management, support project team member activities, risk & issue resolution and supporting other Delivery members within the account portfolio, and project/engagements. The Engagement Manager assumes accountability of meeting customer expectations, delivery assurance of scope of services, deliverables, and all-round outcomes from the engagements. The Engagement Manager is responsible for qualifying and quantifying the business value benefits from the project outcome throughout the engagement.


The responsibilities listed below are not exhaustive, as each account will state their unique requirements in the Statement of Work (SoW) or as defined with the Account team at the start of the project.


Specific Requirements for this Role



- Working from TGS office and/or Client sites in & around the location typically 3 days per week and flexible remote working from home 2 days per week
- Able to work independently, own initiative and guide and support other delivery member within the account portfolio
- Travel to other TGS and Client offices (UK & Europe) for face-to-face meetings on need basis
- Exposure to project delivery involving Data Engineering (Transformation and Analytics)
- Exposure to project delivery with cloud service partner – AWS (Preferred), GCP or Azure
- Strong stakeholder management including cross region or functional teams
- Financial Services Industry and Project delivery exposure


Key Responsibilities:

- Delivery Management: Delivery of the Engagement, SoW requirements and deliverables as defined by customer.
- Understand SoWs/MSAs and importance of staying on top of the engagement activities & deliverables to meet the expectations of the customer.
- Collaborate with cross functional teams to manage risk, engagement scope, and deliver according to the terms and conditions of our contracts.
- Manage revenue and control cost & profitability for assigned engagement/s.
- Consolidate and provide engagement delivery reporting as per the Customer engagement needs via a Monthly and/or Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR).
- Establish escalation protocol between Engagement teams (Consultants, Internal FTEs), Customer Hiring/Project Managers and TGS Account Managers.
- Set and manage timekeeping processes and delivery expectations with consultants.
- Follow and adhere to relevant delivery framework to ensure all aspects of the engagement delivery are covered.
- Facilitating group sessions with consultants to share best practices, technical solution recommendations, case studies and build support network community.



- Account & Customer Management: Establish and perform periodic customer engagement, and solution “health checks” baselined against the target metrics/expectations associated with the value streams.
- Accountable for customer engagement requirements to deliver and meet or exceed customer expectations.
- Participate in Account Strategy with internal stakeholders relative to engagement status, opportunities, and imminent risks.
- Establish and support reporting cadences, status reports, RAID log, and budgetary documentation.
- Facilitate the collaboration between the Customer, Consultants and TGS Practice groups to extend the support as required.
- Co-ordinate with cross-functional teams to keep the consultant’s forum together, networking, share best practices, driving relevant newsletters, lunch & learn sessions etc.,



- Management Responsibilities: Act as a servant leader in leading/directing delivery activities across multiple engagements.
- Consolidate engagement status and budget information across the portfolio.
- Develop and maintain engagement related documentation including processes, tools, and procedures in accordance with the TGS delivery framework.
- Understand and manage customer requirements (deliverables) to ensure contract compliance and customer satisfaction.
- Ensure Human Resources policies and procedures are communicated to consultant staff.
- Support of other engagements and/or delivery team members as required.



- Resource Management: Communicate and/or track project team member requirement details as requested.
- Collaborating with recruiters and Sales Account Managers in preparation for new starters joining client teams and issue resolution as needed.
- Performance tracking, management, and reporting as requested.
- Collaboration with cross function teams to onboard/off-board consultant onto Customer and TGS IT systems (Email, MS Teams, SharePoint etc.,)


Requisite Abilities and/or Skills

- Strong oral and written communication skills
- Analysis and problem-solving skills
- Time management and organizational skills
- Personnel and team management skills
- Demonstrable engagement data/ risk analysis and correlation/ mitigation skills
- Excellent customer service and stakeholder management skills


Basic Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree or equivalent
- 10 to 15 years’ IT experience, customer project/engagement delivery exposure, and agile methodologies awareness.
- Experience managing and delivering professional managed services to Customer.
- Greenfield development, Application modernization, Data Modernization
- Experience working with Cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), hosting solutions, offerings, modernization, migration & strategies is a plus
- Understanding of managed services model, risk, accountability, responsibility expectations
- Agile, Project & Engagement Management experience and any training / certifications on Agile, PMI, SAFe, PRINCE2 is a plus.
- AWS Cloud Practitioner, GCP Cloud Digital Leader or Azure Fundamentals certification is a plus.
- Stakeholder management, team leading, organizing, coaching, and Listening skills.
- Understanding of IT environments and able to demonstrate initiative in challenging project situations to provide continual improvement throughout the delivery of services.
- Experience working within Services Integration partner onsite, offshore, nearshore remote teams.


Behavioural Competencies and Responsibilities
Collaborates:

- Works in partnership with internal stakeholders and delivery team to discuss engagement strategy, scope, and overall health of any current engagements.
- Partners with Delivery Managers, Account Managers, Account Directors, Solution Executives and Business Development Managers to manage risk and ensure we are delivering to the terms and conditions of our contract.
- Participates in monthly financial review meetings with Back Office


Communicates Effectively:

- Thoroughly documents all escalation procedures then communicates to necessary audiences, customer, consultant, managers.
- Actively listens to others.
- Clearly articulates the Customer/SoW requirements and relevant supporting delivery processes.
- Proactively contributes to customer/account discussions and attends relevant account meetings.


Instills Trust

- Maintains positive rapport with consultants and customers by following through on commitments in a timely and responsive manner.
- Develops and maintains trust with internal partners by acting on feedback and ensuring engagement success.


Action Orientated

- Identifies concerns, such as sourcing gaps, and quickly communicates these.
- Facilitates issue resolution using root cause analysis and identifies proper parties to communicate to
- Proactively anticipates customer needs, creates solutions and contingency plans to limit issues.
- Advocates for TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) when possible, to support growth opportunities with customers.
- Contributes, collaborates, and drives internal process improvement issues initiatives.

Location: Dublin, Ireland

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week office attendance required

Territory: Global
Reporting to: Technical Team Lead

About Daon

Daon is a global leader in the defence against digital identity fraud and AI-generated synthetic identities. For over a quarter of a century, we have partnered with governments and leading enterprises to deliver secure, seamless identity experiences across financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, travel, and critical infrastructure.

Our TrustX platform enables organisations to orchestrate secure, scalable, cross-channel identity workflows, supporting identity verification, biometric authentication, and lifecycle management across complex environments. More than two billion identities worldwide have been safeguarded by Daon technology.

Recognised as a leading provider by multiple analyst firms including Gartner®, Kuppinger Cole, and Frost & Sullivan®, Daon is at the forefront of shaping the future of identity security.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Java Developer on our TrustX SaaS platform, you will design, build, and improve cloud‑based backend services that power our identity verification and authentication and voice solutions. This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, understands end‑to‑end system flows, and collaborates closely with frontend engineers, architects, DevOps, mobile teams, and QA to deliver reliable, performant, secure software.

We’re looking for strong engineers, not just deep Java specialists. You should be capable of understanding how components interact across the stack, how data flows through the system, and how to make technical decisions that balance performance, scalability, maintainability, and product needs.

You will also be expected to embrace AI‑assisted development, including GitHub Copilot and other modern AI tools, to accelerate coding, improve quality, and help the team work more efficiently.

If you want to contribute to a high‑impact SaaS platform, and you enjoy both building features and shaping technical direction, you’ll thrive here.

What you will do:

Backend Development and Collaboration

Design, develop, and maintain backend services built primarily with Java and Spring Boot.
Implement REST APIs, service integrations, data processing pipelines, and backend logic supporting our core platform capabilities.
Write maintainable, testable, and well‑structured code using modern engineering practices.
Collaborate with frontend, mobile, DevOps, architects, and QA to ensure features are delivered holistically and integrate smoothly across the platform.
Understand how backend components interact with UIs, cloud infrastructure, data stores, and external systems.
Participate in design discussions and provide input on architecture, system behavior, performance trade‑offs, and scaling strategies.
Use GitHub Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.
Help establish best practices for responsible, high‑value AI use within the engineering team.
Participate in experimentation and adoption of new AI‑based development workflows.
Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and automated test scenarios in collaboration with QA.
Profile and optimize services for performance, throughput, and scalability.
Contribute to improving observability (metrics, logs, tracing) in coordination with DevOps.
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
Collaborate with service delivery managers to ensure smooth deployment and production behavior.
Support occasional troubleshooting efforts for complex defects or production issues.

What you have:

5+ years of experience developing backend or full‑stack software, ideally in SaaS environments.
Strong proficiency in Java, with experience in frameworks like Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Hibernate.
Ability to understand end‑to‑end system design, data flows, integration points, and how cloud‑native systems behave in production.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Hands‑on experience with Git, build tools (Maven/Gradle), CI/CD pipelines, and modern development practices.
A mindset focused on learning, growth, and continuous improvement, including adoption of AI‑assisted development tools.
Exposure to observability tools (logs, metrics, traces) and performance debugging.
Strong communication and collaboration skills—comfortable working with cross‑functional teams.
Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent real‑world experience.

Nice to Have:

Background in identity, authentication, biometrics, cryptography, or fraud prevention.
Experience with telephony, voice biometrics, or multi‑channel communications platforms.

What we offer:

Work in the rapidly growing fields of identity verification, authentication, biometrics, telephony, and fraud.
Opportunity to influence and shape the architecture of a major SaaS platform used by global enterprise customers.
Competitive salary and benefits.
A flexible, supportive environment that respects work/life balance.

Join the brightest minds from around the globe as we build the future of digital identity!

Daon is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.

26fd7810b2c8ebb6.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About The Team

The RevOps team owns the systems layer, operations & automation that supports Telnyx's growth engine. Historically, that meant administering 3rd party GTM tools used by humans: CRM, marketing automation, enrichment vendors, routing, campaign workflows, reporting, and vendor integrations.

That operating model is changing. Telnyx is increasingly building AI agents and automation that interact directly with the GTM stack. The systems team now needs to support both human-facing workflows and bot-facing infrastructure: clean data, reliable integrations, durable automations, documented process, and scalable operating patterns.

The Role

Telnyx is building the next generation of its go-to-market operating system: a trusted, automated systems layer where revenue teams and AI agents can work from clean data, clear business rules, and safe workflow surfaces.

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager, GTM Systems & Automation to lead the cross-functional programs that make that operating model real. You will connect business needs to technical execution across RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Data, Product, and Engineering. You will establish the roadmap, requirements, milestones, dependencies, decisions, controls, and adoption plans required to move complex systems work from ambiguity to durable outcomes.

This is a technical, hands-on program leadership role - not a ticket-queue administrator and not a traditional product management position. You will understand the systems deeply enough to challenge assumptions, debug workflows, define safe operating patterns, and partner credibly with engineers while remaining accountable for end-to-end program delivery.

What You'll Do



- Lead complex GTM systems, workflow-engineering, and automation programs from discovery and current-state mapping through design, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
- Translate revenue workflows and user pain points into implementation-ready technical requirements, including system logic, data flows, integrations, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and measurable success criteria.
- Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap across CRM architecture, lead and account routing, enrichment, lifecycle automation, attribution, handoffs, service-order workflows, reporting dependencies, and AI-agent readiness.
- Create operating mechanisms that keep technical programs moving: intake and prioritization, decision forums, status reporting, risk escalation, change control, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
- Coordinate technical and business workstreams across RevOps, Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Security, and external vendors.
- Lead critical systems migrations and workflow redesigns with explicit cutover plans, data validation, business continuity, rollback paths, training, adoption measures, and support models.
- Define safe patterns for AI agents operating in GTM systems, including context, tools, permissions, approval gates, observability, auditability, exception handling, and human escalation.
- Make agentic execution your default operating mode, using AI agents to accelerate system discovery, technical requirements, prototyping, validation, documentation, QA, and implementation while helping shape GTM systems that are easier for both humans and agents to operate.
- Identify where manual work, vendor glue, or unclear ownership should become durable automation, owned system logic, internal tooling, or an agent-assisted workflow.
- Ensure every launch has documented business rules, system ownership, monitoring, support paths, downstream reporting impacts, and measurable operational outcomes.
- Manage vendor and tooling dependencies where they affect architecture, extensibility, reliability, security, cost, implementation timing, or roadmap decisions.

What You'll Bring



- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, GTM systems, revenue operations, business systems, GTM engineering, or a closely related technical operations discipline.
- A track record leading cross-functional systems programs with multiple business stakeholders and engineering or data teams.
- Strong hands-on fluency with Salesforce or HubSpot and a practical understanding of CRM data models, automation architecture, integrations, permissions, and reporting dependencies.
- Experience leading high-impact software migrations or workflow transformations involving critical end-user processes, data integrity, and minimal operational disruption.
- Ability to reason about APIs, webhooks, event and data flows, system integrations, automation tools, technical documentation, and implementation tradeoffs.
- Experience identifying and resolving integration failures, field-sync issues, routing errors, broken handoffs, data-quality problems, and workflow edge cases.
- Ability to go deeper than roadmap creation: you can reason through system architecture, data models, automation logic, edge cases, and what needs to be custom-built versus bought or configured.
- Strong program judgment: the ability to turn ambiguity into structure, make tradeoffs visible, drive decisions, and hold teams accountable without relying on formal authority.
- Clear written and verbal communication with executives, operators, analysts, administrators, and engineers.
- Comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment where the system, process, and ownership model may all be evolving.

Especially Valuable



- Experience designing systems where LLMs or agents are first-class users, including permissions, memory or context, human approval points, observability, and failure modes.
- Working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript, or lightweight scripting for analysis, prototyping, validation, debugging, or automation.
- Experience with marketing automation, sales engagement, enrichment, routing, customer-success, finance, or workflow-orchestration platforms.
- Experience in API-first SaaS, communications infrastructure, usage-based businesses, or technically complex B2B environments.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will:



- Build a current-state technical map of Telnyx’s GTM systems, including ownership, integrations, data flows, automations, dependencies, failure modes, active initiatives, and unresolved decision gaps.
- Establish a prioritized roadmap for the highest-leverage CRM, automation, data-quality, workflow-engineering, and AI-agent-readiness opportunities.
- Deliver implementation-ready requirements for priority initiatives, including system design, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, success metrics, launch criteria, adoption needs, rollback paths, and operational support models.
- Ship or directly drive measurable improvement in at least one high-friction workflow, such as routing, handoffs, CRM data quality, service orders, reporting, enrichment, lifecycle automation, or agent-assisted work.
- Use AI and automation in your own operating model to accelerate discovery, documentation, analysis, QA, stakeholder updates, and program execution.

Over Time, Success Means



- Telnyx has a clear product roadmap for its AI-native GTM operating system
- CRM, workflow, and automation investments are driven by user needs, business impact, and system scalability
- High-friction GTM workflows are continuously improved, shipped, measured, and iterated
- Repeated manual work becomes owned system logic, durable automation, or agent-assisted workflow
- Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and Engineering operate from cleaner data, clearer ownership, and more reliable systems
- Engineers spend less time on reactive GTM systems issues because requirements, ownership, and operating paths are clearer
- AI agents and automation can depend on clean data, safe integrations, clear permissions, reliable workflow rules, and well-defined approval boundaries
- Revenue teams spend less time maintaining systems and more time acting on trusted customer intelligence

Why This Role Matters

Telnyx is building the next version of its GTM operating system: one where revenue teams and AI agents can work from trusted data, clear workflows, and safe automation surfaces. This role owns the product direction for that future. You will help turn fragmented GTM processes into durable systems, reduce manual work, and build the foundation for a more intelligent, automated, and scalable revenue engine.

How We Work

We value ownership, technical curiosity, direct communication, and measurable outcomes. The strongest candidates are equally comfortable facilitating a cross-functional decision, reviewing a system design, tracing a broken workflow, documenting a launch plan, and ensuring that a change is adopted after it ships.

About Holafly

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we've empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure, reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 600+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to ensure our users stay connected from the second they land - wherever their journey takes them.

We're not just selling eSIMs. We're building the infrastructure of trust and experience that turns first-time buyers into lifelong travellers.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Experience Officer (CCXO), you'll be their strategic right hand - translating vision into execution and driving the highest-priority challenges across CX and Operations to measurable impact.

This isn't a coordination role. You'll own problems end-to-end: diagnosing them with data, building the case for change, orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver, and communicating progress to leadership with clarity and conviction.

Think of it as the best parts of management consulting - sharp thinking, high-stakes problems, real variety - with the added dimension of genuine ownership and long-term impact. This role starts as an individual contributor and is built to grow: as you prove impact, there's a clear path to owning a broader mandate, potentially including people leadership, as Holafly scales.

What You'll Do

Drive Strategic Initiatives Own end-to-end execution of the CCXO's highest-priority projects - from initial scoping and stakeholder alignment through to measurable delivery. You step in where leadership presence is required but bandwidth is limited.

Build the Business Case Architect data-backed frameworks, ROI models, and investment proposals that justify and prioritise operational and commercial decisions. Your work gives leadership the confidence to move fast.

Work Independently with Data Use SQL and financial modelling to validate hypotheses, diagnose friction points, and track the success of transformation initiatives - without waiting for someone else to run the numbers.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Delivery Manage by influence across Product, Tech, Marketing, and Ops. You know how to get teams aligned and moving without formal authority.

Communicate with Impact Turn complex, ambiguous problems into crisp executive narratives. Whether it's a board update, a strategic proposal, or a post-mortem, your decks and written communications set the standard.

Fix What's Broken Deep-dive into underperforming processes and redesign them for global scale. You're comfortable getting into the operational weeds when the situation calls for it.

What We're Looking For



- 5-7 years of experience, with a strong foundation in one or more of: top-tier management consulting (MBB), an internal strategy or transformation function at a high-growth scale-up, or a senior operations/chief of staff role with demonstrable P&L or delivery accountability
- Analytical rigour: advanced SQL proficiency and comfort building analytical models from scratch. You don't wait for a report - you build it, and draw the insight yourself
- Storytelling & communication: exceptional ability to craft compelling executive presentations and written narratives. You can take a messy, multi-stakeholder problem and distil it into a clear recommendation a board can act on
- Execution track record: a demonstrable history of taking projects from ambiguous brief to measurable impact in fast-moving environments. You're as comfortable in a spreadsheet as you are in a steering committee
- AI fluency & advocacy: you don't just follow AI trends - you know how to apply them. You're comfortable identifying where AI tools (generative, agentic, or analytical) can replace manual effort, improve customer outcomes, or unlock operational leverage. Critically, you can build the case for AI adoption and bring non-technical stakeholders along with you

Bonus Points



- Experience in digital transformation, product-led growth, or travel-tech environments
- Hands-on experience leveraging AI to transform contact centre operations
- Fluency in Spanish
- Exposure to customer experience operations or CX metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES, churn)

Compensation & Benefits



- Salary: Competitive, benchmarked to your experience and the market
- Remote-First: 100% remote with full flexibility and a high-trust ownership culture
- Leadership Access: Direct exposure to C-suite decision-making on the most critical challenges in the business
- Growth Trajectory: As Holafly scales, this role is built to grow with you, with a natural path toward owning a line function or domain leadership position
- Impact: You will work on problems that directly shape the experience of millions of travellers worldwide

Holafly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Do you enjoy bringing people, technology and strategy together to deliver meaningful outcomes? Are you excited by projects that shape how technology is developed within a global organisation? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

At Arm, we create technology that powers billions of devices around the world. Behind every innovation are teams working together to develop and deliver hardware and software across a wide range of products.

Working across architecture, RTL development, verification, software, FPGA implementation, emulation, validation and operations teams, you will be accountable for planning, execution and successful project delivery within a dynamic, fast-paced engineering environment.

- Build and maintain project plans, schedules, turning points and dependencies.
- Manage project scope, requirements, risks and changes throughout the project lifecycle.
- Work with architecture, RTL, verification, software, FPGA and validation teams to keep projects on track.
- Lead project evaluations, track progress and provide clear status updates to engineering and leadership.
- Identify issues early and drive them through to resolution.
- Manage competing priorities while balancing technical, schedule and business needs.
- Support software development and first silicon bring-up by delivering high-quality FPGA and Emulation platforms.
- Capture lessons learned and help improve project management practices across the organisation.

Required Skills And Experience

We’re interested in people who can connect strategy with delivery, bring different groups together and help others succeed. Relevant experience may include:



- Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- Experience managing complex technical projects in semiconductor or hardware development.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence across engineering teams.

“Nice To Have” Skills And Experience

We value thoughtful leaders who remain calm when priorities change, use evidence to guide decisions and make complicated challenges easier to understand. A collaborative approach, commercial awareness and an interest in helping people grow will support success in this role.

Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.

Equal Opportunities at Arm

We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Backend teams at Trainline👋

The Backend teams at Trainline build the core of Trainline’s world class product. We create the journey search functionality that millions of our customers use on a daily basis, the eCommerce platform that provides a secure and seamless experience and we connect Trainline to over 270 travel operating companies, across 45 countries in Europe and the rest of the world. Each team has a targeted domain focus, ranging between journey search, fares calculation, bookings, fulfilment, payments, refunds, carriers’ integrations, real-time timetable information, journey disruptions and much more.



As a senior level .NET Engineer at Trainline you will...🚄

 - Deliver new functionality or features, using the most appropriate tools & techniques

 - Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do

Lazer is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more. With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products from $0 to $200M in revenue.

Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.

We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!

Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with enterprise brands to design and implement complex storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From platform migrations to ERP and OMS workflows, our team brings deep expertise in Shopify Plus, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure -- helping clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.

Job Summary

Lazer is seeking an experienced Delivery Manager to lead the development of enterprise eCommerce platforms on Shopify. In this role, you will own the client relationship, manage budgets, and oversee the entire project lifecycle from strategy to execution. Acting as the primary liaison between enterprise clients and Lazer’s internal teams, you’ll ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards.

You will drive the strategic direction of projects, manage competing priorities, and foster collaboration across cross-functional teams. Your expertise in eCommerce, particularly Shopify, coupled with your project and product management skills, will empower you to lead complex platform migrations and deliver innovative solutions for enterprise clients.

The Role



- Client Relationship Management:

- Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, owning the client relationship and ensuring satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives to align project deliverables with business objectives.
- Act as the client's trusted advisor, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth and innovation.
- Project Management:

- Oversee end-to-end project delivery for Shopify-based eCommerce platforms, including migrations and custom implementations.
- Create and manage comprehensive project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and milestones.
- Ensure project objectives align with client business drivers and are delivered on time and within budget.
- Monitor and manage dependencies, risks, and issues, providing regular updates to stakeholders.
- Product Ownership:

- Define and prioritize product roadmaps, requirements, and user stories in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
- Work closely with developers, designers, and QA engineers to ensure the successful implementation of features and functionalities.
- Triage and manage defects, ensuring high-quality deliverables and securing QA sign-off.
- Collaboration and Governance:

- Facilitate communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams, third-party vendors, and clients.
- Provide regular governance updates, including status reports, budget tracking, and resource utilization.
- Supervise third-party solutions to ensure successful integration and alignment with project goals.
Requirements



- Professional Experience:

- Proven experience as a Delivery Manager, Product Owner, Digital Project Manager, or similar role, with a focus on eCommerce and retail.
- Extensive knowledge of Shopify Plus and its ecosystem, including platform migrations, custom development, and integrations.
- Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex project portfolios.
- Client Engagement Skills:

- Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives.
- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Project Management Expertise:

- Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including experience with Scrum or Kanban frameworks.
- Proven track record of delivering large-scale eCommerce solutions on time and within budget.
- Expertise in creating and managing project plans, tracking dependencies, and mitigating risks.
- Leadership and Collaboration:

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and align cross-functional teams.
- Demonstrable ability to resolve disputes, overcome challenges, and maintain a positive attitude in high-pressure situations.
- Required Qualifications:

- Experience in managing platform migrations from systems like Magento, Salesforce, or BigCommerce to Shopify Plus.
- Familiarity with ERP, OMS, and CMS integrations (e.g., NetSuite, Sanity, or Manhattan).
- Shopify certifications are a plus.
AI in our hiring process

We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.

Why Work With Us



- 🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast.
- 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.
- 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.
- 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.

Why This Might Not Be For You



- 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.
- 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.
- 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.
- 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.

Benefits & Perks



- 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!
- 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.
- 🩺 Employee Care: We provide full benefits (healthcare, dental, vision) for our employees (401k for our US employees)
- 🏖️ Unlimited PTO: Everyone needs a break. Take at least 15 days off a year, and more if you need—just be cool about it and keep the team in mind.
- 🎉 Regular Team Retreat: Join us for a week of team bonding at amazing destinations. Recent trips include the Dominican Republic, Cancun, and Hawaii — plus ones welcome.

Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote, United Kingdom only.
Salary Range: £90,000 - £105,000 + stock options.

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Senior Product Manager, you will take ownership of how data is processed at Focal, and shape what that path becomes: from the imports that bring a retailer's planograms, inventory and store metadata into our platform, through the pipelines that turn them into signal, to the metrics and reports their head office acts on. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

What We Are Looking For

You are a peer to the engineers you work with, someone who understands the systems well enough to know what is expensive and why and when to push back
You are drawn to the seams between teams, where ownership is shared and the hardest problems live
You write your own queries and interrogate the answers before anyone else has to, and you can name the business number a data product of yours moved
You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did
You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place
You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once
You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want
You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable

What You Will Do

Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer's data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other
Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs
Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on
Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product
Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer
Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team

What You Need to Be Successful

5+ years in product management, including real time on a technically deep product where you owned integrations, data, or both
Enough technical depth to reason about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion
Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same data: a store manager, a regional director and a head of supply chain reading one dataset three ways, served by one configurable surface
Hands-on comfort with SQL and the ability to answer your own data questions
Fluency in the analytics and BI tooling landscape, and a view on what makes a dashboard worth returning to rather than merely correct
Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from problem definition through to something shipped and adopted
A track record of getting things done across teams, and the communication to influence engineering and commercial partners
Experience working directly with enterprise customers, including holding a position they disagree with
Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team
Willingness to travel occasionally for store and customer visits

What Would Set You Apart

Experience in working with high-volume, noisy sensor or computer-vision data
Experience with change data capture into a cloud warehouse (ideally Snowflake)
Experience shipping AI-powered features, including the call on when a model is good enough to ship

Why Focal Systems

Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that's truly making a difference in the retail world. Here's why you should consider us:

Strong Values and Mission: We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
Exceptional Team: We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
Outstanding Partners: We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavours.

What we offer

We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
Generous Paid Time Off
Pension
Sick Leave
Parental Leave
Learning and Development Budget

About Kinaxis:

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

About the team:

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland

About the team

As a Premier Support Manager (PSM), you will be part of the Kinaxis Premier Support Team delivering post-sales support services to strategic enterprise customers.

In addition to coordinating support activities, the PSM proactively monitors customer environment health, reviews operational trends and highlights observations, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. By combining data analysis, customer engagement and knowledge of Kinaxis best practices, the PSM helps customers better understand their environment and make informed decisions.

If you want to be part of a team that challenges you, moves fast, improves constantly, and makes a difference, let’s talk.

About the role:

What you will do

Lead regular service reviews, support case reviews, and operational discussions to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and outcomes.
Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and serve as an advocate for customer needs within Kinaxis.

Monitor customer environment health using Kinaxis reporting, monitoring and analytics tools.
Analyze trends in system usage, performance, support activity, and operational metrics to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improvement.

Maintain awareness of customer deployments, significant business events and operational changes that may impact system performance or support requirements.

Experience managing strategic enterprise customers and building relationships across multiple stakeholder levels.
Ability to work independently, while collaborating effectively across multiple business functions.
Experience managing high-priority issues, customer escalations, and complex support situations.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify patterns, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Experience leveraging monitoring, reporting, analytics, or dashboarding tools to evaluate system performance and customer health.
Demonstrates curiosity and a proactive approach to uncovering risks, investigating anomalies, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

#Senior #LI-CS1
