At Perrigo, we are driven by our mission to Makes Lives Better Through Trusted Health and Wellness Solutions, Accessible to All. We are proud to be a Top 10 player in the European Consumer Self-Care market and the largest U.S. store brand provider of over the counter and infant formula. Dedicated to providing The Best Self-Care for Everyone, we are the people behind the brands you trust. We are Opill®, Compeed®, Solpadeine®, NiQuitin®, and many more. We Are Perrigo. We are committed to enhancing the wellbeing of our colleagues and consumers alike. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture where each person can experience a sense of belonging.

Join us on our One Perrigo journey as we evolve to win in self-care.

Description Overview

We are excited to recruit an Associate Professional, Regulatory Affairs within our Medical Device Lifecycle Management team. In this role,you will play an important role in supporting Perrigo's medical device portfolio throughout the product lifecycle. You will contribute to regulatory activities that help maintain ongoing conformity, technical documentation compliance, product availability and market access across multiple regions and markets.

You will support lifecycle management activities including technical documentation updates, change assessments, regulatory notifications, registrations/listings and maintenance of regulatory records in accordance with applicable medical device requirements, approved procedures and business priorities. Working alongside experienced regulatory professionals, you will help ensure documentation remains current, traceable and inspection-ready, and that regulatory deliverables are completed to agreed timelines.

You will manage a range of defined regulatory activities and support change control, product maintenance, labelling updates, technical file remediation and ongoing compliance obligations. You will help identify potential regulatory issues, support risk mitigation activities and contribute to the successful delivery of medical device lifecycle objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Quality, Safety, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, R&D, Packaging/Artwork, you will provide regulatory support for product and process changes and assist in translating medical device regulatory requirements into practical actions that support compliance and business needs.

You will contribute to the continuous improvement of Medical Device Regulatory Affairs processes, systems and ways of working, helping to improve efficiency, consistency, data quality and inspection readiness across lifecycle activities. Through your role, you will build regulatory expertise in medical devices while supporting Perrigo's commitment to maintaining high standards of compliance, consumer safety and product quality.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop a strong foundation in Medical Device Regulatory Affairs, gain experience across the product lifecycle and build both technical and professional capabilities within a dynamic global environment.

Scope of the Role
Supports ongoing conformity and compliance of medical device products through defined lifecycle regulatory activities across assigned products and markets.
Delivers routine to moderately complex lifecycle changes, technical documentation updates, regulatory notifications and registration/listing maintenance activities with increasing independence, ensuring compliant and timely execution.
Builds practical expertise across medical device classifications, markets, regulatory pathways and ways of working while remaining agile to shifting business priorities.
Focused on executional aspects of medical device lifecycle regulatory work and owns defined deliverables under guidance.
Assesses and supports routine to moderately complex product, process, labelling and supplier-related changes; prepares and maintains technical documentation, regulatory records, registrations/listings, notifications and conformity-related documentation.
Works with guidance and review, contributes within project teams, and has impact on defined products, markets, or deliverables.

Lifecycle Compliance & Document Management

Support the accuracy and compliance of medical device registrations, listings and regulatory records for assigned products and markets.
Prepare and update technical documentation, technical files and supporting regulatory records with senior review and according to Good Documentation Practice.
Support labelling, Instructions for Use, packaging and artwork reviews to ensure alignment with approved claims, device requirements and market-specific obligations.
Support regulatory notifications, registrations/listings and maintenance trackers to ensure lifecycle status and compliance obligations remain visible and current.

Lifecycle Changes and Regulatory Deliverables

Assess and support routine to moderately complex medical device lifecycle changes under guidance, gathering data and updating technical documentation and regulatory records.
Draft components for regulatory notifications, registration/listing updates, technical documentation updates and authority or notified body responses; support timeline tracking and follow-up.
Recommend options for routine change impact assessment, regulatory pathway or documentation approach within delegated scope and escalate uncertainty or higher-risk topics.
Support implementation tracking following regulatory clearance, notification, listing update or approved documentation change to help avoid compliance gaps and supply disruption.

Risk, Intelligence & Cross-Functional Delivery

Draft responses to health authority, competent authority or notified body queries and support document reviews under guidance.
Support regulatory intelligence impact assessments for medical device requirements and inform stakeholders as directed.
Support audits, inspections, CAPA documentation and follow-up under supervision.
Partner with Quality, Safety, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Packaging/Artwork, Regulatory Operations and local or cluster Regulatory Affairs teams to implement approved changes and maintain ongoing conformity and market compliance.
Experience Required
Typically 2–4 years in Medical Device Regulatory Affairs, Quality, technical documentation or a related regulatory field; scientific, engineering or technical degree preferred.
Ability to participate effectively in cross-functional project teams and manage defined deliverables with accuracy and discipline.
Practical capability in technical documentation preparation, regulatory record maintenance, timeline tracking and structured issue escalation.

Benefits
We believe our people are our greatest asset. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits tailored to supporting you and your family, as well as career development opportunities to ensure you feel valued and supported, both professionally and personally.

Find out more about Total Rewards at Perrigo.

Hybrid Working Approach
We love our offices and the setting they provide for in-person collaboration and celebration. But we also appreciate the opportunity to work remotely can energise you too, so we promote flexibility with the ability to work two days a week from home in many roles.

We are proud to be included in the Forbes list of "America's Best Employers by State 2024". Find out more here

(The SAVE button will only save your profile information but not submit an application for this open position.) All application materials, including resumes and CVs, must be submitted in English. Thank you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or other characteristics protected by law. #weareperrigo

Capri Medical is a multi-award winning startup. We were ranked second in Europe's flagship Innovation Award, the EIC program, which funds Europe's most promising startups. We're looking for talented individuals who thrive in a culture of innovation and empowerment and who are active learners and have a positive attitude. By doing so, we will continue to set new standards in healthcare.


The Role


As Technical Project Manager you will own the planning, coordination and delivery across our implantable device project portfolio, with a particular emphasis on the engineering workstreams. You will be the connective tissue between electronics, mechanical, software, quality and clinical teams as well as external design partners, foundries and contract manufacturers. This is a delivery role for someone who is equally comfortable running a schedule and a risk register as they are reading a schematic or a mechanical drawing and asking the right questions of the engineers who produced it.


Key Responsibilities
Programme planning & delivery

- Own end-to-end project plans for electronics-led development programmes including schedule, resourcing, budget and critical path, and drive them to agreed milestones.
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across electronics, mechanical, firmware/software, quality and clinical, keeping dependencies visible and interfaces well defined.
- Run the cadence of stand-ups, phase gates and steering updates, and maintain a single source of truth for status, actions and decisions.
- Coordinate build and test activities and tracking hardware revisions.


Risk, suppliers & stakeholders

- Maintain risk and issue registers, drive mitigations early, and give leadership a clear, honest read on programme health.
- Manage external partners (e.g. contract manufacturers and test labs, including statements of work, deliverables and timelines).
- Communicate to stakeholders at every level, from bench engineers to executives, tailoring detail to the audience.
- Support development within our quality framework


What You'll Bring
Essential

- 8+ years' experience delivering complex electronic or mechanical engineering hardware product development, including a strong track record of project management.
- A degree in electronic, electrical or mechanical engineering (or a closely related discipline), with genuine technical depth.
- Strong electronics grounding. You are comfortable across PCBA, embedded systems, or other active-device electronics.
- Demonstrated ability to run a full development lifecycle from concept through verification and transfer to manufacture, on time and to budget.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills with fluency in project tooling (e.g. Confluence, Jira, or equivalent) and structured risk management.
- Experience in a regulated, hardware-intensive industry such as medical devices, aerospace, automotive, semiconductor or similar.
- Clear, credible communication. You are able to hold the confidence of senior engineers and executives alike.


Desirable

- Experience with active implantable medical devices, wearables or other miniaturised, power-constrained electronics.
- Familiarity with medical device development within an ISO 13485 quality system and design-control ways of working.
- A recognised project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2, APM or equivalent).
- Experience taking a product from clinical-stage prototype toward commercialisation.


Why Join Capri Medical?

- Be part of a pioneering MedTech company at the forefront of BioElectronics innovation
- Join at a pivotal growth stage with the opportunity to shape processes and systems from the ground up
- Work alongside a passionate, multi-award winning team making a tangible impact on global healthcare
- Enjoy a collaborative, empowering culture that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning


Capri Medical is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

DESCRIPTION

In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. The rest of the supply chain looks to us to clear strategic problems and "enable" them to focus on execution. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
- Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
- Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
- Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
- Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life
You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

About the team
Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. We build bridges with both internal and external customers across those different disciplines to find the right balance between them.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working with large, complex data sets

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Company Description

 
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
 
 
Job Description

 
Help Engineering Teams Work Smarter, Plan Better, and Deliver Faster

Do you enjoy turning complex delivery data into meaningful insights?

Love improving how teams plan, prioritize, and execute work?

Get excited about dashboards, workflows, metrics, tooling, and helping organizations operate more effectively at scale?

We’re looking for a Technology Analyst – PMO to help evolve how Engineering plans, tracks, measures, and delivers work across a fast-moving SaaS engineering organization.

This is not a traditional “status reporting PMO” role.

You’ll operate at the intersection of:


- Engineering delivery
- Operational analytics
- Planning strategy
- Tool optimization
- Process improvement
- Executive reporting

You’ll partner directly with Engineering and Product leaders to improve visibility, streamline workflows, define meaningful metrics, and help create scalable ways of working that support high-performing teams.

If you enjoy combining data, systems thinking, and operational problem solving — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Be Working On

Planning & Delivery Analysis

You’ll help Engineering leaders answer questions like:


- Are teams realistically aligned to delivery goals?
- Where are delivery risks emerging?
- What dependencies could impact execution?
- How predictable is delivery performance?
- Where are bottlenecks slowing teams down?

You’ll support quarterly and annual planning processes by:


- Analyzing demand, capacity, and delivery forecasts
- Supporting prioritization discussions
- Identifying portfolio-level risks and dependencies
- Providing delivery insights that improve decision-making

Delivery Metrics & Operational Intelligence

You’ll help define how Engineering measures effectiveness and delivery health.

You’ll work on:


- Throughput and predictability metrics
- Delivery health reporting
- Cycle time and flow analysis
- Portfolio dashboards
- Executive reporting and operational storytelling

Most importantly, you’ll turn operational data into insights leaders can actually use.

Improve Engineering Tooling & Data Quality

We rely heavily on the Atlassian ecosystem and related delivery tooling to support Engineering operations and planning.

You’ll help:


- Improve Jira and Confluence workflows
- Standardize data structures and reporting models
- Improve dashboard consistency and visibility
- Support governance and documentation practices
- Align tooling with how Engineering teams actually work

You’ll partner closely with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to reduce friction and improve operational clarity.

Drive Continuous Improvement

This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks:

“There has to be a better way to do this.”

You’ll identify opportunities to improve:


- Work intake processes
- Planning cadences
- Reporting practices
- Portfolio governance
- Delivery visibility
 
 
Qualifications

 
What You’ll Bring

Experience In Areas Like:


- PMO or Portfolio Operations
- Engineering Operations
- Technical Program Support
- Delivery Analytics
- Agile Planning & Reporting
- SaaS or software engineering environments

Familiarity With Tools Like:


- Jira
- Jira Product Discovery
- Confluence
- Jellyfish
- CI/CD and DevOps tooling
- Google Workspace

Additional Skills We’d Love


- Data analysis and visualization
- Dashboard development
- Executive presentation development
- Workflow/process optimization
- Cross-functional facilitation
- Portfolio and roadmap reporting

No specific degree required — we value practical experience, analytical thinking, curiosity, and the ability to improve how organizations operate.

The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here

Accountability

You take ownership, follow through, and help teams stay aligned on outcomes.

Resourcefulness

You find solutions, simplify complexity, and improve how work gets done — even when constraints exist.

Collaboration & Influence

You communicate clearly, build relationships easily, and can align teams without relying on authority.

Change Leadership

You’re comfortable helping teams evolve processes, tools, and ways of working in dynamic environments.

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is an opportunity to help shape how Engineering planning and operational governance evolves in a modern SaaS organization.

You’ll work directly with Engineering leadership, influence strategic planning conversations, improve operational visibility at scale, and help create smarter, more data-driven ways of working across the organization.

You won’t just track delivery — you’ll help improve it.

If This Sounds Like You…

If you enjoy combining analytics, systems thinking, tooling, and operational improvement to help Engineering organizations perform at their best — we’d love to talk to you.
 
 
Additional Information

 
Total Rewards @ Turnitin

At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.



Our Values underpin everything we do.


- Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
- Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
- Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
- Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
- One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
- Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits


- Remote First Culture
- Health Care Coverage*
- Education Reimbursement*
- Competitive Paid Time Off 
- Self-Care Days
- National Holidays*
- 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
- Paid Volunteer Time*
- Charitable contribution match*
- Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/*
- Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
- Parental Leave*
- Retirement Plan with match/contribution*

* varies by country

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad

At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Role Description

Wiz is looking for a Security Engineer for Product & Production Infrastructure who has experience performing security reviews, vulnerability management, and detection and response operations in cloud-native environments. You’ll get to collaborate with our software development and DevOps teams to secure Wiz’s products, CI/CD infrastructure, and production infrastructure. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence our product roadmap by utilizing Wiz-for-Wiz to assess, monitor, and harden our environments.

Responsibilities

Lead threat modeling and security reviews across Wiz's products and cloud infrastructure, identifying attack surfaces and developing scalable mitigation strategies.

Build automation, policy-as-code, and security tooling that enables development teams to "shift left" and integrate end-to-end security into their workflows.

Design and implement secure baselines for cloud resources and Kubernetes based infrastructure.

Drive vulnerability management and remediation efforts – prioritizing issues, implementing mitigations, and designing strategic preventative controls in software supply chains from development through production.

Extend our detection and response capabilities – building scalable solutions to identify malicious activity, triage alerts, and investigate and remediate incidents.

Build deep functional partnerships with Wiz's engineering and operations teams – helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

Minimum qualifications

7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations work in cloud environments.

Experience with AWS cloud security (or equivalent experience in Azure and GCP with some level of AWS experience).

Experience with cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and container security principles.

Experience securing IAM and cloud identities at scale.

Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, conducting threat modeling exercises, and translating findings into actionable security controls.

Practical understanding of web application security concepts (such as OWASP Top-10 and similar).

Hands-on experience with IaC and related tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Pulumi).

Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego.

Preferred qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, and/or equivalent job experience in lieu of a degree.

Experience working with remote, globally distributed teams.

Experience working in organizations that develop software and/or operate managed infrastructure and technology services for their own customers.

Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, or CIEM solutions.

Position Summary:

Developers are building the future of infrastructure, and Bentley wants to make sure they have every reason to build it with us. As our Developer Community Programs Manager, you will own the strategy and execution of Bentley's developer programs portfolio: hackathons, Developer Days, technical workshops, API and SDK experiences, build challenges, and peer-learning events. This is a role for someone who understands developers not as an audience to be marketed to, but as a community to be genuinely invested in.

Working cross-functionally between Corporate Marketing, Developer Relations, Product, and Partner teams, you will serve as the connective tissue that ensures Bentley's developer initiatives are coordinated, visible, and building toward something larger than the sum of their parts. You will establish the playbooks, partnerships, and program models that allow Bentley's developer engagement to scale across products, regions, and communities.

If you are energized by the intersection of technical credibility and creative program design, and you thrive where your work connects directly to platform strategy and business growth, this is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful at a company redefining what engineering software can do for the world.

Responsibilities:

Develop and scale programs such as hackathons, Developer Days, technical webinars, API and SDK workshops, live demonstrations, build challenges, office hours, and peer-learning experiences.

Serve as the go-to point within Corporate Marketing for developer-focused initiatives, helping connect the work happening across Bentley and ensuring programs are coordinated, visible, and aligned.

Work cross-functionally with Product, Developer Relations, technical subject matter experts, Events, Partner Marketing, and other stakeholders who share the goal of reaching and engaging more developers.

Translate Bentley’s broader developer strategy into compelling programs and experiences that help developers understand what they can build, extend, or enable with Bentley technology.

Identify opportunities for Bentley to participate in or partner with external developer communities, industry groups, universities, technology partners, open-source communities, and other relevant organizations.

Build and manage relationships with developer community partners, event organizers, technical advocates, influencers, and ecosystem leaders who can help Bentley reach new audiences.

Partner with internal and external experts to shape program content, including technical sessions, demonstrations, tutorials, challenges, use cases, and developer learning journeys.

Create clear pathways for program participants to continue engaging with Bentley through community spaces, technical resources, future events, partner opportunities, and ongoing learning.

Work with Community Platform and Community Experience teams to ensure developer audiences are welcomed into Bentley’s broader community and can easily discover relevant programs, resources, and conversations.

Capture feedback and insights from developer programs and share them with Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, and other relevant teams to inform future experiences, resources, and platform priorities.

Establish repeatable program models, playbooks, and operating processes that enable developer initiatives to scale across products, regions, industries, and audiences.

Track participation, engagement, conversion, feedback, partner contribution, and program outcomes to measure the reach and impact of Bentley’s developer programs.

This is an individual contributor role.

Occasional travel required.

Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer (or any other physical requirements).

Qualifications:

5-7 years of experience in developer programs, developer relations, technical community building, ecosystem marketing, technical product marketing, partner programs, or related roles.

Demonstrated experience developing or managing developer-focused experiences such as hackathons, Developer Days, workshops, webinars, build challenges, technical events, or learning programs.

Strong technical acumen, with the ability to understand and communicate concepts related to APIs, SDKs, developer tools, technical platforms, and developer workflows.

Credibility with developer and technical audiences, with the ability to understand their needs and create experiences that are useful, relevant, and engaging.

Strong program management skills, including the ability to move from strategy into execution and coordinate multiple programs, stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Community, Events, Partnerships, and external organizations.

Experience developing partnerships with developer communities, technology organizations, universities, event organizers, or ecosystem partners.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders and clearly articulate program goals and opportunities.

Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating across a distributed organization where ownership and activity may sit across several teams.

Experience with GitHub, developer portals, community platforms, technical events, open-source ecosystems, or developer-focused communications is preferred.

What Success Looks Like:

Bentley has a clear and coordinated portfolio of developer programs that supports its broader developer and platform strategy.

Hackathons, Developer Days, webinars, workshops, and other developer experiences become repeatable, scalable, and connected rather than operating as one-off activities.

Corporate Marketing has a clear point of contact who understands the developer landscape across Bentley and can bring the right internal stakeholders together around shared opportunities.

Bentley reaches and engages more developers through a combination of owned programs, external partnerships, and participation in relevant technical communities.

Developers have more opportunities to learn about Bentley technology, experiment with its capabilities, build meaningful solutions, and connect with Bentley experts and peers.

Developer programs create sustained engagement by giving participants clear next steps into Bentley’s community, resources, programs, and ecosystem.

Bentley develops stronger relationships with developer advocates, technical partners, universities, community leaders, and organizations that can extend its reach and credibility.

Internal teams gain greater visibility into developer activity, audience needs, program performance, and opportunities for future collaboration.

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.

An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start.

An attractive salary and benefits package.

A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.

A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

* Keep spaces organised and help the day run smoothly and on time
* Follow safeguarding, health and safety and incident-reporting procedures
* Raise any welfare or safety concern immediately with the Lead Coach or Venue Manager
* Contribute energy, ideas and a helpful attitude to the wider camp team

*ABOUT YOU*

You will be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy working with children and can build positive relationships with them
* Are enthusiastic, patient, approachable and attentive
* Are reliable, punctual and willing to take direction
* Can work actively throughout the day, indoors and outdoors
* Understand the importance of safeguarding, professional boundaries and following procedures
* Work well in a team and are happy to help wherever needed
* Can attend the required paid weekend training session
* Have the right to work in the UK

Previous experience with children through coaching, childcare, schools, clubs, volunteering or family activities is helpful but not essential.

Relevant qualifications and paediatric first aid are preferred but not required, as induction and guidance will be provided.

*WHAT WE OFFER*

* Competitive pay of £10.85 to £13.00 per hour, inclusive of rolled-up holiday pay
* Paid pre-camp weekend training

* The opportunity to develop confidence in activity delivery and group management

Rising Stars Activities is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.

Applicants must hold an appropriate Enhanced DBS or be willing to complete a new check before starting work.

*TO APPLY*

Please submit your CV and a short supporting statement explaining why you would enjoy working at the camp and any experience you have with children.

*Please clearly state whether you are available for all 10 weekdays or one complete week of the camp and confirm that you can attend the paid weekend training session.*

Rising Stars Activities is an equal-opportunities employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

Job description:


 
 
DSA Product Owner
 
Glanbia Enterprise Solutions
 
 
Role Overview
 
The DSA Product Owner is the technical specialist owning the DSA application, acting as the key bridge between the Business and IT by capturing and translating Business needs into detailed requirements and technology-enabled use cases. They develop a deep understanding of the opportunities, risks, and issues facing the Business, and advise on how technology solutions can be used to achieve / resolve them with a key focus on the Product Experience Management ecosystem.
 
This permanent opportunity reports to the Foundation Tech Product Manager.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
- Technical & Business Partnership:
Act as the technical specialist supporting business needs, collaborating with the application partner to unlock full value from the DSA ecosystem. 
- Requirements & Backlog Management:
Work with business teams to capture and prioritize detailed requirements (features, user stories) aligned to the product data strategy. Manage and refine the product backlog in partnership with the Scrum Master. 
- Process Documentation & Improvement:
Document current and future system processes, identifying opportunities for efficiency and optimization. 
- Solution Design & Specifications:
Collaborate with Product Manager, Solution Architect, and stakeholders to design high-level system flows and propose technology-enabled solutions. Prepare functional and technical specifications for configuration or development changes. 
- Configuration & Workflow Management:
Configure and maintain workflows within the DSA application to support evolving business needs. Maintain configuration repositories and manage non-SAP code objects where applicable. 
- Access & Security Management:
Administer user roles and access controls in alignment with InfoSec policies. Support compliance and security considerations across the DSA ecosystem. 
- Delivery Support & Testing:
Advise developers and testers on expected system behaviour. Perform functional testing on delivered solutions and upgrades to ensure alignment with business requirements. 
- Release & Change Management:
Coordinate configuration release activities in adherence to established policies. 
- Training & Adoption:
Develop user guides and training materials. Deliver training sessions to key users and support teams to drive adoption and effective usage. 
- Automation & Efficiency:
Identify and implement automation opportunities within product workflows to enhance operational efficiency. 
- Risk & Continuity Planning:
Establish and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for the DSA ecosystem. 
- Performance & Value Realization:
Monitor and report on application usage and effectiveness to ensure ROI and global adoption. 
- Budget & Governance:
Support the Product Manager in budget management and compliance reporting for the DSA ecosystem 
The skills you will bring to the team
 
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience. 
- Strong understanding of digital shelf metrics, product content optimization, and retail media strategies. 
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
- Familiarity with agile methodologies and backlog management tools. 
- Industry certifications and experience with DSA platforms (e.g., Commerce IQ, Profitero, Edge by Ascential) is essential 
- Experience in Food & Beverage or other related industry highly desirable. 
- Experience in analysing business challenges using structured frameworks and methodologies. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing technology-enabled use cases and analysing Business needs. 
- Experience in modelling system processes; knowledge of common notational standards is beneficial (e.g., BPMN). 
- Able to design and execute functional tests, with experience managing bugs / defects through to remediation. 
- Basic knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security standards, and technology solutioning is beneficial. 
- Ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional IS team 
Where and how you will work  
The opportunity will be based in Citywest, Dublin 24 with hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.  
  
What we would like to offer you!  
The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, health & dental plan, competitive salary. 
 
About Glanbia  
Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide
   
  
At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Here, you’ll be the champion and ‘expert’ for the products within Marketing; You will have expert understanding of all aspects related to the products, including having the ability to demo products with our Parallels Desktop team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere. So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

This is the moment. It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with new leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
We want you to be you. Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
It’s your world. We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

As a Senior Tech Product Marketing Manager, you will:

Translate roadmap and feature capabilities provided by Product management into meaningful messaging for customers, channel partners & sales. This includes:
Website content (e.g., product & use-case pages)
Slide decks
Product 1 pagers

Manage new releases from a sales & marketing perspective (especially the content & positioning part).
Write relevant content – such as blog posts – with the help from the Tech growth marketing team (and their SEO/Keywork analysis)
Training and supporting other Marketing Managers

Work hand-in-hand with the sales & sales engineering teams to identify needs and areas of improvement.

15+ years or more experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, or, equivalent for IT solutions.
Strong analytical skills and use data to drive insights.
Ability to communicate effectively across both technical and non-technical audiences; able to simplify and structure complex technical messages.
Hands-on experience in content creation (blogs, slide decks, etc.) combined with strong story-telling skills.
Hands-on technology skills are a must (I.e. You can install and use Parallels products, you understand the technical foundations of the technology)
Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects at the same time

US:

Parallels Workspace Solutions are award-winning solutions that helps users leverage the best technology out there, whether it’s Windows, Mac, Chrome OS, iOS, Android, or the cloud.
We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.

Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
Our team is growing fast, and there’s a ton of energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform and virtualization solutions that make it simple for businesses and individuals to securely access applications and data on any device, anywhere.

Eaton’s ES EMEA CPS division is currently seeking a Program Manager Direct Current for Data Center (DC for DC) EMEA.

Role Summary

The DC for DC EMEA Program Manager is responsible for orchestrating and governing Eaton’s end to end data center electrical solution portfolio for hyperscale and colocation customers across EMEA. This role ensures that product development, system architectures, and customer engagement activities across multiple Eaton divisions are aligned into a coherent, competitive, and execution ready offering.

Operating as a senior, technical program leader with strong systems engineering credibility, the Program Manager leads through influence across R&D, product management, engineering, and commercial teams. The role owns program execution from concept through launch, ensuring on schedule and on budget delivery, structured customer engagement at each development milestone, and rapid identification and resolution of technical or organizational gaps.

This is a newly created, strategic role reporting directly to the VP/GM, with a mandate to strengthen Eaton’s position with hyperscalers and colocation customers by driving integrated solutions rather than disconnected products.

What You’ll Do

DC for DC EMEA Program Leadership:



-  Establish and lead the DC for DC EMEA program covering Eaton’s full data center power value chain, including MVSST, 800VDC Switchboard, DC Remote Power Panel, Solid State Breakers, BESS, Busway, digital power management, and related software and services.
-  Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
-  Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.


Cross Division Product & Technology Alignment



-  Coordinate new product development roadmaps across multiple Eaton divisions to ensure architectural coherence and compatibility for hyperscale and colocation data center applications.
-  Work closely with divisional R&D, power systems engineering, and product management teams to align technical assumptions, interfaces, and performance targets.
-  Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


Customer Engagement & External Alignment



-  Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
-  Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
-  Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.


Program Execution, Visibility & Issue Resolution



-  Consolidate inputs from divisions into clear program dashboards, executive summaries, and decision materials for senior leadership.
-  Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
-  Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.


Strategic Contribution & Continuous Improvement



-  Contribute to Eaton’s long term data center strategy by providing insights from customer engagements, competitive dynamics, and technology trends.
-  Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.


Qualifications



-  Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
-  Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
-  Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
-  Prior experience in R&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


Skills



-  Strong understanding of data center electrical architectures, including MV and LV distribution, ACBs, UPS systems, energy storage, busway, and redundancy concepts.
-  Ability to ensure system level technical coherence through collaboration with divisional experts rather than hands on detailed design ownership.
-  Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.
-  Strong program management discipline and executive communication skills.
-  Ability to operate confidently with senior internal leaders and demanding external customers.
-  Structured, action oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution and issue resolution.
-  Excellent written and spoken English.

- Support client retention and renewals

Single Sponsor Associate Clinical Project Director (Program Manager) - 3 days in the Dublin office

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Typically manages a team of direct reports and may have indirect reports. Plays a leadership role in team member recruitment, on-boarding and leads ongoing training and coaching of team members.
May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-range therapeutic area / functional area plans as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communications to other team members upon implementation.
Champions Values and Leadership Commitments.
Responsible for overseeing the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility.
Responsible for leading or otherwise overseeing study teams related to assigned studies.
Proactively manages vendor engagement for appropriate third-party oversight at the study-level, including proactive governance.
Proactively manages stakeholder relationships at the study-level.
Proactively manages oversight of clinical study execution, including developing operational strategies for the study to optimize execution.
May actively contribute to and/or represent Clinical Operations at sub-teams as applicable, including providing input and support to Associate Directors / Directors as needed.
Acts as a manager of managers and individual contributors with a People First approach that focuses on employee engagement, development and team health.
Responsible for the resource management of assigned studies, including an ongoing assessment of resource needs and optimal deployment of resources to support a fluid ‘One Ops’ workforce.
Effectively participates and engages in Clinical Operations and/or cross-functional change initiatives.
Leads and/or engages in Clinical Operations-specific change initiatives, typically therapeutic area- or functional area- specific.
May have business process owner (BPO) responsibilities and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes.
Encourages an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives that incorporate best practices, external benchmarking and standardization across Clinical Operations.
Ensures team’s work complies with established practices, policies and processes, and any regulatory or other requirements.
Experience needed.
BA / BS / RN with end to end program management experience, with a solid background in Clinical Trial Management or Clinical Project Management.
Operating at a high level in a cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in CRO or Pharma, including multiple years’ experience leading and managing study management or project teams.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Clinical Operations is responsible for the worldwide execution of all Phase I - IV clinical trials across therapeutic areas. Clinical Operations plays a key role in ensuring all clinical trials are performed in accordance with applicable SOPs, company policies and regulatory guidelines to provide timely and high-quality clinical data that supports global registration and commercialization of our client's products. This individual will manage a team of direct and potentially indirect reports. Oversee and be responsible for the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility. You may act as the business process owner (BPO) and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes. You will encourage an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives and incorporating best practices, external benchmarking and standardization across Clinical Operations.

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

Responsibilities



- Build and maintain reporting that product managers, engineering leads, and the exec team actually use to tell stories and make decisions. This includes recurring dashboards in Hex as well as one-off analyses in response to specific product questions.
- Partner directly with PMs across the portfolio (Talent CRM, Work Architecture, Work Intelligence) to answer product questions such as usage, adoption, retention, feature performance, conversion through key flows.
- Maintain the product analytics tool stack (incl. Pendo, and Hex). Make sure they're configured well, integrated properly, and that PMs and designers can get to the answers they need without always going through you.
- Enable PMs to self-serve. Build the dashboards, templates, and documentation that mean routine questions don't need an analyst in the loop. Your job is to make yourself unnecessary for the easy stuff so you can focus on the hard stuff.
- Design and iterate AI agent workflows to automate prospecting, outreach, lead qualification, and follow-up
- Leverage LLM-powered tools to build scalable, autonomous product ops processes (e.g. customer and market feedback ops, roadmap and planning, process and governance, internal communication and team enablement)
- Instrument agents with feedback loops and quality controls
- Evaluate emerging AI tooling and document agent architectures so workflows are reproducible and maintainable

What We're Looking For



- Strong SQL. You'll be writing it daily, against messy real-world data, and you should be comfortable doing so as a stand-alone SME.
- A track record in product analytics, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally somewhere with multiple products or a reasonably complex data model.
- Hands-on experience with Pendo or a comparable product analytics tool (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap), and with a SQL-based exploration tool like Hex, Mode, or similar.
- You can tell a clear story with data such as building a dashboard that doesn't need a tour, or present a finding to a PM or a VP with strong clarity and focus.
- Pragmatism. Beamery's data isn't pristine. We need someone who can make progress in a real environment in the face of imperfect conditions.
- Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered automation workflows - either in a business or personal context

Nice to have



- Experience analysing AI/ML-powered product features.
- Exposure to HR tech, talent acquisition, or workforce data.

Project Manager – Hyperscale Data Centre & Fibre Infrastructure
Location: Site / Hybrid – UK, Europe & USA
Department: Service Delivery
Reporting to: Head of Service Delivery
Travel: Regular international travel required


An established provider of fibre optic, structured cabling and critical infrastructure solutions is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of large-scale Data Centre and Hyperscale infrastructure projects.
This is a senior, client-facing delivery role with responsibility for managing complex projects from initial handover and planning through to delivery, commercial close-out and client handover.
You will manage high-value fibre and connectivity projects within hyperscale and enterprise environments, working across live data centre facilities and coordinating multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and stakeholders.
This is a hands-on Project Manager position suited to someone comfortable operating in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. You will be responsible for project performance across programme, cost, quality, risk and safety, while maintaining strong client relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
What You'll Be Doing
Project Delivery

- Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale Data Centre and fibre infrastructure projects.
- Manage projects from sales handover and mobilisation through to delivery, commercial close-out and client sign-off.
- Develop and manage detailed project plans, delivery strategies, resource plans and risk registers.
- Deliver large-scale fibre infrastructure supporting spine-leaf network architectures, including high-count backbone and connectivity deployments.
- Monitor project performance across programme, cost, quality, risk and client requirements.
- Coordinate multiple teams, including shift-based and 24/7 operations where required.
- Ensure all works are delivered in line with contractual obligations, SLAs and project requirements.
Client & Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with hyperscale, enterprise and critical infrastructure clients.
- Lead project meetings, governance reviews and service reviews.
- Provide clear and accurate updates on project progress, risks, constraints and required actions.
- Work closely with internal teams, subcontractors, suppliers and client stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
Commercial & Financial Management

- Take responsibility for project budgets, cost control and commercial performance.
- Manage forecasting, resource utilisation and project expenditure.
- Support and manage project P&L and margin performance.
- Oversee change control and ensure commercial risks and opportunities are managed effectively.
- Support accurate invoicing, revenue forecasting and commercial close-out.
Operational & Resource Management

- Lead and coordinate installation engineers, service teams, subcontractors and third-party suppliers.
- Manage resource planning across multiple project activities and locations.
- Ensure projects meet required quality, security, uptime and compliance standards.
- Drive continuous improvement across project delivery and operational performance.
- Support the management and resolution of issues within live and fast-paced delivery environments.
Risk, Safety & Compliance

- Identify and manage project risks, particularly those associated with high-density deployments, complex cable routing and live Data Centre environments.
- Ensure compliance with relevant health and safety legislation and project requirements.
- Oversee the preparation and implementation of RAMS.
- Promote a strong safety-first culture across project teams and subcontractors.
- Ensure project activities are delivered in accordance with client, regulatory and environmental requirements.
Pre-Sales & Technical Support

- Work with sales and technical teams to support project proposals and solution development.
- Provide project delivery input during pre-sales and technical workshops.
- Ensure proposed solutions are practical, scalable and commercially deliverable.
- Support technical discussions relating to fibre infrastructure, structured cabling and Data Centre connectivity.
What We're Looking For
Essential

- Significant experience as a Project Manager within Data Centres, fibre infrastructure, structured cabling or other critical infrastructure environments.
- Proven experience delivering large-scale, high-value projects for enterprise, mission-critical or hyperscale clients.
- Strong understanding of Data Centre infrastructure, including fibre, copper, structured cabling and connectivity.
- Experience managing complex project lifecycles from planning and mobilisation through to delivery and handover.
- Strong commercial experience, including budgets, forecasting, cost control and project P&L.
- Proven experience managing project teams, subcontractors and third-party suppliers.
- Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
- Experience working within high-pressure, SLA-driven or mission-critical environments.
- Knowledge of project risk management, change control and project governance.
- Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills.
- Proficiency in relevant project management tools and methodologies.
- Willingness and flexibility to travel across the UK, Europe and the USA.
- Full clean driving licence.
Desirable

- Experience delivering projects within Hyperscale Data Centre environments.
- Understanding of spine-leaf network architectures.
- Exposure to GPU, AI or high-performance computing infrastructure.
- Experience managing high-density rack deployments and complex fibre infrastructure.
- PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent project management qualifications.
- IOSH or other relevant Health & Safety qualification.
- First Aid certification.
What's on Offer

- Competitive salary and performance-based incentive scheme.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Company pension.
- Private healthcare.
- Life insurance.
- Opportunity to deliver major Data Centre and critical infrastructure projects across the UK, Europe and USA.
Summary
This is a senior, hands-on Project Manager role for someone with strong experience delivering complex Data Centre, fibre or critical infrastructure projects.
You will lead project delivery in demanding environments, manage clients and commercial performance, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering infrastructure supporting the next generation of high-density and high-performance computing environments.

We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.

We’re looking for people who:

Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose

Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride

Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them

Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly capable and customer focused Field Service Engineer to support our growing customer base across Ireland (Cork and surrounding areas), with occasional travel across Ireland as required. This role is essential to ensuring our equipment operates reliably in the field, delivering exceptional service that drives both customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will provide on‑site installation, maintenance, and repair of our equipment, acting as the primary technical representative for our organisation. You will diagnose issues, complete repairs efficiently, and identify opportunities to enhance service value, ensuring customers receive a seamless and professional experience.

This position requires a self‑motivated individual who is comfortable working independently, managing their own schedule, and adapting to varied customer environments. Strong technical skills, clear communication, and a commercial mindset are essential, as your work will directly contribute to operational uptime and service related revenue.

Key responsibilities:

Perform on‑site installation, maintenance, and repair of company equipment around Cork and surrounding areas, and Northern Ireland.
Diagnose technical issues efficiently, carrying out corrective actions to restore equipment performance and minimise customer downtime.
Deliver a high quality customer experience, acting as the primary technical representative and maintaining strong professional relationships.
Identify and promote service opportunities, including upgrades, replacement parts, and revenue‑generating activities aligned with customer needs.
Manage daily schedules and travel plans independently, ensuring timely arrival to customer sites and effective use of working hours.
Maintain accurate service documentation, including job reports, parts usage, and follow‑up actions within company systems.
Ensure compliance with safety standards, company procedures, and customer site requirements at all times.
Collaborate with internal teams, providing feedback on recurring issues, product performance, and customer insights.
Support continuous improvement, contributing ideas to enhance service efficiency, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
Maintain company tools, equipment, and vehicle to a high standard, ensuring readiness for daily field operations.

Benefits

25 days holiday, increasing to 30 days with length of service, plus bank holidays
Mobile Role across Ireland (Cork and surrounding areas) and occasionally into Northern Ireland.
Compensation – Base salary of €38,500 per annum, car allowance of €6,500 per year or company car, additional earnings through commission - potential to earn €1,000 per month commission (on target, not guaranteed)
Pension scheme with employer match contribution up to 6% of basic salary (individuals must contribute a minimum of 1.75% to the scheme)
3 x basic salary life insurance scheme
Employee Assistance Programme
Employee Discount Scheme - Access deals for travel, restaurants and shopping

Experience:

Proven experience in a field service, maintenance, or technical support role, ideally working with electro‑mechanical or similar equipment.
Strong diagnostic and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify faults quickly and implement effective solutions.
Technical proficiency in mechanical, electrical, or electronic systems, supported by a relevant qualification:
Hold or be willing to obtain A+/N+ accreditation within the first 12 months of contract
Excellent communication and customer‑facing skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and professionally.
Commercial awareness, with the confidence to identify service opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.
Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and prioritise tasks across multiple customer sites.
Full, clean driving license, with the willingness to travel across southern Ireland, surrounding areas, and into Northern Ireland when required.
Strong organisational skills, including accurate completion of service reports, documentation, and parts usage records.
Comfortable working in varied environments, including customer facilities, workshops, and field locations.
Commitment to safety, following company procedures and site-specific requirements at all times.
Embrace technology, to enable greater efficiencies within the role.
Able work independently, with minimal supervision.

We are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace ensuring all employees are treated with dignity and respect, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion, age, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

Every organisation has millions of assets. When they move together it's breathtaking.

We will:

• Provide the opportunity to grow and develop your career
• Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
• Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
• Offer comprehensive benefits globally (PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs)

We are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace ensuring all employees are treated with dignity and respect, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion, age, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

Whilst this role may be advertised as a full-time role, we are open to applications from those who may need, or like, to work different schedules. Please discuss this as part of the application process.
