Description

Program Manager responsible for driving cross-functional program delivery across EMEA infrastructure supply chain operations. Owns coordination and execution of complex, multi-workstream programs spanning logistics, warehousing, vendor management, and data center fulfillment. Reports to Sr Mgr, EMEA AWS Cloud Logistics.

Key job responsibilities



-  Drive cross-functional coordination across internal teams (logistics operations, procurement, engineering, trade compliance, finance) and external partners (carriers, LSPs, warehouse operators, contractors) to deliver program outcomes on time and within scope.
-  Build and maintain program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone trackers that provide clear visibility on status, blockers, and critical path across all active workstreams.
-  Establish and own program reporting cadences (WBR/MBR/QBR), synthesizing progress across multiple workstreams into executive-level narratives with clear escalation of risks and decisions required.
-  Identify and proactively manage cross-program dependencies, resource conflicts, and sequencing challenges — escalating early and proposing tradeoff options when programs are at risk.
-  Design and implement program governance frameworks, intake processes, and delivery mechanisms where none exist — creating repeatable, scalable structures that reduce coordination overhead and drive consistent execution.
-  Partner with technical and systems teams to improve program tooling, reporting automation, and data quality — translating manual tracking into scalable solutions.
-  Drive continuous improvement across program delivery practices, capturing lessons learned, refining processes, and raising the bar on delivery predictability and stakeholder communication.
-  Operate with a high degree of independence, prioritizing based on business impact, managing competing demands across the portfolio, and escalating only when executive decision-making is required.

A day in the life



-  Run a cross-functional / regional sync to drive progress on a multi-partner program (e.g., a new warehouse stand-up, a logistics network change, or a capacity expansion initiative), documenting actions and owners.
-  Dive deep into a program blocker — pulling together the right stakeholders, diagnosing the root cause, and proposing a path to resolution with clear owners and timelines.
-  Update program plans and risk registers, preparing materials for an upcoming leadership review with a clear narrative on what's on track, what's at risk, and what decisions are needed.
-  Coordinate with procurement and vendor teams to ensure external partner deliverables are sequenced correctly and SLA commitments are being met.
-  Partner with a technology team to scope an automation opportunity that eliminates a recurring manual coordination bottleneck in the program lifecycle.
-  Facilitate a retrospective on a recently completed program, capturing what worked, what didn't, and what mechanisms should be adopted for future programs.

About The Team

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, high-impact team within AWS Cloud Logistics EMEA. The team manages the end-to-end supply chain for AWS infrastructure across the EMEA region — ensuring the right equipment reaches the right data center at the right time, cost, and quality. The breadth and complexity of our network continues to grow, and we need program managers who can operate across workstreams, geographies, and partner ecosystems to keep our delivery engine running and make it better.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic Qualifications



-  Experience in program or project management
-  Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
-  Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
-  Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications



-  Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
-  Experience leading process improvements
-  Knowledge of general AI tools
-  Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Job Description

This is an opportunity to join Ascot Group - one of the world’s preeminent specialty risk underwriting organizations.

Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we’re bound by a common mission and purpose: One Ascot. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourish in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.

The Ascot Way guides our people and our organization. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. These platforms work as one, deploying our capital creatively through our unique Fusion Model: Client Centric, Risk Centric, Technology Centric.

Built to be resilient, Ascot maximizes client financial security while delivering bespoke products and world class service — both pre- and post-claims. Ascot exists to solve for our clients’ brightest tomorrow, through agility, collaboration, resilience, and discipline.

Job Purpose



-  Establish yourself as the product expert and go-to person for understanding the various Underwriting Products including but not limited to, applications, warehouses, methodologies, and reporting solutions. 
-  Tackle operational issues, mitigate risks, and seek opportunities for process improvement or automation, while staying updated on technical and regulatory changes affecting Underwriting Operations. 
-  Oversee the sequencing of operational and IT updates within Underwriting, ensuring project outcomes align with goals, and orchestrating the Underwriting team’s engagement in business-wide operational change. 
-  Continually monitor and update Underwriting business processes, ensuring they are evaluated regularly and adapted to reflect any changes as a result of I.T Initiatives. 
-  Work closely with the Director of Operational Strategy to ensure any Underwriting initiatives align to Ascots strategic objectives and the required prioritisation has been applied. 
-  Help develop the Product Management capability, with a focus on developing core competencies and cultivating a culture of ‘continuous improvement. 

Detailed Duties



-  Undertake a continuous review of the existing products, identifying areas for improvement, and making recommendations to provide better outcomes for the Underwriting teams. 
-  Assist in troubleshooting and investigating operational issues that arise within Underwriting, helping propose and work through potential solutions. 
-  Proactively identify potential operational risks within Underwriting, ensuring all risks are monitored, actioned and if possible mitigated. 
-  Work with the Underwriting teams to analyse business processes and workflows identifying areas for improvement or automation. 
-  Familiarise yourself with technical and regulatory changes to understand how they might impact the Underwriting landscape. 
-  Provide technical support to the business on behalf of Underwriting, including acting as a SME on projects, participating in workshops and contributing to project delivery as required. 
-  Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across the business including but not limited to Operations, I.T, Finance, Reinsurance, Claims, Pricing and Actuarial. 
-  Perform any required analysis to support and promote the funding of all discretionary initiatives on behalf of the Underwriting teams. 
-  Oversee and assist in the monitoring and achievement of any Underwriting project benefits, confirming their alignment with the initial business case objectives. 
-  Facilitate the prioritisation of all operational and IT changes within the Underwriting business area, by co-ordinating the Underwriting teams across large-scale transformation projects, handling small change service requests, and contributing to the ongoing development of data warehouses. 
-  Develop, implement, and manage OKRs and KPIs for the Underwriting teams to align with Ascots strategic objectives. 
-  Assist the Director of Operational Strategy with any ad-hoc requests when needed. 

Person Specification



-  Serve as the liaison between Underwriting and IT, effectively translating technical solutions into non-technical language and vice versa. 
-  Able to facilitate, collaborate, influence and drive resolution across different stakeholders within the Ascot Group. 
-  Proactive and organised with good attention to detail. 
-  Lead by example at all times. 
-  Highly professional, energetic, diplomatic, calm, pragmatic and solution-driven. 
-  Exceptional problem-solving skills. 
-  Self-sufficient and a self-starter who can think and act proactively. 
-  A willingness to be flexible and respond appropriately to changing and / or conflicting demands. 

Technical Knowledge



-  Understanding of Underwriting concepts and accounting principles. Including knowledge of the various types of MOA’s, Contracts Types and Business Classes. 
-  Well versed in Business Process Improvement (BPI) methodologies, with experience of enhancing operational processes. 
-  Experience with process mapping tools and techniques, with a background of producing As-Is and To-Be process documentation. 
-  Skilled in evaluating and writing new proposals for the purpose of obtaining new project funding. 
-  Adept in formulating and executing SQL queries for data manipulation and analysis. 
-  Knowledge of Risk Management strategies to identify, assess and prioritise risks. 
-  Familiarity with the full Project Lifecycle, including experience in different methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid) 
-  Strong Microsoft skills in particular Excel, Visio, Powerpoint, Word and Outlook. 
-  Ability to review Project plans, Resource allocation and Benefit Realisation models. 

Business Knowledge



-  Lloyd’s Market, General Insurance or Broking Experience (Must Have) 
-  Core concepts of Insurance – Underwriting, Reinsurance, Finance, Compliance, Claims (Must Have) 
-  Background in Underwriting or Underwriting Operations from either BAU or Project based activities (Must Have) 

 Please be aware that Ascot Group’s job opportunities will be posted on our official careers page. All official communication comes from @ascotgroup.com email addresses, if you receive a job offer or recruitment communication from Ascot Group that you suspect might be fraudulent, do not hesitate to contact us directly to verify its legitimacy . We will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during any stage of the recruitment process. Your privacy and trust are of utmost importance to us, and we strive to ensure that you have a positive experience with Ascot Group.

4724f6e5c29be6e7.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here. 

What we're looking for

This is the first dedicated Chief of Staff hire in our Product org. You'll report directly to Rob, our VP Product, and work alongside him every day as his closest partner in running the product organisation.

Working with Rob is the job. This isn't a role where you'll get a remit handed to you and check in monthly. You'll be in Rob's most important conversations, you'll leave them owning the follow-through, and you'll be the person he thinks out loud with before a decision is made. Expect a standing 1:1 that runs long, a shared list of the org's live problems, and genuine licence to take things off his plate permanently rather than tidying them up for him. Where he can't be in the room, you'll represent his thinking, and where you think he's wrong, he'll want to hear it first, directly, from you.

Rob is a good person to learn from. He joined Omnea as VP Product in early 2025; before that he was VP Product and then General Manager at OakNorth, and prior to that VP Product and later interim CEO at H4, a contract lifecycle management company he helped build from pre-seed. He's operated across product, commercial and P&L ownership, which is unusually broad - and it means this role is exposed to all three rather than just the product surface.



- You'll live at the intersection of product and AI. Your remit is the operational and strategic layer a fast-growing product org needs to scale: the tool stack, the launch rhythm, our top-level metrics, early access programmes, the comms, and the cadence that holds the team together.
- Treat the product org as your user. Define the problem, build the thing, get people using it, then check whether it made anyone faster. If it didn't, kill it and try something else.
- This is not a co-ordination job. You'll be trusted to hold real ownership. We want a structured operator with low ego and a builder's instinct — someone who'd rather automate a problem than write a process doc about it. You'll be hands-on: wiring up integrations, writing Claude skills, pulling data, shipping dashboards.
- The role is deliberately broad, and it's a springboard. Working this closely with a VP Product is a fast route into product leadership, a PM group, or whatever the biggest gap turns out to be twelve months from now.

What Can You Expect?

AI enablement for the product team. You'll work out where PMs, designers and engineers are spending time they shouldn't, then build the agents, Claude skills and automations that take it off them: synthesising customer signal from Gong, Slack and support, turning specs into first drafts, generating release notes, assembling reporting. Getting people to use what you build matters as much as building it, so expect to spend real time on adoption and coaching. Hold yourself to whether the team is measurably faster.

The product tool stack. Claude (incl. skills), Figma, Linear, Notion, Pylon, Mixpanel, Datadog, Granola, our AI tooling, whatever comes next. You own how it's configured, how it connects and how well it's used. Kill what isn't earning its licence. Run the evaluation when we need something new. Connect them up so nobody's copy-pasting between systems. And structure our sources of truth — roadmap data, decision logs, product knowledge — so agents can read them as well as people can.

Launch and release coordination. The product launch calendar, readiness criteria, and a reliable record of what shipped when. The important part is the join between what we build and how we sell it. Product Marketing owns the narrative, the campaign and marketing release timing; you own the reality underneath it. You'll know the product inside and out, and you'll ensure that the thing we're announcing has actually shipped, works, is documented for internal teams and customers, and that a customer can use it on day one. Nothing goes out before it's ready. Nothing meaningful ships without the market hearing about it.

Early access programmes. Alpha, beta and design partner programmes are how we de-risk what we build and how our best customers get a stake in the roadmap. They run informally today. As we sell to bigger and more demanding enterprises they need proper structure: who gets in, what both sides commit to, how feedback gets captured and routed, and what has to be true before something goes GA. You'll design that and mature it as our customer base does.

Top-level metrics, and the story they tell. PMs own the detail for their own areas and should keep owning it. You own the layer above: our North Star and company-level product metrics, the key metric from each team pulled into one picture, kept current and actually looked at. You'll shape the narrative around the metrics and work with PMs to connect the detail up to the company level. You'll bring in the signals from outside product that should be shaping decisions — pipeline and what we're winning on, customer health, how people really use what we've shipped. Board and investor materials should pull from your view rather than getting rebuilt from scratch every quarter, and you and Rob will build them together — you assembling the picture, him taking it into the room.

Product comms, including the roadmap deck. The internal newsletter, release notifications, release tracking. As we ship faster this becomes the difference between a business that's aligned and one that's guessing — Sales, Customer and Marketing should never be surprised by something we've shipped. You'll often be writing in Rob's voice as well as your own, so getting close enough to him to do that convincingly matters. You'll also own our external-facing roadmap deck, used with prospects and customers and as an internal alignment tool.

Documentation. Integration guides, technical docs and product reference material that get used live in sales cycles and onboarding. You'll keep them accurate as the product grows, track their adoption, and adjust.

How the product team comes together. A team growing this fast needs coherence, and that's yours to own. You'll run our quarterly or semi-annual product events, and wider R&D events where it makes sense, with a real agenda and a real outcome rather than a day of slides. You'll also own our learning rhythm: lunch and learns, internal teach-ins, and getting good external speakers in from other product orgs.

About You



- You've spent 2 to 3 years in a chief-of-staff role, product operations, product management, business operations, strategy and ops, or consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS. The strongest candidates will have done more than one of those, and will have built the systems they ran rather than inherited them.
- You want to work this closely with someone. The best version of this role is a genuine partnership with Rob, which means you're energised by being in someone's orbit, learning by proximity, and building the trust that gets you handed the things that matter. If you'd rather be given a clean brief and left alone, this isn't the one.
- You're comfortable operating with borrowed authority. You can represent a leader's thinking accurately, chase senior people without friction, and be trusted with the things they can't delegate anywhere else, while being direct enough to disagree with them privately.
- AI is already how you work. Not something you're planning to get to. You use it instinctively, and more usefully, you know how to design systems that leverage it for other people. You've built agents, automations or internal tools that others adopted and kept using. You can get to a working prototype without waiting for engineering.
- You're comfortable with data. You can pull it, interrogate it and turn it into something a PM will act on.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A Few Things To Note



- We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here. 
- We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here
- We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!
- We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Legal note: if you are viewing this posting outside of the Omnea careers' page, this may be an auto-generated advertisement and may lack the full range of advertised information - please click through to the posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/omnea to view additional advertised information on this posting.

Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place.

Job Description

At the heart of every unforgettable LEGO® experience is a seamless connection between people, processes, and technology — and that's where you come in. We're launching a dedicated program team to transform how we work in Digital — taking us from alignment to delivery. This key initiative focuses on shifting from merely re-engineering existing processes to completely reimagining end-to-end workflows. We're reimagining our Digital Product Delivery Lifecycle and future operating model, embedding AI and agent-enabled ways of working where they create meaningful value for teams and products.

 - this is your chance to make an impact that truly stacks up!

Core Responsibilities

The Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) will be a key player in driving high-quality delivery across multi-team, cross-functional programs within the 'Reimagine and Elevate How We Work' (Re-Elevate) initiative. We're reimagining our Digital Product Delivery Lifecycle with AI integration, and you'll be at the forefront. Collaborating closely with Engineering, Product, PPC and external partners, you'll create clarity, foster alignment, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure our transformation progresses smoothly and effectively across teams.

Own the day-to-day orchestration and delivery of a major Re‑Elevate workstream (e.g. Technology, People, Change Management), ensuring outcomes are clear, measurable and aligned to overall programme objectives.
Translate strategic direction and operating-model decisions into executable plans, sequencing work across teams and ensuring progress towards agreed transformation outcomes.
Lead program‑level operating rhythms (e.g. workstream alignment meetings, cross‑workstream integration sessions) that keep the Re‑Elevate program coordinated, sequenced and moving with momentum.
Shape clear, compelling program narratives that help senior stakeholders understand purpose, progress, risks and tradeoffs.
Partner with the Re‑Elevate Program Team, Workstream Leads, and fellow TPMs to define shared goals, milestones, and cross‑workstream expectations.
Create transparency across risks and dependencies ensuring issues are surfaced and mitigated early.
Maintain high‑quality program plans, including transformation roadmaps, dependency maps, delivery milestones and adoption / landing strategies
Facilitate alignment across cross‑functional teams, ensuring blockers are removed quickly and decision paths are clear.
Coordinate readiness and adoption activities across DT clusters, ensuring new operating‑model process, roles & responsibilities are understood, embraced, and embedded consistently.
Model excellent collaboration, structure, and delivery discipline, uplifting TPM craft standards across DT.

Play your part in our team succeeding

A core team is being brought together across key program workstreams, focusing on: digital operating-model, technology, people and change. Each area will have a dedicated TPM, working closely with the workstream teams, Digital leaders and the broader DT team as the work develops.

In Re‑Elevate, Senior TPMs are transformation orchestrators who bring structure, clarity, and disciplined coordination to complex operating‑model change. This won’t have direct line management responsibilities but will lead a major workstream (for example Technology, People, Change Management) and will influence across Product, Engineering and DT - reducing ambiguity, aligning stakeholders, sequencing change, and ensuring the transformation progresses coherently across multiple teams.

This role can be based either at LEGO® Campus in Billund, LEGO® Copenhagen Hub or our LEGO® London Hub. The work environment is exciting, inspiring, flexible, - and we like to have fun along the way!

Do you have what it takes?

Summary
Are you an Engineering Program Manager who thrives in fast-moving, highly dynamic environments where priorities evolve quickly and no two days look the same? Do you excel at creating clarity, alignment, and momentum across complex, high-stakes work? Join the AI, Search & Knowledge Platform Global SRE team; the organization responsible for keeping some of Apple’s most heavily used, always-on AI and Search infrastructure reliable, resilient, and scalable.

As the Senior EPM for Global SRE, you will serve as a trusted partner to our London-based SRE Manager, extending their reach and driving alignment, visibility, and execution across time zones. This is a fast-moving, highly dynamic environment with an established operating cadence and a constant flow of new priorities. You will bring structure to ambiguity without creating unnecessary overhead, using sound judgment, adaptability, and a pragmatic approach to keep teams moving.

This is also a hands-on role. You will engage deeply in the technical and operational details and personally lead high-impact programs, such as complex infrastructure migrations, when direct ownership is needed to accelerate progress.

You will be the connective force that keeps a global SRE organization aligned, informed, and ahead of emerging risks and priorities.

Description
We are looking for an exceptional Engineering Program Manager to join our team and partner closely with ASK Global SRE.

In this highly visible role, you will work alongside the London-based SRE Manager as a trusted partner and force multiplier across the organization’s global scope.



- You will help strengthen operational excellence by identifying and closing gaps in processes, tooling, planning, and execution across a complex, matrixed SRE environment.
- You will bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving inputs; including incidents, planning cycles, capacity forecasts, migrations, and leadership priorities and translate them into actionable plans with clear ownership, milestones, and timelines.
- This is a hands-on program leadership role. You will go beyond tracking execution to deeply engage in the technical and operational details, personally driving high-impact infrastructure and platform programs from planning through delivery. You will partner with engineering teams on capacity forecasting, resource utilization, operational readiness, and continuous improvement, while identifying scalable approaches that improve the stability, resilience, and agility of our environments.
- You will also evaluate existing workflows and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, accuracy, and scalability across the organization.
- Clear, proactive communication is central to this role. You will use collaboration channels as an operational signal, synthesizing complex information, surfacing risks and dependencies, escalating critical issues, and ensuring teams and leaders remain aligned and informed.
- Because many of the role’s key partners are based in California, working hours will primarily align with the afternoon and evening in London, providing meaningful real-time overlap with both California-based teams and London counterparts.

Minimum Qualifications


- -5+ years of Technical Program/Project Management experience in a dynamic, fast-paced, global infrastructure or SRE environment.
- -Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving, multi-team environments; organizing chaos without over-engineering process (resourceful problem-solving).
- -Self-motivated, independent, and proactive; able to operate with minimal oversight and make sound real-time judgment calls.
- -Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills; able to quickly triage, prioritize, and lead cross-functional teams under pressure.
- -Willingness and ability to work evening hours to maximize real-time overlap with California-based teams.

Preferred Qualifications


- -10+ years of Technical Program Management experience, ideally spanning global internet services, large-scale international user bases, and responsibility for rapid-response operations.
- -Experience partnering directly with or effectively acting as an extension of an SRE manager/lead — operating with their judgment and authority when they're unavailable.
- -Familiarity with AI/ML, search, or knowledge platform infrastructure at scale.
- -Proven track record of raising team maturity improving processes, driving tooling adoption, and establishing operational consistency across newly formed or still-developing teams.
- -Strong technical/infrastructure background; bonus points for past hands-on engineering experience.
- -Innate drive to improve how things work, with a proven record of driving dramatic improvements in team quality, performance, agility, or effectiveness.
- -Capability to foster collaboration across cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
- -Experience building or improving communication and knowledge-sharing systems for a distributed org (Slack tooling/bots, digests, runbook hygiene, etc.).
- -BS/MS in EE/CS/CE or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
- -Strong customer-service orientation; able to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous requirements while pushing back when needed to protect alignment with priorities.
- -Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with genuine fluency operating through Slack, docs, and async channels across time zones — comfortable being the one who "scrubs" the noise and keeps everyone current.
- -Experience in large-scale, global infrastructure environments.
- -Direct, hands-on experience leading or heavily supporting infrastructure migrations or major operational cutovers, not just tracking them, but getting into the details yourself.

Job summary

A 12‑month secondment for an Inspector, or a Sergeant on temporary promotion.

PoliceAI is a nationally significant technology and transformation programme in UK policing. Backed by central government investment and positioned at the heart of the police reform agenda, PoliceAI is the new National Centre for AI in Policing, helping to shape how policing uses data, technology and artificial intelligence to tackle crime, protect the public and modernise frontline operations.

We bring together operational policing, technical expertise, product delivery, assurance and the responsible use of AI to develop and scale capabilities that improve public safety outcomes. Our work helps forces respond more effectively to demand, strengthen investigations, identify risk and harm earlier, and free up frontline time for the activities that matter most to communities.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a programme with national reach and meaningful public service impact, helping to define how AI is developed, governed and adopted across one of the UKs most important public services. The work is varied and complex, moves at pace, and has the potential to deliver better tools for policing, better outcomes for the public, and stronger foundations for the responsible use of AI.

About the College of Policing:

Our mission is: Leadership, Standards, Performance. This guides our work with individuals, forces, and policing partners towards our vision. We exist to support police officers, police staff and volunteers to deliver the best service to the public. Only through high quality leadership, consistent standards and continual performance improvement can everyone in policing reach their full potential. Our mission guides our work with individual, forces and partners towards our vision.

Additional Information:

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles.

Due to our status as Public Servants, we are not eligible to participate in the Civil Service transfer process. Therefore, while successful candidates can transfer in on their existing terms and conditions, any subsequent transfer out of the College to the Civil Service cannot be guaranteed on existing terms and conditions, and new starter/modernised terms may apply.

The College embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we comply with the Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) and apply the minimum selection criteria at sift stage of the recruitment process.

Job description

We are looking for people who are motivated by public service, interested in responsible innovation, and comfortable working collaboratively across organisational, operational and technical boundaries. Joining PoliceAI means contributing to a supportive, multidisciplinary team that is helping to shape the future of policing and ensure AI is used in ways that are effective, responsible, operationally useful and worthy of public trust.

This role sits within the Tool Theft and Acquisitive Crime Programme, a ministerial priority that is testing whether artificial intelligence and better data can cut tool theft and improve recovery for tradespeople and small businesses across England and Wales. The postholder combines day-to-day delivery management of the programme with operational subject matter expertise in tool theft, organised acquisitive crime, and the partner landscape surrounding it.

Working under the Programme Lead, and alongside a mix of business and technical specialists, the postholder runs the delivery rhythm of the programme, acts as the main contact for pilot forces, and brings frontline credibility to every conversation with technology and data partners and the wider stakeholder network. We are looking for someone with credible operational experience of acquisitive crime and a track record of managing delivery in a policing or comparable public sector setting.

You should be confident working alongside technical partners and translating operational need into practical requirements, with strong communication skills for briefing senior stakeholders. Experience of tool theft specifically, or of working with partners such as Opal, NaVCIS, or Trading Standards, is an advantage but not a requirement.

Hybrid working, with regular travel to pilot forces across England and Wales.

Person specification

Some of your responsibilities will include:

Manage and deliver the programme plan across the AI intervention and data integration strands, tracking milestones and escalating risks and dependencies to the Programme Lead.
Act as the main point of contact for pilot forces, coordinating testing, gathering feedback, and resolving field-level issues.
Bring direct operational knowledge of tool theft and organised acquisitive crime to shape requirements, test assumptions, and sense-check tooling against how officers and victims experience the problem.
Maintain working relationships with key operational partners across policing and industry, keeping the stakeholder map current as the programme develops.
Support benefits tracking and contribute to SLT-facing reporting on progress, risk, and the case for continued investment.

To be successful in this role youll need:

Operational experience of acquisitive crime, ideally tool theft or organised acquisitive crime, with knowledge of how disposal markets and recovery processes work in practice.
A track record of managing projects or workstreams to time, scope, and budget in a policing or comparable public sector setting.
Experience of identifying, managing, and escalating risks and issues in a complex delivery environment, with strong written and verbal communication for senior stakeholder briefings. Confidence working alongside technical partners and translating between operational need and technical delivery.
Experience of working across force boundaries, or in a national, regional, or multi-agency environment.

Please see the attached job description which contains full details of the role.

Making Effective Decisions

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

As a Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d), you will play a crucial role in driving project success and contributing to the growth and efficiency of our organization. Your ability to lead, collaborate, and deliver results will be essential in achieving our strategic objectives and exceeding client expectations. The position can be filled on any Kuehne+Nagel location in the EMEA region.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) to lead and oversee complex global customer implementation projects and programs from initiation to successful stabilization within a defined business vertical. As part of the vertical PMO, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. You will collaborate with the related vertical leadership teams on the Sales side and the Business Unit Air Logistics side to develop vertical related strategic goals and best practice to continuously meet the market requirements and conditions of our customers. This role requires at least 5 years of experience in leading/driving large, complex projects and/or programs through complete project Life-cycle, preferably on an international basis and a solid operational background in Air Logistics.

How you create impact



- Project Planning and Initiation: Lead project definition, scope, and objectives by collaborating with stakeholders. Create detailed plans, including timelines, resource and risk management
- Project Execution and Control: Guide teams, ensuring alignment with goals. Monitor progress, address deviations, and maintain proactive issue resolution
- Resource Management: Allocate and secure resources, collaborating with functional managers for expertise and success
- Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships, communicate status, be transparent and highlight opportunities effectively
- Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet Kuehne+Nagel and ISO 21205 standards, conduct evaluations, and suggest and implement improvements
- Competence & Strategy: Collaborate closely with the stakeholders of the assigned PMO vertical within the Sales and Business Unit Air Logistics organization to develop and lead strategic internal projects to further grow the success of vertical specific implementation management
- Risk & Change Management: Identify and mitigate risks, manage scope changes professionally for successful integration
- Mentoring/Supervision: Serve as a patient mentor, coaching, sharing best practices, fostering learning, and guiding junior managers on the assigned vertical requirements

What we would like you to bring



- Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration or a related field 
- Min. 5 years of proven experience as a Project Manager and/or Program Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering complex global projects in the assigned business vertical
- Strong understanding of Air Logistics operation and processes
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
- Proficiency in project management tools and software
- Project Management Professional (PMP, PMI, Prince2) or equivalent certification is a plus

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you get to grow your expertise, shape processes and deliver innovative solutions. We are continuously building our local and global network and our product portfolio, creating career opportunities in different fields of work worldwide. As a leader in the logistics industry, we provide a collaborative and IT-driven environment where you will work with motivated and customer-centric colleagues across the world. We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

Location

Our Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery.

This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives, serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Delivery



- Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
- Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
- Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
- Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
- Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
- Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.

Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding



- Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
- Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
- Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.

Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise



- Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
- Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:

- Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
- Partner margin and discount models.
- Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
- Usage and cost transparency.
- Marketplace and private offer workflows.
Executive & Partner Validation



- Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
- Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
- Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.

Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership



- Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
- Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
- Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.

Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance



- Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
- Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
- Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Qualifications



- Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
- Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
- Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
- Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
- Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
- Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
- Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
- Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
- Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.
- Excellent communication skills: ability to engage deeply with partners, cloud experts, and internal stakeholders at the executive level.
- A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate.

How Success Will Be Measured



- You are universally recognized by your peers and leadership as the driving force and primary authority ("tip of the spear") for the Partner Platform's product direction.
- Platform capabilities ship frequently with clear partner value.
- Partner feedback loops are strong and visibly influence the overarching roadmap.
- Adoption across the partner ecosystem increases and partner operational workflows improve measurably.
- Billing accuracy, financial transparency, and operational scalability improve for partners using the platform.
- Engineering teams consistently have clarity on the next most valuable increment to build—and why.
- Other product owners on the team are effectively mentored, aligned, and elevated through your leadership.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:



- Unlimited Vacation
- Flexible Working Options
- Health Insurance
- Parental Leave
- Employee Stock Option Plan
- Home Office Allowance
- Professional Development Stipend 
- Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

Job Title
Customer Program Manager

Job Description

Be part of a team connecting patients with hospitals, helping to make a difference and improving lives every day.

In this role, you have the opportunity to:

Lead customer-facing programs for Radiology Informatics (RI) — including PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging solutions — to meet project objectives, stakeholders’ expectations, and create lasting customer value.

Your role:

As a Philips Customer Program Manager for Radiology Informatics , you will be at the leading edge of healthcare innovation, improving customer satisfaction (NPS) by delivering software solutions that meet our healthcare customers’ needs. You will use project methodologies such as PMP/PRINCE2 to manage complex software implementation projects through their full lifecycle, from customer order signature to revenue recognition, go-live, and handover to Support Services.

Using a structured approach, you will provide timely and regular stakeholder communication (internal and external) supported by clear documentation, effective risk management, and rigorous management of the customer acceptance process.

This is a field-based role, predominantly covering customers across the UK, Ireland, and the Nordics (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland), with responsibility to support other areas within Northern Europe as needed. You will work from home with regular travel to customer sites.

You are responsible for:
Overseeing and managing large-scale, cross-functional projects (typically >€/£1M budget), ensuring delivery across scope, timeline, budget, quality, resources, and risk.
Gaining agreement on and achieving project goals and objectives; balancing and managing the project scope (including requirements), schedule, budget, quality, resources, and risks.
Driving decision-making, appropriately balancing risk-taking and issue escalation, and setting up detailed progress/escalation reports with clear corrective actions.
Building strong relationships with customers and external partners within the region up to senior leadership level.
Representing projects in steering committees and governance forums.
Leading and empowering diverse project teams, enabling team members to become efficient and effective.
Ensuring adherence to standardized solution delivery processes (e.g., SOLiD/Gearshift framework) and providing a flawless customer experience.
Ensuring that RI solutions are delivered according to agreed scope, quality, budget, and time targets.
Managing external parties such as subcontractors and partners, including complex or customized contract environments.
Ensuring cost performance and optimization by driving KPIs such as utilization rate by role/skill level and project costing/recalculation.
Controlling project budgets and project progress; evaluating all change requests for feasibility, cost/benefit, and added value; taking corrective actions.
Supporting the revenue and cost forecast process for projects and ensuring changes to the forecast are reported and flagged promptly.
Managing workforce planning and resource allocation across projects to ensure seamless delivery and flawless customer experience.
Developing proposals to improve processes and procedures proactively in the interest of continuous improvement.
You are part of:

Enterprise Informatics RI S&SD Implementation Northern Europe. You will report to the EI RI S&SD Implementation Project Management Leader in Northern Europe. You will be part of an inspiring team that has the goal to strengthen and drive performance of EI RI S&SD Implementation within Northern Europe.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience:
5+ years of work experience in software professional services and project management, ideally across different countries/markets.
A degree/qualification in Software Engineering, Business Engineering, or equivalent.
PMP (PMI) certified or equivalent (mandatory).
Professional knowledge of project management methodologies and estimation techniques (resources, cost, time, and risks).
Proven experience delivering healthcare IT/software projects, ideally including Radiology Informatics and PACS.
Functional knowledge of applied products and systems, and their interaction with third-party systems.
Financial acumen to influence margin in the pre-sales phase and to improve margin during delivery execution.
Communication skills to manage relationships with executive/management representatives of customers.
Experience managing teams, subcontractors, and complex contract negotiations.
Relevant experience with improvement projects for software delivery, meeting time, budget, and quality targets.
Experience in analyzing process performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and driving change.
Knowledge of quality and compliance requirements.
Knowledge of Health & Safety standards; ideally in-depth experience in the Health Systems industry.
Comprehensive understanding of "people business" — managing key skills in project, solutions, and services business, and driving continuous professionalization.
Quality-first mindset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Fluent in English (written and verbal); additional European languages (e.g., Scandinavian languages) are beneficial.
Acts as a role model for our Philips Leadership Asks: Customers first; Patient Safety, Quality and Integrity always; Team up to win; Take ownership to deliver fast; Eager to improve and inspire.
Clear driving license and willingness to travel.
How we work together:

We believe that we are better together than apart. This is a field-based role, most effectively done at customer or partner locations. You will be supported with a competitive salary, performance bonus, company car/allowance, family-friendly policies, flexible benefits, and access to Philips University.

Due to the role working in the healthcare environment, a standard DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) criminal record check will be required.

About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business .
• Discover our rich and exciting history .
• Learn more about our purpose .
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

About Philips UKI

In the UK, we are recognized as a Disability Confident employer and are proud to be part of the Armed Forces Covenant and Mental Health at Work Commitment. We welcome all applicants including those from minority backgrounds, LGBTQIA+, and individuals living with a disability.

Because we are at our best when you are, you can safely share any reasonable tools or adjustments needed during our recruitment process and beyond.

About The Team

As one of DoorDash's core operations teams, Customer Experience ensures that when there are bumps in the last mile, there's always someone there to help make things right. Our team designs and implements DoorDash's automated support solutions, with the ultimate goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience as reliably and efficiently as possible.

About The Role

Our team is looking to hire a Manager to lead the expansion of support automation in international markets. This Manager will own the end-to-end strategy and implementation of automated support features across new markets — leveraging DoorDash's extensive automation expertise to drive measurable automated resolution rate while building a scalable foundation for ongoing global expansion.

This Manager will serve as the S&O Expansion Program Lead: the central DRI for developing DoorDash's international automation rollout plan, owning reporting for North Star metric, and working closely with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and country teams. This role is a great opportunity for someone who wants to operationalize complex, multi-market solutions and have a direct impact on DoorDash's global support strategy

What You'll Be Doing



- Lead strategy. Define and drive DoorDash's support automation expansion strategy for international markets: determining use cases, prioritization frameworks, and the approach to scaling automations across countries in a repeatable, compliant, and operationally efficient way.
- Own the metric. Own the goal end-to-end, tracking progress weekly, identifying gaps, and driving corrective action across the cross-functional team.
- Build the foundation. Build a strong foundation partnering with Product and Engineering to enable feature parity and market customization, and creating the playbook for scaling across new use cases and automation channels.
- Enable experimentation. Partner with Analytics to design, launch, and evaluate experiments that measure impact and drive ship decisions in alignment with stakeholders.
- Navigate cross-functional complexity. Identify and manage interdependencies with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Legal, and country leads — ensuring automation strategy is built in alignment with local market requirements, regulatory constraints, and broader business priorities.
- Communicate and influence. Represent the automation expansion program in weekly business reviews and executive forums, clearly articulating progress, risks, and decisions needed from senior leadership.

Requirements



- You're organized. You thrive in creating structure out of ambiguity — defining clear ownership, milestones, and processes in a complex, multi-team environment.
- You solve problems from first principles. You're excited to tackle challenges in new markets and resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
- You're analytical. You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL or modeling in Excel to size opportunity, track performance, and inform decisions.
- You're persuasive. You are an effective communicator — speaking as if you're right and listening as if you're wrong. You can influence across DRIs at all levels, from country leads to senior leadership.
- You act with urgency. Speed excites you. You move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and hold teams accountable to timelines.
- You're relentless. You do what it takes to drive outcomes, no matter how many teams or time zones are involved.
- You have 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations, management consulting, or a related field — and have successfully delivered results in complex, cross-functional environments. Experience in support strategy, automation, or international expansion is a plus.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

We are at the heart of Ireland’s energy transition - connecting, operating and transforming the electricity grid to support a low carbon, renewable future.

We are building talented teams that tackle real world challenges every day and help us to achieve our goal to prepare the grid to carry up to 80% of Ireland’s electricity from renewable sources.

We are proud to be a certified Great Place to Work, recognised for our culture built on trust, collaboration and inclusion. At EirGrid you will find supportive teams, opportunities to grow and meaningful work. We also offer secure employment with a range of flexible and family friendly working policies to support your life and wellbeing. If you want to know more about what EirGrid has to offer you, visit Life at EirGrid.

If you are ready to make an impact and grow your career in a purpose-led organisation, your journey starts here.

The Opportunity
The successful candidate will support the Onshore PMO function in the delivery of projects within the established governance framework and across the relevant management boards. The role will be responsible for coordinating governance processes and forums, ensuring effective meeting administration, high-quality documentation, clear decision-making, and timely follow-up of actions and commitments.
Key responsibilities will include coordinating governance schedules and meetings, preparing and collating governance documentation, recording decisions and actions, assigning ownership, and tracking progress to completion. The successful candidate will provide governance advice and constructive challenge to stakeholders to support effective decision-making and adherence to agreed governance requirements.

The role will also involve monitoring the effectiveness of governance arrangements, identifying opportunities for improvement, and supporting the implementation of enhanced governance processes, controls, and reporting mechanisms. Acting as a key point of contact for governance activities, the successful candidate will manage the Change Control process across the CIO function and maintain the Help Hub Governance pages, driving continuous improvements where opportunities are identified.

In addition, the successful candidate will coordinate monthly reporting to the Executive and EirGrid plc Board, working closely with the Strategy Office and internal stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and of a high standard. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills will be essential to build effective relationships across the organisation and support the successful delivery of governance and reporting activities.

Candidate Profile
We are seeking a motivated, organised, and detail-oriented professional who can demonstrate:
Experience supporting PMO, governance, or project delivery functions.
Strong governance and meeting management skills, including the preparation of agendas, minutes, decision logs, and action trackers.
Experience coordinating reporting activities for senior management or board-level forums.
The ability to provide governance advice and constructive challenge to stakeholders.
Strong organisational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Demonstrated experience engaging with senior stakeholders and influencing outcomes across complex organisational structures.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
A proactive approach to process improvement and the implementation of governance best practices.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of strategic initiatives while supporting robust governance, effective decision-making, and continuous improvement across the organisation.

The Team

The Infrastructure office leads the development and delivery of the power system, onshore and interconnection investment programmes in collaboration with partners, customers and communities.
The Onshore Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for undertaking three key roles within Infrastructure; Regulation and Compliance Reporting and Auditing, Business Operations and Governance, and Business Intelligence. The team is responsible for setting the governance policies and standards to be used for onshore business readiness and large scale onshore transmission infrastructure and regulatory auditing and monitoring of OpEx and CapEx delivery.

The team also develops reports on schedule and financial information and delivery of outcomes and benefits aligned to strategic objectives across the development and readiness of the onshore transmission infrastructure to key stakeholders such as DECC and the CRU.

About you
Successful candidates will have:
Qualification to degree level or equivalent qualification, with at least 8 years relevant post qualification experience.
Strong interpersonal, influencing and communication skills.
Ability to develop a deep understanding of EirGrid governance methodology and approach
Excellent time management skills and proven ability to work independently.
Working knowledge of relevant software packages – Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to work collaboratively and transparently with others across the business and externally to deliver outcomes in accordance with strategic objectives.

Closing date for applications
11th September 2026

We value potential as much as experience. If you believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We're dedicated to diversity and inclusion at EirGrid. We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and the importance of a supportive culture for all our people to achieve their potential. Our diversity and inclusion networks have been designed to create an inclusive culture that enables our people to feel a sense of belonging at work.

As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.

Vice President, Scientific Services

Summary of Opportunity

This is an opportunity to co-lead a large medical affairs account in the oncology space, in collaboration with Client Services and Creative colleagues. You’ll be working as a strategic partner to the client and will help deliver scientific communications, digital projects, and medical campaigns across multiple products and pipeline compounds in our client’s oncology portfolio.

You will have the opportunity to lead and mentor a team of scientific writers, advise clients and key experts, and make suggestions to shape and align client strategy. You will also be able to use your business development skills to expand the business into other client teams and service offerings.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

To be successful in this role, you will be a scientific expert with a robust track record in leading a large medical affairs or commercial account, preferably within the oncology space. You will thrive when presented with commercial challenges that require a visual eye and creative solution. You will be able to confidently advise clients based on your experiences and be adapt at forming trusted partnerships. A successful candidate will be comfortable aligning strategy across a high-volume account and be able to direct the team towards success. You will develop and oversee content development, providing continual editorial and strategic support and guidance. You will pride yourself in people management and your ability to coach and mentor their team to success, always ensuring that the highest quality standards are met.

In addition to account responsibilities, you will also be a member of the BOLDSCIENCE scientific leadership team who work collaboratively to share experiences and ideas, lead cross-agency initiatives, and contribute to agency culture and operations.

About the team

Our Public Sector Transformation Excellence team supports public sector clients to design, deliver and implement transformation programmes. We are seeking a Project Manager at Senior Consultant or Assistant Manager level to join our Public Sector Transformation Excellence team. This role will support the delivery of transformation, change and implementation projects for public sector clients in Ireland and internationally. You will work with consulting colleagues and client stakeholders to manage project delivery, coordinate workstreams, maintain governance, analyse evidence, prepare high-quality deliverables and develop practical recommendations that help public sector organisations improve services and deliver better outcomes.

Project and Client Delivery

Lead and support the delivery of transformation, change and implementation projects for public sector clients, working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders.

A third-level degree, with a strong academic record.

Typically 2 to 5 years’ relevant experience in project management, consulting, transformation, public sector delivery or a related field.

Excellent analytical capability, including the ability to assess complex information, develop actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making.
