Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The Role

This is the first role of its kind at Prolific. You’ll help build how we deliver physical-world multimodal data collection from the ground up – establishing the operating model, production standards and collection methodologies we can scale across future programmes.

As our Technical Program Manager for Multimodal Data Collection, you’ll own the end-to-end execution of large-scale video, audio and multimodal data programmes – capturing and delivering thousands of hours of natural human activity through body-worn cameras, wearable devices and other recording hardware. You’ll turn complex client requirements into real-world collection programmes that meet precise technical, quality and diversity requirements. That could mean coordinating participants, sourcing controlled filming locations, selecting and deploying hardware, designing natural activity scenarios and running onsite production.

This is a hands-on, highly operational role. You’ll need to understand what it takes to reliably capture high-quality data in physical environments – from video and audio quality and multi-device synchronisation through to participant behaviour, consent, metadata, equipment and field logistics. You’ll also own programme economics, understanding how participants, locations, hardware, staffing, processing and rework affect the cost, scalability and margin of each collection.

We’re looking for someone equally credible reviewing a technical capture specification, running a production site, working through programme economics and sitting in front of a client.

What You’ll Be Doing



- Own large-scale video, audio and multimodal collections from client brief and pilot through to onsite production, data processing and final delivery.
- Design the collection operation across participants, activities, locations, recording hardware, field teams, vendors, logistics and quality controls.
- Turn activity requirements into natural, repeatable collection scenarios and participant protocols that capture authentic behaviour without over-scripting.
- Translate technical specifications into capture protocols covering video and audio quality, device configuration, synchronisation, metadata and acceptance criteria.
- Own programme economics, including bottom-up costing, cost per accepted hour, collection yield, rejection and rework, hardware utilisation and margin.
- Run pilots and quality gates, resolving technical and operational issues before moving successful collection methodologies into scaled production.
- Lead client delivery, making clear recommendations around trade-offs between quality, coverage, timeline, cost and operational feasibility.

What You’ll Bring to the Role



- Significant experience owning complex video/audio data collection, technical production or real-world capture programmes at scale – including the physical operation, not just project coordination.
- Experience running onsite or field-based operations involving participants, physical locations, recording equipment and production or field teams.
- Hands-on experience with video/audio capture and recording hardware, with a strong understanding of areas such as resolution, frame rate, audio quality, device configuration, multi-camera synchronisation and data integrity.
- Experience translating technical or research specifications into participant protocols, production workflows and measurable quality and acceptance criteria.
- Commercial ownership of operational programmes, including bottom-up costing, forecasting and the financial impact of rejection and rework.
- Experience delivering at scale against defined quality, diversity and acceptance requirements, while working directly with clients or senior stakeholders.

Even Better if you have:



- Experience collecting human video, audio or multimodal data for AI/ML, computer vision, robotics or embodied AI.
- Experience with egocentric or first-person video, body-worn or wearable cameras and multi-camera recording.
- Experience coordinating controlled filming environments, participant recruitment, permits, equipment and external production vendors.
- Experience working with Product or Engineering teams on data ingest, metadata, file formats, batch processing or data transfer.
- Experience taking a new collection methodology from pilot through to thousands of hours of production data.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research.

Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. At Prolific, our compensation packages for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. Many roles also include the opportunity to earn a cash variable element, such as a bonus or commission. Each job posting shows a salary range that reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires, based on the role’s location as well as your skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will also be happy to share the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Lazer is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more. With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products from $0 to $200M in revenue.

Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.

We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!

Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with enterprise brands to design and implement complex storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From platform migrations to ERP and OMS workflows, our team brings deep expertise in Shopify Plus, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure -- helping clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.

Job Summary

Lazer is seeking an experienced Delivery Manager to lead the development of enterprise eCommerce platforms on Shopify. In this role, you will own the client relationship, manage budgets, and oversee the entire project lifecycle from strategy to execution. Acting as the primary liaison between enterprise clients and Lazer’s internal teams, you’ll ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards.

You will drive the strategic direction of projects, manage competing priorities, and foster collaboration across cross-functional teams. Your expertise in eCommerce, particularly Shopify, coupled with your project and product management skills, will empower you to lead complex platform migrations and deliver innovative solutions for enterprise clients.

The Role



- Client Relationship Management:

- Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, owning the client relationship and ensuring satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives to align project deliverables with business objectives.
- Act as the client's trusted advisor, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth and innovation.
- Project Management:

- Oversee end-to-end project delivery for Shopify-based eCommerce platforms, including migrations and custom implementations.
- Create and manage comprehensive project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and milestones.
- Ensure project objectives align with client business drivers and are delivered on time and within budget.
- Monitor and manage dependencies, risks, and issues, providing regular updates to stakeholders.
- Product Ownership:

- Define and prioritize product roadmaps, requirements, and user stories in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
- Work closely with developers, designers, and QA engineers to ensure the successful implementation of features and functionalities.
- Triage and manage defects, ensuring high-quality deliverables and securing QA sign-off.
- Collaboration and Governance:

- Facilitate communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams, third-party vendors, and clients.
- Provide regular governance updates, including status reports, budget tracking, and resource utilization.
- Supervise third-party solutions to ensure successful integration and alignment with project goals.
Requirements



- Professional Experience:

- Proven experience as a Delivery Manager, Product Owner, Digital Project Manager, or similar role, with a focus on eCommerce and retail.
- Extensive knowledge of Shopify Plus and its ecosystem, including platform migrations, custom development, and integrations.
- Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex project portfolios.
- Client Engagement Skills:

- Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives.
- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Project Management Expertise:

- Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including experience with Scrum or Kanban frameworks.
- Proven track record of delivering large-scale eCommerce solutions on time and within budget.
- Expertise in creating and managing project plans, tracking dependencies, and mitigating risks.
- Leadership and Collaboration:

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and align cross-functional teams.
- Demonstrable ability to resolve disputes, overcome challenges, and maintain a positive attitude in high-pressure situations.
- Required Qualifications:

- Experience in managing platform migrations from systems like Magento, Salesforce, or BigCommerce to Shopify Plus.
- Familiarity with ERP, OMS, and CMS integrations (e.g., NetSuite, Sanity, or Manhattan).
- Shopify certifications are a plus.
AI in our hiring process

We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.

Why Work With Us



- 🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast.
- 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.
- 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.
- 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.

Why This Might Not Be For You



- 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.
- 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.
- 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.
- 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.

Benefits & Perks



- 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!
- 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.
- 🩺 Employee Care: We provide full benefits (healthcare, dental, vision) for our employees (401k for our US employees)
- 🏖️ Unlimited PTO: Everyone needs a break. Take at least 15 days off a year, and more if you need—just be cool about it and keep the team in mind.
- 🎉 Regular Team Retreat: Join us for a week of team bonding at amazing destinations. Recent trips include the Dominican Republic, Cancun, and Hawaii — plus ones welcome.

Bioanalytical Program Lead – client dedicated

Location: UK or Sweden (remote/home based)

Thermo Fisher's clinical research business is a leading global contract research organization and world leader in serving science. We are passionate, deliberate, and driven by our mission – to enable our clients to make the world healthier, safer, and cleaner.

Within our Analytical Services team, we have a functional service provider solution, which is an outstanding partnership that allows our customers to use the experience of our staff, while allowing you, the employee, to gain direct experience working onsite at a pharmaceutical/ biopharmaceutical company, all while maintaining full-time benefits.

Role Summary
This is a client dedicated role where you will be working as part of our customer’s global biopharma team. As a Bioanalytical Program Lead you will be leading the design and implementation of robust bioanalytical strategies. This role is pivotal in ensuring lab-based activities are aligned with context of use. You will be working in a matrix environment, managing aspects such as experimental design and tech transfer. This role requires close interaction with other scientific and technical staff in the lab. If you have a strong track record in regulated bioanalysis supporting therapeutic modalities across a range of therapeutic areas, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Responsibilities:
You will interact closely with scientists who are primarily lab based, and you will be required to aid in experimental design where required. This is a highly visible role, and you will be required to use your scientific knowledge and expertise while working with a range of collaborators and cross functional groups. You will also work with regulatory agencies and Health Authorities across a range of countries and geographies to mitigate risk, submit regulatory documents and respond to Health Authority questions.

Essential Skills/Experience:

BSc in relevant subject with 10+ yrs experience in Bioanalysis required

Proven experience as a Subject matter Expert in regulated bioanalysis across a range of modalities PK/CK, PD and immunogenicity assessments (humoral and cellular)

Experienced as a bioanalytical lead in diverse project teams, defining, leading and implementing robust bioanalytical strategy to advance the portfolio including Biomarker & Target Engagement strategy for dose decision endpoints.

Skilled scientist able to discern the advantages and pitfalls of a range of analytical techniques such as molecular assays (ddPCR, qPCR, RT-qPCR), flow cytometry, ELISpot, viral assays, cytokine assays, ligand binding assays and Mass Spectrometry.

Deep understanding of small & large molecule Bioanalysis

Experienced in regulated bioanalysis for multiple drug modalities.

Proven publication and presentation record

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in English essential

Desirable Skills/Experience:

Experience of working in a matrix environment

Knowledge of Immunology and or metabolic diseases

Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement

If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough

About Kinaxis:

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

About the team:

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in UK or Ireland.

About the team

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the strategic technical advisor for Kinaxis’
most complex and strategic customers. This role develops deep expertise in customer
environments and business processes, providing leadership and guidance that helps customers
maximize solution value, improve operational performance, and achieve long-term business
outcomes.

As a recognized subject matter expert, the TAM proactively manages solution health, identifies
optimization opportunities, mitigates technical risk, and leads complex customer initiatives that
drive adoption, stability, scalability, and retention. This role partners closely with Customer
Success, Product Management, Support, Cloud Operations, and customer Centres of
Excellence (CoEs) to influence both customer outcomes and internal product and service
improvements.

About the role:

What you will do

Serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of strategic customers.
Develop deep expertise in customer environments, business processes, and solution
architecture.
Lead technical reviews to identify risks, optimization opportunities, and improvement
plans.
Investigate complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution.
Recommend and implement solution improvements, engaging cross functional teams as
scope and complexity require. Maintain technical ownership of customer production
environments and overall solution health.
Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Cloud Operations
to drive customer outcomes.
Advise customers on best practices, platform capabilities, and evolving business
requirements.
Identify recurring issues, product gaps, and enhancement opportunities to improve
customer outcomes.
Contribute to TAM standards, methodologies, and knowledge sharing across the
organization

What we are looking for

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
7+ years in customer-facing technical such as Technical Account Manager, Solution Consultant, Customer Success Engineer, or similar positions.
3+ years of hands-on Kinaxis Maestro experience (solution development/authoring, configuration, integrations/data flows, and troubleshooting)
Deep expertise supporting enterprise SaaS solutions and complex customer environments.
Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and technical problem-solving skills.
Proven ability to influence technical and business stakeholders and build trusted customer relationships.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex customer initiatives and work independently in ambiguous environments.
Experience in supply chain, planning, logistics, manufacturing, or related enterprise business processes preferred.
Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, data analysis, reporting, or scripting tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to travel to customer sites

#Senior #LI-CS1

Why join Kinaxis?:

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Want to be a part of a company that’s making a difference?

We’re a growing global tech company, with huge potential for curious and caring minds, committed to each other, to deliver solutions that protect people and the planet for future generations. Our team of experts are focused on creating meaningful impact and making a real difference for our customers.

🌍 Impact: A strong connection to our mission through product, customer and impact is essential. We protect people and the planet by helping businesses mitigate risks and create safer, healthier workplaces.

💡 Innovation: Trusted by over 11,000 customers, you’ll have the chance to work with industry experts and thought leaders, dedicated to driving positive change. We believe in fostering a trusting environment that empowers our team to grow, innovate, and succeed.

📈 Growth: Connect commercial growth to personal growth opportunities. Benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities for ambitious professionals seeking development in a rapidly expanding sector.

We're on a mission to protect people and the planet by building and deploying transformative software. We need everyone's energy and commitment, regardless of region or rank, to make that mission a reality for millions more customers.

Our culture code, a set of principles that underpins our values, is our commitment to each other and working better together.

Join EcoOnline and be part of a mission dedicated to driving positive change. Read on to learn more about the opportunity and how you can have a positive impact!

About The Role

As our Product Owner you will play a key role in delivering safety-critical software used by emergency services, government agencies, corporate resilience and business continuity teams when it matters most.

Sitting within our Product Operations team, you will own day-to-day product delivery for D4H, translating approved roadmap initiatives into high-quality, measurable and supportable software deliverables. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, QA and operational stakeholders to ensure teams have the clarity, direction and product decisions needed to deliver effectively.

This is an opportunity to help evolve a trusted, proven platform as it scales into new markets and connects into EcoOnline’s broader EcoOne platform, including identity, data and analytics, and dedicated AI platform services.

You will play a key role in helping EcoOnline move customers from compliance to visibility to prediction, with AI becoming a first-class capability that supports crisis readiness, incident response and operational resilience.

Key Responsibilities



- Translate roadmap initiatives into deliverable product solutions, increments, epics, features and user stories.
- Own backlog quality and prioritisation, ensuring engineering teams have clear, actionable and well-defined requirements.
- Use AI day-to-day to accelerate specification writing, backlog grooming, data analysis and QA acceptance.
- Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to shape solutions that balance customer needs, technical constraints and delivery timelines.
- Manage delivery scope while protecting agreed objectives, escalating significant changes where strategic decisions are required.
- Provide timely product direction throughout delivery, resolving day-to-day questions around execution, operations and implementation.
- Coordinate release readiness, including documentation, release notes, operational preparation and successful deployment.
- Define clear acceptance criteria, support testing and quality assurance, and ensure delivered capabilities can be measured after release.
- Use customer feedback and product data to support continuous improvement and maintain high product quality.
- Factor AI governance, data-handling considerations and model limitations into product design, acceptance criteria and delivery decisions. 

What We're Looking For



- 2+ years’ experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager delivering software products.
- Fluent, practical and daily use of AI tools to write specs, groom backlogs, analyse information and move faster.
- Demonstrated technical fluency, with the ability to work confidently with Engineering and Architecture teams.
- Experience influencing without authority and driving decisions across multiple R&D teams or stakeholder groups.
- Experience shipping AI-built or AI-designed product features, with an understanding of what makes an AI capability production-ready, trustworthy and usable in high-stakes environments.
- Strong backlog and delivery management skills across epics, stories, acceptance criteria and the software development lifecycle.
- Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, data models and system architecture.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities across internal teams.
- Working knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, such as prompting, RAG, model limitations and evaluation.
- Awareness of AI governance, data sensitivity and compliance considerations in regulated, multi-region product environments.
- Ideally, experience in public safety, emergency management, crisis or business continuity, or other safety-critical or mission-critical software environments.
- Curiosity, pace and commercial awareness, with the ability to understand the “why” behind product decisions and keep delivery moving.

Our Benefits

We offer a variety of global benefits which are listed below! Please note a country-specific breakdown will be provided during your interview process.



- 🌴 Generous Paid Time Off
- 🍼 Extended Parental Leave
- ❤️‍🩹 Robust Health Coverage

Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead

As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Senior Project Manager for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams.

PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets.

What You Will Do



- Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software implementations, from kickoff through go-live and handover.
- Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run.
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards.
- Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.
- Partner with the VP of CS and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures.
- Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start.
- Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems.

Who You Are



- 5+ years of project management experience, ideally as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Implementation Manager, or Professional Services Manager, within a formal PMO, high-growth software, consulting, or enterprise technology environment.
- Direct experience running enterprise software deployments or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex implementations succeed or fail.
- Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework.
- Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers.
- Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar).
- Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential.
- Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred).

What We Offer



- This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market.
- Based in Europe, you will be a key part of our strategic growth in this market and drive the development of a self sustained business.
- Work on technology that matters. Our physics-enabled digital twins are actively protecting global energy grids from increasingly common weather events and structural failure, meaning your operational excellence directly translates to a more resilient world.
- You will have the strategic autonomy to influence global operations, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission.

Compensation Range: £100K - £110K

Description

Are you an experienced Program Manager who thrives on bringing structure, momentum and clarity to complex transformation? Working closely with the HR Program Lead, HR Talent Lead, HR Leadership Team, workstream delivery teams and HRIT, you will ensure activities are well planned, coordinated, tracked and delivered against clear objectives and timelines. • Partner with workstream delivery teams and project managers to turn transformation objectives into practical delivery plans, milestones and execution roadmaps.

Qualifications

• Significant project or program management experience delivering complex global transformation in a large enterprise environment.
• Experience in HR transformation, operating model transformation, technology-enabled change or large-scale business change programs.
• A track record of managing multiple cross-functional projects or workstreams simultaneously, including dependencies, risks and stakeholder expectations.
• Experience supporting executive governance forums and preparing clear, decision-focused leadership reporting materials.
• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and meeting management skills, with the confidence to drive alignment and decisions in ambiguous environments.

Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

620664f590e45691.description:
We’re in the business of delivering awesome meals into everyone's home or office – fast.

We achieve this by building and running a superb website, suite of mobile apps, a complex logistical platform, a fleet of passionate drivers, and a global operation, all to help bring great food from the world's best-loved local restaurants to consumers with an unparalleled level of convenience. We don’t want people to have to suffer with bad takeaway delivered an age after they order.

About The Team

This role sits within the Express Integrations Team. You will be helping the hospitality industry grow as a member of the Technology org that is responsible for building the best food delivery platform for our first-party restaurant and grocery partners.

About The Role

You will be responsible for managing the integration efforts and relationships across multiple parties including restaurant & grocery partners, external technology providers and business stakeholders, to ensure clear visibility within each project and drive the project to successful completion.

This is a great opportunity to work with a diverse set of teams in a fast-changing environment and is integral to driving success as we grow. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week fro our London office, and you will report into our Senior Technical Integrations Manager.

What You'll Be Doing



- Technical integration ownership: Manage the end-to-end API technical integration of partners, from integration through to test planning, UAT, and production go-live, working with engineering and product to troubleshoot and resolve issues along the way.
- Detailed planning: You will manage pre-kickoff preparations, project kickoffs, project plans including milestones and all project communications to ensure the successful adoption of the product with our key accounts.
- Management throughout the lifecycle of a project: responsibilities include, but are not limited to creating rollout plans specific to each project, establishing go-live criteria and defining the owners of each stage, issue tracking and clearing, and communicating progress to the wider business. Throughout, you will need to anticipate bottlenecks, explore contingencies and provide escalation management throughout new product launches.
- Stakeholder management: This is a critical role for Deliveroo to make sure both external and internal teams are working toward the same goal and managing communication & changes as we roll out the product further. You’ll need to advocate for all stakeholders throughout the release cycle to ensure they have the support needed to succeed.
- Process optimisation: It’s essential that we learn from every launch, and get quicker and more streamlined every time. You’ll be responsible for identifying where we can improve, and making sure that we execute required changes across product and engineering, business, or POS teams.
- Analyse and aggregate feedback from our partners on our products and liaise with Product Management to assist in their prioritisation.

Requirements



- Understanding of API integrations
- 5 yrs relevant experience in Technical Integrations Management, Technical Programme Management or similar roles
- Technical understanding and ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audience
- Ability to manage technical configuration of SaaS-like solutions
- Comfort troubleshooting technical issues using data tools
- Willingness to take responsibility, run multiple projects simultaneously, and drive them forward without close supervision
- Experience working with product and engineering teams
- Very good working knowledge of Jira, Confluence & Jira Service Management
- Excellent communication, organisation and project planning skills with emphasis on technology
- Demonstrated stakeholder management / relationship building skills
- Ability to hold each party responsible for their actions

You May Have



- Experience leveraging AI tooling as a means to improve your and the team’s productivity.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

6213ca46eb97f0d8.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Brand Insight & Effectiveness Team 👋

Our Brand Insight & Effectiveness team helps Trainline stay close to its customers by delivering high-quality research, clear insight and commercially grounded recommendations across our UK and International markets. The team plays an important role in shaping customer-first thinking, helping colleagues understand audiences, evaluate brand and marketing performance, and make confident decisions based on evidence.

As Market Research Lead, you will bring strong quantitative research expertise and a curiosity for how AI-led approaches can improve the way we work. You will lead a varied range of research projects, partner closely with Brand, Marketing, Data Science, UX Research and Effectiveness teams, and help the business turn insight into action across multiple markets.

In this role as the Market Research Lead , you will...🚄

 - Lead quantitative market research projects from brief through to delivery, including survey design, methodology development, analysis and reporting across areas such as audience segmentation, concept and creative testing, brand health tracking and campaign evaluation.

 - Own and evolve key reporting outputs, including the Brand Tracker, ensuring stakeholders are engaged, informed and able to use insights confidently in their decision-making.

 - Analyse and interpret data independently and in partnership with teams such as Data Science, UX Research and Marketing Effectiveness, bringing together multiple sources of evidence to create clear, actionable narratives.

 - Identify opportunities to use AI-led approaches to improve research quality, efficiency and insight generation, helping the team test new ways of working while maintaining strong research standards.

 - Work closely with Senior Brand Managers, Brand Directors and wider Marketing teams to ensure brand and marketing strategies are grounded in relevant customer insight and robust data.

 - Manage third-party research suppliers across qualitative and quantitative projects, from briefing and relationship management through to delivery, budget tracking and ensuring outputs meet business needs.

 - Proactively spot opportunities where research can help answer business questions, shape decisions or unlock a deeper understanding of customers, markets and campaign performance.

 - Support non-research colleagues by building simple processes for self-service projects, such as creative testing, and helping wider teams engage effectively with existing research and data sources.
   
   

 - We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Significant hands-on experience in a market research role, either agency-side, client-side or through an equivalent background, with strong quantitative research capability.

 - Experience implementing, experimenting with or a strong interest in AI-led approaches within market research, insight or marketing effectiveness.

 - Confidence designing research methodologies, writing surveys, analysing data, creating reports and presenting findings in a way that is clear, engaging and tailored to different audiences.

 - The ability to combine multiple data sources, including qualitative and quantitative insight, into a coherent story that gets to the “so what?” and supports business decision-making.

 - Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex findings into practical recommendations for stakeholders across different teams.

 - Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, suppliers and timelines while keeping work focused on impact.

 - A collaborative approach and confidence working with cross-functional partners such as Brand, Marketing, Data Science, UX Research and Effectiveness teams.

Bonus points if you have...

 - Multi-market research experience across markets such as the UK, France, Italy, Spain or the US

 - Experience using tools such as YouGov Crunch.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Responsibilities
Role Overview
At Monetization Product Operations (MPO) our goal is to help businesses have seamless experiences with our advertising solutions, by designing and scaling support processes to resolve technical issues within our product. We're a global team with regional hubs in Singapore, Japan, China, London and multiple locations in the US.

This role focuses on troubleshooting advertising performance issues(overbidding, high CPA/low ROI/tROAS, low/no spending etc) across advertiser-facing products and internal support workflows. The candidate will act as a bridge between advertisers, internal operations teams, PMs, and RDs, helping identify, investigate, and resolve delivery performance problems in a structured way.

The role covers ticket investigation, customer feedback analysis, product support enablement, knowledge base development(runbook/SOP), and dashboard maintenance. It is suitable for candidates with 2-5 years of experience in customer support, technical support, product operations, or a related support function, especially if they have exposure to advertising products or campaign performance analysis.

Key Responsibilities
- Investigate technical and product issues raised by internal stakeholders and advertisers through ticketing systems, with a focus on campaign delivery and performance symptoms.
- Support the launch and adoption of new advertising products and features by preparing support resources, troubleshooting guides, and enablement materials.
- Contribute to ticket quality review, issue categorization, knowledge management, and support process improvement across regional and global teams.
- Extract qualitative and quantitative feedback from ticketing systems and data platforms, then organize issues by type, customer scale, impact scope, and resolution priority.
- Translate advertiser pain points into actionable inputs for Product and Engineering, including issue background, reproduction conditions, affected scope, metric evidence, and suggested priority.
- Work with regional technical product teams and support teams to balance global troubleshooting standards with local market requirements.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Understanding how an ad goes from creation and review to delivery, spend, conversion, and attribution, and where anomalies may occur along this path.
- Being able to distinguish advertiser setup issues, product policy changes, data delay, system incidents, and market fluctuations.
- Using time-series comparison, segmentation, funnel breakdown, and WoW/DoD movement to locate performance anomalies.
- Tracking key metrics such as spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA, CVR, CTR, and budget utilization.
- Providing Product and Engineering with clear reproduction conditions, affected scope, metric evidence, and prioritization rationale.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

637ff9f6a7740562.description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

Requirements:

7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

Brand:
TripleTen

What you will do:

Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently
Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

What we can offer you:

Fully remote work.
A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

As a Program Manager on the Global Professional Services team at Planet, you will drive complex projects focused on helping scale governmental customer adoption of the Planet Platform and its data products. You will work with cross-functional teams, both technical and non-technical, to define project methodology and strategy across a project portfolio. In this role, you will also contribute to business development efforts by working with Planet’s proposal team to deliver proposals related to Planet’s platform and data solutions for defense & intelligence (D&I) customers.

This position will appeal to candidates with a keen interest in defense & intelligence and applications of remote sensing data. The ideal candidate is process-driven and has a desire to improve ways of working to scale development cycles. Ideal candidates are excited to work as part of a global team, adapt quickly and have a growth mindset.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, UK or Slovenia. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own



- Work closely with Professional Services Engineers, PreSales, Product Management, and other teams to design and deliver reliable platform and data solutions
- Lead the development of proposals for D&I customers by gathering technical inputs, articulating value propositions, and aligning with mission needs
- Partner with internal and external stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, and success metrics
- Translate business and technical requirements into actionable and clear deliverables
- Scope and manage detailed project schedules; drive execution of project scope; proactively identify and mitigate risks; track project costs and budget
- Deliver consistent project updates to customers and internal stakeholders on progress, adjustments and strategy
- Design and implement processes for operational excellence and scalability
- Continuously improve ways of working and processes by monitoring business workflows and identifying inefficiencies
- Manage contracts with subcontractors, including task assignment, deliverable tracking, and budget management
- Measure project performance and customer satisfaction to improve future delivery

What You Bring



- 6+ years of experience in project management experience, including experience supporting proposal development for government or defense-sector customers
- Bachelor’s degree in a related field
- Experience preparing and contributing to technical proposals
- Experience working with or as part of the Defense and Intelligence community
- Ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects in a technical or product development setting
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to independently manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in dynamic environments
- A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to balance day-to-day responsibilities with forward-looking improvements

What Makes You Stand Out



- Experience developing proposals for federal customers
- Understanding of platform development, platform integrations, or geospatial data-as-a-service offerings
- Experience with remote sensing, EO data, or imaging technologies
- Ability to be proactive in initiating efforts to improve existing programs or develop new initiatives
- Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management skills
- Experience working with globally distributed teams

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview

The Deputy Director, Supply Chain Business Development and Program Delivery is a senior global role responsible for making IRC's supply chains fit for scale across its most ambitious health and humanitarian programming commitments. The role is designed to translate strategic program targets into operational supply chain solutions that work at country level and ensuring country realities shape global supply chain strategy in return.

The role has three integrated areas of responsibility.

 It serves as a primary GSC lead and contributor to business development: identifying, designing, and positioning supply chain funding opportunities with institutional and non-traditional donors, and leading supply chain sections of competitive proposals.

It provides support across IRC's Impact at Scale (I@S) thematic supply chains, driving end-to-end performance from demand planning and forecasting through sourcing, pre-positioning, and last-mile delivery.

It builds country and regional capacity to sustain health supply chain improvements over time, providing direct technical support, deploying to high-priority contexts, and harmonizing tools and SOPs across country programs in collaboration with Regional Supply Chain Directors (RSCDs) and other relevant Global Supply Chain (GSC) units and IRC stakeholder departments.

Reporting to the Director of Emergency and Health Supply Chain, the Deputy Director works in close collaboration with the Health Technical Unit, Global Procurement, Regional Supply Chain Directors, Country Programs, IT, Finance, and external partners including UNICEF, WHO, ECHO, and peer INGOs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Leadership for Program Delivery

The Deputy Director plays an active role in GSC’s business development (BD) function. Supply chain is an increasingly fundable programming area, with institutional donors such as ECHO, SIDA, Gates and non-traditional donors explicitly framing requirements around operational efficiency, commodity management, and supply chain innovation. Additionally, private and corporate donors have expressed specific interest in funding the optimization of health and emergency supply chains.

Act as the primary GSC focal point within I@S agile working groups and cross-functional scaling teams, ensuring supply chain planning is embedded in program design from the outset and not treated as a downstream implementation task.

Implement the strategic direction for cross-cutting supply chain enablers including pooled procurement, global pre-positioning frameworks, harmonized delivery models, and digital systems and oversee their development and rollout across priority country programs.

Provide supply chain leadership and oversight for the addition of any new I@S Ready to Scale thematic areas, ensuring new commodities and delivery models are integrated into IRC's global supply chain architecture without creating fragmentation or duplication.

Serve as GSC's coordinating focal point with the Research and Innovation Department, contributing to supply chain innovations including AI-enabled solutions.

2. Business Development & Resource Mobilization

Is responsible for operationalizing the BD strategy, assembling inputs to create compelling bids, gap filling in the BD process as needed/relevant, and driving ultimate bid success through correct donor intel and positioning, strong bid submission, and effective cross-functional collaboration.

Flag, track and route relevant funding opportunities to GSC Leadership and work closely with internal stakeholders to plan for staff needs and business development capacity requirements to successfully write and budget for winning bids based on the pipeline

Lead or co-lead the technical design of supply chain sections for proposals where GSC has a primary role, including narrative writing, logical framework development, and supply chain costing.

Collaborating with program and business development leads to embedding supply chain considerations into program design, with specific attention paid to Impact at Scale initiatives

Contribute to bid assessment, probability-of-winning analysis, and positioning strategy for supply chain funding opportunities with specific focus on I@S thematic areas

Develop and maintain GSC supply chain capability statements and value propositions relevant to I@S programming areas, for use in capture and proposal development.

Participate in the BD review cycle for proposals with significant supply chain components, ensuring technical quality and alignment with IRC’s global supply chain strategy.

Mobilize opportunities with non-traditional partners such as Airlink to improve program delivery and increase cost savings

Take the lead with External relations and other fundraising teams to enable increased use of GIK goods and services, enabling program delivery whilst making IRC more cost effective.

Build and maintain donor intelligence on supply chain funding streams

Support pre-award activities including donor engagement, capture visits, and key personnel recruitment where relevant to I@S supply chain opportunities.

Coordinate with Regional Supply Chain Directors and country programs to ensure country-level supply chain needs and evidence are reflected in proposals.

Contribute to after-action reviews following award decisions to capture lessons and improve future supply chain BD submissions.

Identify and evaluate opportunities for business development & partnerships with academic or research centers, with Research & Innovation colleagues as appropriate.

3. Implementation of Strategic Initiatives Supporting Impact @ Scale

Strengthening global forecasting and demand planning systems for key health commodities.

Collaborate with Global Procurement to define sourcing strategies, monitor supplier performance, and ensure security of supply.

Lead global visibility efforts by consolidating country-level data on demand, pipeline status, consumption, and stock risks. Collaborate with GSC Systems and Data to digitalize as many aspects of this as possible in a timely manner.

Work with country teams to improve quantification, storage, distribution planning, and last-mile delivery.

Translate I@S targets into actionable supply chain plans with milestones, KPIs, and risk controls.

Design and support the rollout of cross-country improvements (e.g., pooled procurement feasibility, centralized pre-positioning, LMIS integration, preferred vendor strategies, emergency surge mechanisms, harmonized delivery models).

Support the implementation of the supply chain I@S bodies of work.

Escalate and advise GSC Leadership on global priorities, risks, and mitigation strategies impacting success of I@S activity plans.

4. Capacity Building, Country Support & Operational Strengthening

Provide specialized technical support to country supply chain and health teams.

Strengthening country practices in forecasting, contingency planning, supplier management, and stock-out prevention.

Support countries facing pipeline risks or operational bottlenecks; deploy to high-priority locations as needed.

Promote best practices and harmonize tools, guidance, and SOPs across all countries, regions and departments.

Train country and departmental staff as required. Develop e-training as funding permits.

5. Monitoring, KPIs, Reporting & Knowledge Management

Develop supply chain KPIs aligned to IRC’s LMIS, BD and I@S objectives.

Produce timely reports on global health supply chain performance, risks, and mitigation actions.

Document lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.

Maintain updated knowledge of global markets, procurement trends, supplier landscapes, regulatory shifts, and donor funding priorities relevant to supply chain programming.

Qualifications

Education

Master's degree in public health, pharmacy, supply chain management, strategy development, , international development, international relations, or relevant field or equivalent combination of education and work experience background is required or related field.

Work Experience

Experience in supply chain management in humanitarian settings, preferably with demonstrable experience in health supply chains, especially immunization, nutrition and sexual and reproductive health (SRH).

Proven experience in departmental or organizational strategy development in operations / supply chain in humanitarian organizations.

Expertise in forecasting, strategic sourcing, procurement, quality assurance, and distribution of health commodities including in the context of vaccine storage and distribution.

Experience in conducting assessments and evaluations of supply chain systems.

Experience engaging in business development processes, including writing and project design, proposal development, donor positioning, or capture for supply chain or health programming is strongly preferred.

Experience in developing and managing project concepts and funding proposals for humanitarian / development work with the ability to turn concepts and strategy into measurable action

Strong capacity to understand the humanitarian system and operating context and coordinate the relevant technical inputs from within and outside GSC

Familiarity with donor landscapes for supply chain programming (e.g., ECHO, SIDA, USAID, Gates) and ability to contribute to donor engagement and positioning.

Familiarity with managing large-scale, complex portfolio and experience using strategic insights and data from varied sources to support portfolio management, pivoting and alignment to organizational and sectoral goals

Experience in building partnerships for development and humanitarian funding as well as negotiation of programmatic and financial contractual arrangements with donors and partners

Experience and comfort interrogating partnership practices and familiarity with emerging developments including growing attention to power-shifting, localization and technical assistance models for INGOs

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Proficiency in data analysis, visualization tools (Power BI), and performance monitoring.

Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills and ability to analyses trends based on a diverse set of data and insights

Digital supply chain literacy: familiarity with LMIS platforms, supply chain technology ecosystems, and data interoperability standards in humanitarian or low-resource settings. Experience with using AI-enabled solutions preferred.

Ability to identify fundable supply chain programming opportunities and experience in business development writing and proposal design

Ability to translate operational supply chain experience into compelling proposal narratives and capability statements.

Demonstrated ability to work with stakeholders at multiple levels and influence decision making

Knowledge of public and private fundraising - appetite and curiosity about building collaborative pathways with philanthropy and private sector

Fluent in English (required); proficiency in French, Spanish or Arabic.

Competencies

Strong project management and coordination skills.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in supply chain optimization.

Good organizational skills and ability to prioritize competing priorities effectively.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities; skills; ability to work cross-functionally and across cultures.

A sense of curiosity about how things can be done, and a willingness to get creative on solutioning.

Attention to detail and ability to identify and address potential risks proactively.

Commitment to ethical standards and accountability.

Key Relationships

Reports to: Director, Emergency & Health Supply Chain

Directly Supervises: N/A

Internal: Global Supply Chain, Health Technical Unit, IT, Regional Supply Chain Directors, Health Coordinators/teams and Supply Chain Coordinators/Teams; Pharmacists; GOAT BD Coordinator; GSC BD pipeline monitoring

External: Peer INGOs, UN agencies (UNICEF, WHO), institutional donors (ECHO, SIDA, Unitaid, USAID), implementing partners, HLGSC members

Additional Information

Frequent travel to program countries will be required up to 20%.

This position may involve collaboration with government agencies, international NGOs, private-sector partners, and institutional donors.

The role actively participates in IRC’s BD process, including pipeline monitoring, capture, and proposal development for supply chain funding opportunities.

Working Environment

Remote work / standard office (location dependent)

This is a remote position open to internal candidates based in countries where IRC operates who have the right to work in their location. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale.

This role is open to candidates located and with the right to work in United Kingdom, Kenya, and Lebanon.

Compensation: (UK Pay Rate: £58,476-£69,440/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

Role overview

The Delivery Manager will be accountable for the day-to-day delivery performance of a product or service team at AWTG. The role focuses on building motivated teams, removing obstacles, managing delivery flow and helping multidisciplinary teams deliver high-quality outcomes for clients and users. You will work with multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, cloud, data, AI, product, QA and client delivery to create practical outcomes for clients and end users.

Key responsibilities



- Build and maintain motivated delivery teams with clear ways of working, priorities, cadence and responsibilities.
- Facilitate planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, reviews and delivery governance appropriate to the team context.
- Track and manage risks, issues, blockers and dependencies, escalating appropriately when delivery is at risk.
- Keep the team focused on the highest-value work and the outcomes needed for users, clients and the business.
- Encourage continuous improvement, reflective practice and effective collaboration across technical and non-technical team members.
- Communicate progress, delivery confidence, plans and blockers clearly to stakeholders.
- Support supplier coordination, budget tracking and reporting where relevant to the delivery context.

Essential Skills And Experience



- Experience supporting or managing delivery within Agile or Lean product and service teams.
- Good understanding of delivery life cycles, planning, prioritisation, forecasting and team capacity management.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Ability to facilitate collaboration, resolve team issues and create an environment where teams can deliver.
- Experience using delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Trello, Confluence or similar.
- Ability to use evidence and delivery data to inform planning, improve flow and provide delivery confidence.

Desirable Skills And Experience



- Experience delivering software, data, AI, cloud or digital transformation products and services.
- Familiarity with service standards, product life cycle phases, reporting dashboards and delivery metrics.
- Experience working in client-facing, supplier-led or multidisciplinary project environments.

What success looks like



- The team has a clear plan, sustainable rhythm and shared understanding of priorities.
- Blockers, risks and dependencies are visible, tracked and resolved before they materially affect delivery.
- Delivery outputs support user needs, client objectives and business outcomes.
