About Us:


At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About The Role

We're looking for an outcomes-first Delivery Program Manager to own complex, cross-functional initiatives from idea through to realised impact. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders across R&D, translate ambiguous strategy into clear plans, unblock teams across functions, and follow value through to realisation. For you, "done" is the moment the customer and business outcome lands.

What You Will Do:

Own End-to-End Program Delivery




- Drive complex programs from initiation through to value realisation, with integrated plans across scope, dependencies, milestones, risks, and value assumptions
- Translate product and business objectives into sharp execution plans with measurable outcomes


Drive Business Value Realisation (the core focus)




- Define outcomes, success metrics, and value hypotheses up front with Product and Business stakeholders
- Track adoption, impact, and realised value after release; surface gaps and drive corrective action


Lead Across Functions




- Coordinate across Product and Engineering teams, manage dependencies and critical paths, and facilitate program-level planning and retrospectives
- Create clarity where there is ambiguity, and momentum where there is friction


Govern, De-Risk, and Communicate




- Establish effective governance and reporting; identify and escalate risks early with clear options
- Deliver concise, outcome-focused updates to senior stakeholders


Raise the Bar




- Spot systemic delivery and value-realisation gaps, contribute to APMO standards and playbooks, and embed AI into day-to-day coordination and reporting


Measures of Success




- Programs delivered against committed business outcomes 
- Business value realised post-release (adoption, impact, ROI) 
- Cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, and Business 
- Early surfacing and resolution of risks and dependencies 
- Contribution to APMO maturity and ways of working 


What You Need to Succeed:




- 5+ years delivering complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end, including post-delivery outcome follow-up
- Deep delivery-at-scale expertise, with the judgement to adapt frameworks to context
- Strong working partnerships with Product Management and Engineering leadership
- A clear understanding of how product delivery connects to customer value and business results
- Comfortable challenging "done" until the outcome lands; builds credibility with stakeholders and welcomes productive friction
- Strong command of agile and hybrid delivery models; concise, structured, influence-led communication


Key Traits for Success




- Outcomes-first - prioritises impact over activity 
- Comfortable in ambiguity, and creates structure rather than waiting for it 
- Highly collaborative, with the confidence to push back when delivery drifts from value 
- Strong bias for action, experimentation, and continuous improvement 


Additional Skills That Will Set You Apart:




- Experience in Software as a Service (SaaS) or enterprise software environments 
- Exposure to value tracking or outcome frameworks 
- Track record of evolving existing norms 


Equal Opportunities at Sitecore 

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

BIGGLESWADE, United Kingdom

At Solina, our community of close to 5,000 people share a passion for food and live our entrepreneurial culture.

We design customised savoury solutions for our clients operating in the food industry, food service, butchery and nutrition markets. With sustainability at the heart of our business model, we aim to produce food that is good in every sense of the word: delicious, nourishing, affordable, sustainable and convenient.

By constantly rethinking culinary solutions, we make food matter for people and the planet.

If you're ready for a new adventure in a dynamic, expanding, passionate, international company, join us !

Solina is looking for an IT Project Manager with an industrial/manufacturing background to lead the delivery of enterprise application projects across our manufacturing sites and business functions.

You will manage end-to-end projects within our global IT Build organization, covering ERP, PLM, CRM, supply chain systems, and integrations. This role owns scope, planning, governance, budget, vendor coordination, deployment, and adoption. Run/Operations teams retain ownership of support; however, you will provide Level 3 expertise for complex incidents.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience delivering IT projects in an industrial, manufacturing, or production-driven environment, with a strong understanding of site operations, business processes, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

This position will be based in Biggleswade, UK.

Key Responsibilities

Demand intake & scoping



- Gather business needs and translate them into clear IT requirements and functional specifications.
- Challenge demand against the Group digital roadmap and standard solutions where relevant.
- Define scope, assumptions, constraints, success criteria and delivery approach (waterfall/agile/hybrid).
- Provide high-level estimations (effort/costs), resource needs and delivery options.

Planning, governance & reporting



- Build and maintain delivery plans (milestones, dependencies, resources, budget) and ensure execution.
- Define and run project governance (steering committees, project controls, regular status reporting).
- Maintain RAID management (Risk/Action/Issue/Decision logs) and drive timely decisions.
- Coordinate cross-program dependencies and ensure consistent reporting to leadership.
- Be the contact person for the business and IT project members

Budget & vendor management



- Estimate workload and costs (internal effort, licenses, external partners) and manage budget tracking.
- Participate in RFPs, vendor selection and contracting support; review statements of work.
- Control subcontractor effectiveness and delivery quality throughout the engagement; manage change requests.

Solution delivery & quality



- Coordinate design/build/configuration, integrations, data migration and deployment across IT teams and partners.
- Define and manage testing strategy (SIT/UAT), acceptance criteria, defect management and release readiness.
- Ensure testing is evidence-based (test results reviewed, logs checked where relevant) and includes end-to-end validation reflecting production constraints (e.g., printing/scanning or other peripherals when applicable).
- Ensure documentation is produced and kept up to date (solution, procedures, handover pack).

Change, deployment & adoption



- Prepare and execute cutover/go-live plans, communications, training and hypercare.
- Support change management and business readiness activities; ensure stakeholder alignment.
- Ensure operational risk is controlled through readiness checks, testing evidence and structured transition to Run.

Transition to Run & Level 3 expertise



- Plan and execute structured transition to Run (knowledge transfer, service acceptance, support model, KPIs).
- Provide Level 3 functional/technical expertise for complex incidents/major problems (Run remains the ticket owner).
- Support root cause analysis and corrective action plans with Run teams and vendors to prevent recurrence.

Business analysis support for small/medium initiatives



- For smaller initiatives (e.g., local apps, workflow automation), facilitate workshops, document requirements and translate them into actionable work items and acceptance criteria.
- For large programmes (e.g., ERP rollouts), coordinate with product owners, business analysts and solution leads to ensure a complete and validated requirements baseline.

Success measures (examples)



- Milestones delivered on time with controlled scope and documented decisions.
- Budget and vendor performance effectively managed with clear accountability.
- Go-lives executed with stable hypercare, clean operational handover and limited disruption to plants.
- High stakeholder satisfaction and measurable adoption of delivered solutions.
- Reduced recurrence of major issues through effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Your Profile



- 6/8 years of IT project management experience (with an industrial background)
- Proven ERP or enterprise application implementation experience regarding production and/or supply chain
- Solid understanding of integrations, APIs, and data migration
- Experience in manufacturing and multi-site environments preferred
- Strong stakeholder management across functions and geographies
- PMP certification preferred; Agile certification is a plus
- Fluent English required
- Professional ethics
- Willingness to travel

If you are comfortable operating in an international environment and driving structured, high-quality delivery across complex landscapes, we invite you to apply.

We are open to talents of all backgrounds. Our recruitment process is based on competences, and we openly welcome all candidates of all types according to our DEI Commitment

Please note: You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy. Cancer Research UK is not able to offer visa sponsorship.

At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.

We are professionals with purpose, beating cancer every day. But we need to go much further and much faster. That’s why we are looking for someone talented, someone who shares our vision, someone like you.

We are looking for a Bank Nurse to join our team. You’ll join a team of Bank Nurses that provides vital contingency cover where needed to Cancer Research UK’s nurse-led face-to-face cancer awareness and health promotion activity across the UK.

In this role, you’ll inform and empower people to make positive changes for their health and promote early diagnosis through providing face-to-face information in hard-to-reach audiences.

What will I be doing?

Face-to-face delivery of the latest cancer prevention and early detection information in an appropriate and relevant way
Providing cover on the Cancer Awareness Roadshow, working alongside a small team to engage the public in indoor and outdoor community settings through individual face-to-face conversations
Delivering face to face cancer awareness activities for people at their place of work with our Cancer Awareness in the Workplace team – typically health information stands and occasionally short presentations.

Supporting other cancer awareness activities and Cancer Research UK events
Representing Cancer Research UK in a positive and professional way and ensure that all information shared is in line with CRUK’s core messages
Responsible for collecting and inputting data for evaluation purposes and contributing to other general feedback
Ensuring familiarity with local stats and local health information sheets to tailor activity and enable effective signposting to local services.

What skills are you looking for?

Registered Adult Nurse - NMC registration is mandatory for this role and must always be maintained.
An interest in or experience of at least one of the following: health promotion, practice nursing, occupational health, health visiting, district/community nursing or other qualification/experience
Excellent verbal communication skills – an ability to engage people in conversation and to use motivational interviewing techniques while ensuring accuracy of information conveyed
Strong oral presentation skills, with the ability to convey clear and accurate information confidently and pitched appropriately for the audience
A clear, demonstrable understanding of boundaries and of the importance and need for always adhering to data protection and other compliance policies
Experience in delivering public-facing work, and a good understanding of the challenges associated with engaging hard to reach groups and addressing health inequalities
Excellent written, administration and organisation skills with the ability to keep accurate confidential records
Willingness to travel, including occasional unsocial hours work or overnight stays.

What will I gain?

Each and every one of our employees contributes to our progress and is supporting our work to beat cancer. We think that’s impressive.

In return, we make sure you are supported by a generous benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools, policies and processes to enable you to do your job well.

We review pay annually and aim to recognise individual performance and achievements.

We don’t forget people have lives outside of work too and so we actively encourage a flexible working culture.

Our work – from funding cutting-edge research to developing public policy – will change the world. It’s exciting to be part of our team.

For more information on this career opportunity please visit our website or contact us at recruitment@cancer.org.uk .

For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and YouTube.

Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.

We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen. Please contact recruitment@cancer.org.uk or 0 20 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

Unfortunately, we are unable to recruit anyone below the age of 18, so that we can protect young people from health & safety and safeguarding risks.

Our Vision 

uMed seeks to be a cornerstone of the efforts to reduce the burden of disease for patients by radically reducing the barriers to knowledge creation.

Join us.

Our Culture 

We are a group of trusting and inclusive individuals, who encourage, are creative and want to make a difference in the world. We do not take ourselves too seriously and we love to tell a story. We innovate, work hard and take risks but at the forefront is a joint mission to be part of groundbreaking research to ultimately advance and develop science to support those most in need.

What We Do

The process of conducting clinical research is incredibly expensive and time consuming, limiting our efforts to find answers to the world's most important medical challenges. uMed is a clinical research network fit for the 21st century, underpinned by cutting edge technology that connects patients, electronic health data and research groups across the world. Our rapidly growing network covers 90 GP sites in the UK representing over 2,000,000 patients with our first US healthcare system joining us this year bringing a further 5M patients. uMed was founded by an NHS doctor, supported by a world class board and backed by London and US based venture capital.

Life at uMed 

No matter what an organisation is trying to achieve, success or failure is inextricably linked to the people within it. For a young company, there is no redundancy, so this relationship is turned up to eleven.

At uMed we punch well above our weight due to the quality of the team we have built, and their dedication to our shared vision. Recognising this dedication, we have a fantastic benefits package and accompanying culture at uMed. This includes



- Private Health Insurance to keep you covered
- Pension Plan to help you secure your future
- 25 days of paid time off for your well-deserved breaks
- Work From Home equipment budget for a comfortable working space
- Flexible Benefits platform tailored to your needs
- Enjoy your Birthday Day Off on us!
- Eye-test vouchers for Specsavers to look after your eyesight
- Coworking policy - catch up with the team as regularly as once a week
- Enhanced Parental Leave

The role

The Director of Product & Delivery is responsible for leading the successful execution of uMed's application product roadmap, ensuring that the Application Product, Delivery, and Product Operations functions work effectively together to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), this role provides day-to-day leadership of the Application Product, Delivery and Product Operations functions. Working closely with the CPTO, the Director will ensure strategic priorities are translated into achievable delivery plans and executed predictably, efficiently and to a high standard.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines operational leadership with active involvement throughout the product delivery lifecycle. The Director provides leadership, coaching, and support across product planning, delivery planning, release readiness, and UAT, ensuring the team has the clarity, structure, and support needed to deliver successfully. The role will lead the Application Product Manager, Product Designer, Scrum Master, and Product Operations Specialist.

The Director will work closely with Application Engineering, QA, and the Data team to manage dependencies and ensure the successful delivery of application roadmap priorities.

Requirements

Product Planning and Execution



- Work closely with the CPTO to plan, coordinate, and deliver the application product roadmap
- Ensure agreed priorities are translated into clear, sequenced and achievable delivery plans
- Support the Application Product Manager and Product Designer in ensuring initiatives, epics and stories are sufficiently defined before development begins
- Ensure business requirements, operational considerations, dependencies and compliance requirements are understood and incorporated into delivery plans
- Maintain visibility of progress, risks, blockers and resource constraints across the application roadmap
- Escalate significant delivery issues to the CPTO with clear recommendations and proposed mitigations
- Support prioritization decisions by providing visibility of delivery impact, dependencies and team capacity
- Build effective working relationships with Engineering, Data, QA, Compliance and other business functions to ensure successful product delivery. 

Delivery Leadership



- Lead the day-to-day execution of the application product roadmap
- Work closely with the Scrum Master to maintain effective planning, refinement, sprint and release cadences
- Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, clearly understood and actively managed
- Monitor progress against agreed plans and intervene early where delivery is at risk
- Remove blockers and coordinate the resolution of cross-functional dependencies
- Work closely with Engineering, QA and the Data team to ensure work progresses effectively from definition through development, testing and release
- Ensure releases are appropriately planned, tested, communicated and operationally ready
- Drive continuous improvement of delivery processes, team effectiveness and ways of working
- Balance delivery pace with quality, technical sustainability and operational stability

Product Leadership



- Coach and support the product team throughout the product lifecycle
- Provide hands-on support during periods of high delivery demand, complex initiatives or where additional leadership is needed
- Act as an escalation point for product decisions, delivery challenges and prioritization
- Ensure usability, accessibility and consistency are considered throughout the development lifecycle. 
- Participate in UAT, release readiness and key product activities to help ensure successful delivery
- Maintain a detailed understanding of the application product, user workflows and operational processes to effectively support the team and remove delivery barriers
- Ensure the product team maintains a consistent, high-quality approach to product management, product design, and delivery

Platform Operations



- Lead the Platform Operations function and ensure operational product activities are completed accurately and consistently
- Oversee platform configuration and other operational processes owned by the Product team
- Ensure appropriate controls, review processes and documentation are in place for configuration changes
- Support the operational readiness of new features, studies and product releases
- Ensure internal documentation, release notes, user guidance and process documentation are accurate and kept up to date
- Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve controls and automate repeatable operational processes
- Ensure recurring operational issues are identified and addressed through sustainable improvements rather than manual workarounds

Team Leadership & Development



- Directly manage the Application Product Manager, Product Designer, Scrum Master and Platform Operations Specialist
- Set clear objectives, priorities and expectations across the team
- Provide regular coaching, mentoring and constructive feedback
- Ensure responsibilities are clearly defined and effectively coordinated across the function
- Build a collaborative, accountable and delivery-focused culture
- Support recruitment, onboarding and capability development as the Product function grows
- Foster continuous learning and continuous improvement across the team

Essential Skills & Experience



- Experience working within healthcare, life sciences or another regulated industry. 
- Significant experience leading Product, Delivery or Program functions within a software, SaaS or technology organization
- Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products from concept through to release
- Strong practical experience of product management, including requirements definition, backlog management, prioritization, story writing, refinement and UAT
- Experience managing multidisciplinary teams including Product Managers, Product Designers, Delivery professionals and Platform Operations
- Excellent planning, organization and prioritization skills
- Strong understanding of Agile software development and modern product delivery practices
- Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives, competing priorities and cross-functional dependencies
- Strong leadership, coaching and people development skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Comfortable operating as a hands-on leader within a scaling organization
- Pragmatic, delivery-focused and able to balance strategic objectives with operational execution
- Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment is desirable.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

This role is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of WPP’s Service Management re-platform programme, replacing the current platform with a modern, AI-enabled service management capability.

You will be accountable for the planning, coordination, governance, and execution of a large-scale platform transformation, ensuring all workstreams are delivered in a controlled, structured, and timely manner.

Working under the Director of Service Delivery, you will coordinate cross-functional teams and strategic implementation partners, driving delivery across technology, process, data, integrations, and organisational change while ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, budget, and business outcomes.

This role requires a highly experienced programme delivery leader who can establish strong governance, manage complex dependencies, mitigate risk, and successfully deliver one of WPP’s most significant Service Management transformation programmes.

What you'll be doing:

Programme & Project Delivery



- Lead the end-to-end delivery plan for the Service Management Platform programme. 
- Define, construct, and maintain detailed, integrated project plans, identifying critical paths, key milestones, and cross-functional dependencies. 
- Ensure all delivery activities align perfectly with the agreed scope, budgets, timelines, and priorities defined by leadership. 
- Successfully coordinate multiple concurrent workstreams, including platform architectural rebuilds, data migration, global configuration, and multi-market rollouts. 

Execution Management



- Drive a high-performance culture of execution discipline and accountability across all hybrid and cross-functional delivery teams. 
- Proactively track workstream progress, pre-emptively identify delivery roadblocks, and swiftly resolve blockers. 
- Establish clear ownership and definition of “Done” across all technical and operational project tasks. 
- Maintain tight change-control management over project scope to prevent scope creep while remaining agile. 

Partner & Vendor Coordination



- Act as the primary operational integration point with key strategic partners, including Kyndryl and ServiceNow. 
- Align external delivery methodologies and delivery schedules with WPP's internal technical teams and business targets. 
- Strictly track partner deliverables, ensuring contractual and execution commitments are met. 
- Establish clear pathways for early escalation of partner-related risks, gaps, or dependencies. 

Governance & Reporting



- Design, implement, and lead robust programme governance structures, including Steering Committees, weekly delivery forums, and peer reviews. 
- Synthesise complex data to provide transparent, clear, and highly professional reporting on project progress, risks, issues, and dependencies. 
- Own and actively manage the programme RAID log, ensuring risk mitigation plans are executed. 
- Deliver structured, data-driven, and polished executive-ready updates for senior leadership. 

Planning, Adoption, and Rollout



- Orchestrate integrated sequencing plans across all workstreams to prepare the business for successful transition-to-service. 
- Coordinate deployment readiness activities including extensive User Acceptance Testing, training alignment, and change communication campaigns. 
- Monitor business readiness metrics and platform adoption progress, escalating risks that could impact successful business-as-usual transition. 

What you'll need:



- Extensive SDLC Experience: Proven experience leading strategic, highly complex enterprise technology migrations or platform implementations across the entire Software Development Life Cycle, with a track record of managing multiple project tracks simultaneously. 
- Service Management Platform Expertise: Direct experience managing Service Management transformations, platform resets, or large IT Service Management / IT Operations Management platform rollouts is highly desired. 
- Global Stakeholder Management: A proven background coordinating and mobilising cross-functional, globally dispersed internal teams and major global external vendors such as Kyndryl and ServiceNow. 
- Adaptable Leadership: Highly resilient and quick to learn; able to reshape, reconfigure, and realign delivery solutions to meet changing priorities and challenging deadlines without compromising on delivery quality. 
- Relationship & Consensus Builder: Exceptional ability to work inclusively, establish instant credibility, solve conflicts, build consensus, and drive delivery alignment across competing business units. 
- Value-Oriented Self-Starter: Impeccable organisational and time management skills, prioritising activities that deliver the highest business value and outcomes. 
- Critical & Commercial Thinker: A strategic thinker who seamlessly blends technical, operational, and commercial insights into decision-making while challenging the status quo to optimise delivery. 
- Data-Driven Storyteller: Outstanding capability to translate metrics and project data into a compelling case for change, highlighting business outcomes and realised value. 
- Brilliant Communication Skills: Exceptional communication abilities, with the skill to translate highly complex, technical ServiceNow architecture concepts into succinct, clear, and impactful messages for non-technical business leaders. 
- Requirements Analysis: Strong functional analysis skills with the capability to capture, deconstruct, and prioritise well-formed business and technical requirements. 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

Circit is a fast growing B2B SaaS company that is on a mission to make business verifiable in real-time. We are creating a global asset verification platform that allows auditors to deliver higher quality financial audits and spend more time helping businesses to create greater value for all economic stakeholders. Our current customer base includes big four accountancy firms as well as global banks.

Our Verified Transactions (VT) product connects audit firms and their corporate clients directly to banking APIs — enabling real-time, secure confirmation of financial data from the world's largest banks. We're regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland as an AISP under PSD2, UK Financial Conduct Authority, accredited by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission open banking and work with clients including Big Four accountancy firms and global banks like JP Morgan, HSBC, Goldman Sachs, and Santander.

We're looking for a Provider Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day health and management of Circit's banking API provider network — currently 7k+ and growing. You'll be the person who ensures our connections to banks stay healthy, new providers get activated smoothly, and issues get identified before they impact clients.

This is not a traditional support role. You'll act as Circit's interlocutor with banking partners — communicating with banks on behalf of clients, managing tri-directional relationships between clients, banks, and our development team, and proactively monitoring API connectivity across our entire provider network. The scale is significant: thousands of provider endpoints generating millions of transactions, each with data quality signals that need monitoring and interpretation. You'll need to be deeply data-driven and comfortable using AI tools as daily force multipliers — not as a crutch, but as a way to stay ahead of a provider landscape that grows every quarter.

You'll sit between our product support function and the product team itself, spending roughly 20-30% of your time embedded with product to provide operational context for roadmap decisions.

You'll report to the Product Director and work closely with the Head of Bank API Platform. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is curious about fintech, comfortable with data, and wants to develop deep expertise in banking API connectivity and open banking infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities



- Provider Network Health and Monitoring Own the proactive monitoring of provider API health across 50+ banking connections. Track bank data quality metrics, API response times, and connectivity status. Identify and investigate anomalies — when time-to-authorize increases for a high-volume provider, you're the person who notices, investigates, and acts. Maintain and update the provider status channel so support, customer success, and product teams have reliable, real-time visibility
- SWIFT Exception Management and Provider Verification Manage the SWIFT exception queue, resolving repair cases and coordinating with banks and/or clients to clear blockers. Handle provider verification workflows across SWIFT, Plaid, Blink, and other connectivity channels. Ensure provider data in Circit's systems is accurate and current
- Provider Activation and Onboarding Support Support the activation process for new bank connections — coordinating between Circit's engineering team and bank technical contacts to ensure smooth go-lives. Maintain the provider database with accurate coverage, authentication types, product support details, and connection status
- Client Hypercare and Authorization Support Provide post-go-live support for clients on newly activated bank connections. Create and maintain client authorization guides. Act as the operational bridge when clients encounter provider-specific issues, communicating with banks on behalf of clients to resolve blockers
- Product Team Collaboration Spend 20-30% of your time embedded with the product team, providing operational context that informs roadmap priorities. Surface patterns from provider monitoring that indicate product improvements needed. Contribute to data quality definitions and admin panel documentation for broader team enablement
- Process Documentation and Improvement Build and maintain operational playbooks for provider monitoring, exception handling, and activation processes. Identify recurring issues and propose automation or process improvements. Contribute to the provider management vision — making provider information self-serviceable for customer success and support teams

Requirements



- 1-2 years of experience in operations, technical support, implementation, or a related role — in fintech, SaaS, banking, or technology
- Data-driven mindset — you think in dashboards, metrics, and trends. Ability to read and interpret monitoring data, spot anomalies across large datasets, and investigate root causes. Basic SQL or data querying ability is a strong plus
- AI fluency as a core working skill — you actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) as daily productivity multipliers — for data analysis, drafting communications, triaging issues, and automating repetitive workflows. You understand what AI does well and where it falls short, and you apply judgment on top of AI outputs rather than accepting them uncritically
- API literacy — understanding of what APIs are, how REST APIs work, and what terms like OAuth, webhooks, and authentication flows mean (you don't need to build APIs, but you need to understand how bank API connectivity works)
- Strong written communication — ability to write clear, professional communications to bank technical contacts, internal teams, and client-facing stakeholders
- Proactive problem-solving orientation — you notice things before they break and follow through without being asked
- Organizational ability — can manage multiple provider relationships and operational workflows simultaneously without dropping balls

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in open banking, bank connectivity, or financial services operations
- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, bank connectivity protocols, or API aggregation platforms
- Experience with monitoring or observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or similar)
- Experience with ticketing systems (Jira, Intercom, Zendesk, DevOps)
- Understanding of data quality concepts and how to interpret DQ metrics across large datasets
- Exposure to banking or API connectivity operations from either the bank side or the fintech side
- Interest in product management as a career direction

Benefits

This is an exciting opportunity for an all-rounder, highly motivated candidate to get involved at the ground level of a fast-growing company. We're committed to making sure our employees are well-treated. If there's something that's important to you that's not on the list, talk to us.



- Competitive salary plus commission paid against sales contracts, with the possibility of equity;
- A small team with a friendly environment that promotes autonomy for you to self-manage your time;
- Remote working and flexible working hours;
- Great opportunity for career progression with hands on experience;
- Freedom of expression is encouraged

The role combines hands-on operational responsibilities—including control reviews, issue remediation, and management information oversight—with strategic product development activities aimed at maintaining competitive positioning in the UK retail investment market. Product Control & Operational Oversight

Perform and oversee regular control reviews to prevent, detect, and remediate issues including ineligible investments, over-contributions, and cash/in-specie transfer errors.

Oomnitza offers the industry’s most versatile Enterprise Technology Management platform that orchestrates and automates key business processes for IT. Our SaaS solution, with agentless integrations, best practices and low-code workflows, enables enterprises to leverage their existing infrastructure systems and automate processes such as offboarding, onboarding, audit readiness, refresh forecasting and more, thereby reducing reliance on error-prone manual tasks and tickets. We help some of the most well-known and innovative companies to improve efficiency, expedite audits, mitigate cyber risk and eliminate redundant IT spend.

Oomnitza is hiring a Product Owner to drive throughput on our engineering teams. The role is tactical and focused: organize and prioritize the backlog, identify blockers, and get them resolved with minimal disruption to the team.

You sit alongside the engineering team and act as the central clearing house for incoming work: strategic priorities from Product Engineering, customer escalations from Support and Customer Success, engineering-identified technical debt, and deferred bugs. You keep the team's plate full of the right work, in the right order. You also run the team's engineering ceremonies, but ceremonies are a means, not the goal. The goal is throughput.

What You'll Do



- Own the engineering team backlog. Maintain it in a prioritized, ready-to-work state with the right mix of strategic features, customer escalations, technical debt, and bug fixes.
- Prioritize across product strategic priorities, customer escalations, and engineering-identified technical debt. Make the tradeoffs explicit.
- Identify blockers early (technical, organizational, cross-team, or strategic) and escalate to the right owner to unblock the team with minimal impact to delivery.
- Run engineering ceremonies: daily stand-up, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Use them as instruments to surface issues and manage flow.
- Partner with Product Engineers to translate validated solutions into well-formed user stories, acceptance criteria, and a sequenced delivery plan.
- Partner with Customer Success and Support to triage customer escalations, scope the real problem, and slot the work appropriately.
- Set realistic delivery expectations and provide regular, honest updates on what is shipping, what is at risk, and why.
- Maintain a trust-based relationship with the engineering team. You are their advocate for clarity, focus, and protection from churn.



What We're Looking For



- Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years as a Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Program Manager in an agile B2B SaaS environment.
- Strong knowledge of agile and scrum methodologies, and the practical experience to know when to follow the playbook and when to deviate from it.
- Demonstrated ability to prioritize across competing inputs (strategic, customer, technical) and defend those priorities with clear reasoning.
- Sharp instincts for spotting blockers and the communication skills to escalate them without creating drama.
- Technical literacy. You can read an API spec, follow an architecture conversation, and reason about engineering tradeoffs well enough to make calls on the backlog.
- Strong written and verbal communication. You are a clarifier, not a confuser.
- Detail-oriented and structured. You hold a complex backlog in your head and still keep the team's next two weeks crisp.

About Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

The Context

Conveo is scaling fast and has very ambitious revenue targets. Every function (Engineering, Product, Sales, CS, Marketing) is getting sharper in isolation. To keep scaling, we are building at lightning speed and the places we lose momentum now sit at the seams: the handoff from Sales to CS, the expansion motion in our top accounts, the onboarding ramp, the feedback loop from customers back into Product.

GTM Operations is the team that walks into those seams, diagnoses where they leak, designs the new way of working, proves it cross-functionally, and hands it off as a playbook the functional team can run without us.

Net Revenue Retention and Expansion ARR are our scoreboard. You won't own the number. You will use it as the guiding light for every leak you chase and every playbook you ship.

This role is the operator behind the motion. The Strategy & Ops Lead frames the bet and owns the end-to-end arc. You are the person who makes it actually land: you run the diagnostic, you own a workstream inside the project, you build the playbook, you keep momentum every week. If you do this well for 12 to 18 months, you run your own motion end to end.

Your Mission



-  Run the diagnostic with rigor

The first 30 days of every motion is diagnostic. Your job is to walk into a function, find where the effort is not converting to outcome, and ground the diagnosis in evidence.



- Pull the data. Build the cohort, the funnel, the churn view, the cycle-time chart, whatever shows where the motion is leaking. 
- Shadow the calls, sit in the rituals, read the tickets, join the project. You know how the motion actually runs, not just how it's described on paper. 
- Talk to the operators. Interview the CSMs, AEs, onboarding leads, support team. Synthesize what you hear into patterns, not anecdotes. 
- Size the leak in revenue or time terms. Make it easy for the exec team to rank the fix against the next one. 
-  Own a workstream inside strategic cross-functional projects and own smaller projects in full

When the Lead ships a cross-functional project, you are the single accountable owner of a piece of it. You drive momentum on that piece every week, no one has to chase you. You also manage smaller projects end to end.



- Run the workstream end to end: plan, cadence, artefacts, decisions, escalations. 
- Keep the cross-functional stakeholders aligned. Send the weekly update before anyone asks for it. Make the status obvious. 
- Ship a v1 in days or weeks, not quarters. Measure it against the KPIs. Iterate until the numbers move. 
- When something slips, you surface it early with the fix already drafted. Never let a blocker sit quietly. 
-  Turn the motion into a playbook

A motion that only works because the Strategy & Ops team is running it is not a system. You are the person who turns "this worked" into "this runs on rails."



- Document the playbook: the workflow, the triggers, the decisions, the escalation paths, the scripts. Make it so clear a new recruit can run it on day one. 
- Build the templates, dashboards, and trackers the functional team will use after the handover. 
- Automate the repetitive parts. Default to the AI or workflow tool that removes the work, not a new hire. 
- Train the functional team to own it. Stay on call for 4 to 6 weeks post-handover. If the team can't take it over yet, you continue to own it. 

What We're Looking For

Must-haves



- 1 to 3 years at a top strategy consulting firm (MBB, Big 4 Strategy, LEK, OC&C, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman) with evidence of owning a workstream end to end. Or: 2+ years in a high-velocity operator seat (BizOps / RevOps analyst, Chief of Staff org, early-stage startup generalist) building things that stuck. 
- Sharp analytical chops. You can pull data, build a model, and pressure-test an assumption without waiting for a data request queue. 
- Crisp written communication. Your docs, memos, and updates make decisions faster, not slower. 
- Proven ability to own something end to end, from scope to ship, without hand-holding. 
- Evidence of cross-functional collaboration. You have worked with people outside your function and kept them aligned without formal authority. 
- AI-native. You default to building with AI, not asking for more headcount. 
- Willing to be based in Antwerp HQ or the UK, with regular travel to HQ. 

Mindset



- High agency, low ego. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. You do not care who gets credit. 
- Learner. You are hungry, coachable, and you compound quickly. You want to be unrecognisably better in 12 months. 
- Momentum is a feature. You ship a rough v1 this week rather than a perfect v3 next quarter. 
- Quality bar. When you hand something over, it is polished, documented, and the team is trained. 
- Curious and rigorous. You love going deep. You don't stop at the first answer. 

Nice to have



- Pre-MBA or fresh post-MBA from a top school. 
- Exposure to B2B SaaS, AI, or enterprise software as an analyst or operator. 
- Fluency with data and automation tooling: SQL, Hex, Looker, Zapier / n8n, AI workflow builders. 
- Experience with consumer insights, market research, or the CMO buyer

Why Join Conveo?

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working, and spending time, together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team offsites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.



- Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company in full scaling mode
- Work across every function in the business: Engineering, Product, CS, Sales, Marketing. Rare exposure at this seniority
- Work with world-class enterprise clients (Unilever, Google, P&G, Orange, and more)
- Direct access to the Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops Lead, VP of sales, VP of Client Growth and the founders on the motions that matter most
- Hybrid working model with offices in Antwerp, London, and New York. Base yourself at HQ or in the UK with frequent time in Antwerp
- Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside
- A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.


INTRODUCING THE TRAINLINE CLOUD NATIVE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE TEAM 

At Trainline, we're evolving the platform that powers millions of journeys across Europe. As part of our Cloud Native Acceleration Programme, we're modernising our backend services to create a more scalable, resilient and efficient engineering platform. This programme is about more than migrating workloads. It's an opportunity to redefine how .NET services are built, deployed and operated, helping teams deliver faster while improving reliability and reducing operational complexity.

As a Senior C# Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping our cloud-native engineering standards. Working closely with Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and product development teams, you'll modernise existing services, build reusable patterns and develop automation that accelerates engineering across the organisation. Your work will have a lasting impact on both the developer experience and the resilience of our platform.

Success in this role is measured not only by modernising services, but by raising engineering capability across Trainline through reusable tooling, technical leadership, collaboration and the adoption of cloud-native engineering practices and by the ability to collaborate across the organisation.




IN THIS ROLE AS THE SENIOR C# ENGINEER, YOU WILL... 

 - Modernise existing .NET services by containerising applications for Amazon ECS, removing legacy infrastructure dependencies and optimising services for cloud-native operation.

 - Design and build resilient distributed systems by improving health checks, fault tolerance, observability and runtime behaviour to enhance service reliability and reduce operational incidents.

 - Define and evolve the .NET migrations by creating reusable service templates, engineering standards and best practices covering dependency injection, configuration, logging, monitoring and deployment.

 - Develop automation and AI-assisted tooling that accelerates cloud migration by analysing existing services, identifying modernisation opportunities and generating infrastructure and deployment scaffolding.

 - Optimise containerised workloads to improve performance, resource utilisation and scalability, helping teams deliver efficient, cost-effective services at scale.

 - Partner with engineering teams across Trainline to drive adoption of cloud-native engineering practices, influence technical direction and build consensus around modernisation approaches that enable successful service migrations.

 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, enabling faster, safer and more consistent software delivery.

 - Champion cloud-native engineering through technical leadership, documentation, design reviews, demos, mentoring and engineering community engagement, helping teams adopt consistent engineering practices with confidence.


WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE... 




CORE SKILLS

 - Strong professional experience developing applications with C# and .NET, alongside a solid understanding of software engineering principles and modern backend architecture.

 - A good understanding of distributed systems, including resilience patterns, observability, scalability and performance optimisation.

 - Experience designing reusable engineering patterns, frameworks or shared libraries that improve consistency and developer experience across multiple teams.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams and influence technical decisions through partnership and expertise.

 - A continuous learning mindset and a passion for improving engineering practices, modernising legacy systems and delivering measurable business impact.


INFRA AND CLOUD NATIVE EXPERIENCE

 - Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (or equivalent), alongside a strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.

 - Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using containers and orchestration technologies within AWS and Amazon ECS.


AI EXPERIENCE

 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, quality and software delivery, while applying sound judgement to validate outputs. 

 - You're curious about the rapidly evolving AI landscape and can identify practical opportunities to apply AI to engineering workflows, automation and developer experience - ideally through first hand experience.


COMMUNICATING AND INFLUENCE

 - A track record of influencing technical decisions across engineering teams through collaboration, clear communication and technical credibility.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences, build trusted relationships and help drive organisational adoption of engineering standards and best practices.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life – enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies.

With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Within our Analytical Services team, we have a functional service provider solution, which is a unique partnership that allows our customers to use the experience of our staff, while allowing you, the employee, to gain direct experience working with a pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical company, all while maintaining full-time benefits.

Role Overview

As a Senior Bioanalytical Study Manager, you’ll manage bioanalytical operations for pre-clinical studies and clinical trials, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality data by coordinating activities across multiple internal and external stakeholders.

This role will have a particular focus on high-priority, late-phase clinical studies, requiring a strong understanding of the complexities associated with late-phase clinical development and the regulatory environment.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Management: Support contracting activities with third-party laboratory service providers for assay development, validation and sample analysis. Collaborate with business operations, procurement, clinical teams and external laboratories to ensure appropriate SOWs and contracts are established.
Study Coordination: Manage bioanalytical activities across clinical studies, including critical reagent supply and sample analysis. Work closely with bioanalytical strategy leads, clinical trial teams and laboratory service providers to finalize study documentation and ensure delivery against study timelines.
Bioanalytical Oversight: Coordinate bioanalytical activities involving both LC-MS and ligand-binding assay (LBA) platforms, supporting the analysis of small- and large-molecule therapeutics as appropriate.
Late-Phase Clinical Development: Support complex, high-priority late-phase clinical studies, applying an understanding of clinical trial design, operational requirements and the challenges associated with later-stage development.
Regulatory Support: Apply strong regulatory awareness to bioanalytical study activities and documentation, ensuring work is conducted in accordance with applicable regulatory expectations and requirements.
Documentation & Data: Provide input into clinical trial documents, including eCRFs, ICFs and SOWs. Drive the delivery of data transfer specifications and ensure the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of bioanalytical data.
Sample Logistics: Track and reconcile clinical samples and associated testing, proactively identifying and resolving issues that could impact study timelines or data delivery.
Biomarker Activities: Support biomarker-related bioanalytical activities where required, working across relevant internal teams and external laboratory partners.

Education

BA/BS in a scientific discipline plus at least 2 years of relevant project or study management experience within a bioanalytical laboratory or related environment.

Experience

Experience working in a regulated bioanalytical, pharmaceutical or clinical development environment.
Strong understanding of clinical trial design and clinical development, ideally including experience supporting late-phase clinical studies.
Demonstrated understanding and practical experience with LC-MS (liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry) bioanalysis.
Experience with ligand-binding assays (LBA) and large-molecule bioanalysis is highly desirable; candidates with a mixed LC-MS/LBA background are particularly encouraged.
Experience supporting the bioanalysis of small and/or large molecules, with the ability to work effectively across different bioanalytical platforms.
Strong regulatory awareness, particularly as it relates to bioanalytical activities supporting clinical development.
Experience with biomarker bioanalysis
Experience with PK and/or immunogenicity/ADA bioanalysis is advantageous.
Experience with additional biomarker techniques and/or flow cytometry would be beneficial.
Experience coordinating external laboratories/CROs and multiple stakeholders within complex clinical programs is preferred.

Skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-priority clinical development environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong stakeholder and vendor management capabilities.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Strong attention to quality, timelines and regulatory requirements.
Proficiency with Excel and other relevant data and project management tools.

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Resilient Watersheds Project Manager, Europe (RWPME), manages and advances watershed-scale nature-based solution (NbS) projects that support TNC’s conservation strategy in Europe. The RWPME reports to the Resilient Watersheds Program Director, Europe, and works closely with conservation and policy teams across Europe, as well as TNC’s global community of freshwater NbS practitioners.

Externally the RWPME serves as a key point of contact between the Resilient Watersheds Programme in Europe and partners developing and delivering projects on the ground. The role aligns TNC expertise, resources and networks with partner needs, coordinates TNC’s engagement across multiple projects, establishes timelines and ensures the successful delivery of agreed activities.

This means operating within a matrix of European and global TNC teams while retaining responsibility for coordinating TNC Europe budgets, tracking project performance and reporting outcomes against TNC objectives and grant agreement requirements. The role also contributes expertise and insight to support the Programme Director in developing strategies, plans and products that engage donors, businesses and policymakers, helping to grow the impact and reach of the programme.

We’re Looking for You:

If you're ready to step into a rapidly evolving programme that works at the intersection of water security, nature conservation and land management - this is the role for you. No two projects are the same so you will need to be creative in applying your knowledge and ready to work with others to solve real world problems. You'll be joining a small but dynamic team and given opportunities to grow you knowledge and skills on projects that span from the local to global.

What You’ll Bring:
Bachelor’s degree and 3 years experience in natural resource management or similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Relationship-building experience in working closely with a variety of partners, i.e., media, government officials, and internal scientists.
Experience completing tasks independently concerning timeline(s).
Experience with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English and other relevant languages.
Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
Experience in training.

3-5 years’ experience in practice or policy of water and land management , or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Familiarity with principles of Nature based Solutions,.
Knowledge of ecological watershed management principles.
Knowledge of current trends and practices in conservation, water management and environmental economics.
Who We Are :

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

The Personal Work Solutions (PWS) business group at Logitech is the engine behind the tools millions of people rely on every day to create, collaborate, and work—including mice, keyboards, webcams, tablet keyboards, headsets, speakers, and presentation remotes. It represents more than half of Logitech revenue.

In the era of AI disruption, our devices are no longer just peripherals; they are the extension of human hands, voice, and senses. We are the bridge between the physical person (typing, speaking, clicking, being seen) and the digital world. Our mission is to transform these individual touchpoints into a seamless, intelligent ecosystem.

The Mission: 

As the Principal PWS Ecosystem & Platforms Program Manager, you will act as the "right arm" to the PWS Head of Product & Innovation, leading PWS technical program management.

PWS is organized around three business units focusing on vertical execution. You will own the horizontal connective tissue across these three BUs. You will bridge the gap between visionary product strategy and high-velocity R&D execution across multiple teams globally. You will drive the PWS R&D coordination, to ensure our hardware, software, design, and strategic partnerships come together as one cohesive program. You will ensure we achieve our goals within budget, cost, schedule (HW & SW), and experience targets, while keeping an eye for our security and sustainability goals.

Your Contribution: 

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role, you will the following responsibilities:



-  Horizontal R&D Alignment & Innovation Governance
- Orchestrate the Innovation Funnel: Drive the cross-BU planning cycle for our 3-year innovation roadmaps, ensuring deep alignment between product visions and engineering capabilities. Lead the annual “3-year innovation strategy” off-site with the PWS head of product.
- Lead Cross-Functional Governance: Own and optimize the monthly PWS R&D alignment forums. Serve as the bridge between the three Business Units: 3 Heads of Product, 3 Heads of HW Engineering, and 1 Head of SW Engineering.
- Manage the PWS Experience Platforms: Drive technical coordination across PWS for experiences that impact multiple product categories. Key platforms such as AI-enabled workflows, security, connectivity and sustainability. 
- Coordinate program & schedule across multiple functions: Design, UX, SW, HW, Partner alliances. Working closely with heads of product and the program managers of each of the R&D functions.
- Strategic Partnership & Influence: Craft and lead the strategic innovation direction in collaboration with key internal and external partners (platform partners, technology suppliers), leveraging their expertise to co-create and de-risk the future product and technology pipeline.
-  Full-Scope, High-Stakes Project Leadership
- Drive Complex Initiatives: Take direct operational ownership of high-impact, multi-threaded projects that defy traditional functional boundaries (e.g., leading a deeply complex partnership with a big platform partner, launching a unified software/hardware experience).
- Break Down Functional Silos: Step in where traditional, function-specific program managers (HW, SW, Design) stop. Synthesize engineering timelines, software readiness, go-to-market (GTM), partnership requirements, regional nuances, and retail readiness into a singular, executable program.
- Ecosystem Connection: Ensure new and existing products seamlessly interconnect to create a fluid, intuitive hardware and software ecosystem.

Who You Are:

As a deeply experienced, T-shaped technical leader, you bring a proven track record of delivering complex solutions across hardware, software, design, and go-to-market strategy, all backed by deep program management expertise. You know how to command a room and excel at influencing without formal authority, effortlessly driving cross-functional projects with external partners and internal stakeholders. Your leadership is built on a solid technical background, sharp business acumen, and a passion for the front-end of innovation. Thriving in a vibrant "Design Thinking" culture, you are energized to challenge yourself and others to relentlessly remove project and operational barriers.

Key Qualifications:

For consideration, you must bring the following skills and experiences to our team:



- The "T-Shaped" Toolkit: Proven track record leading R&D programs that involve complex hardware and software in B2C and B2B. You speak the language of engineers, designers, business, and commercial marketers equally well.
- Gravitas & Executive Influence: Senior enough to challenge, align, and partner with Vice Presidents, General Managers, and Directors across engineering, product and business organizations.
- Ambiguity Navigator: You thrive in the "gray space." When a critical partnership project touches five different teams with no clear owner, you naturally step in, map out the dependencies, and drive the team to the finish line.
- Ecosystem Thinker: You look at a mouse, a webcam, and a software platform and see a single, continuous user experience, not three separate products.
- Experience: 10+ years of hands-on R&D program management, technical product management, or engineering leadership within consumer electronics, or complex hardware/software environments. Experience delivering new HW & SW consumer electronics all the way to mass production and launch.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken
- Willingness to travel globally

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

Description

Amazon Web Services is hiring a technical program manager to lead Amazon's primary network monitoring products. This team owns AWS Flagship active monitoring tools which provides active probing, processing, and triangulation infrastructure across AWS's global network, delivering near real-time performance metrics and availability insights to network operators and automated remediation systems.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for the different monitoring solutions. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.

Key job responsibilities



-  You’ll drive both hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
-  You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
-  You’ll interact cross-team Deployment Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
-  You’ll participate in Network Design engineering reviews.
-  You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
-  You’ll work with engineers to develop detailed and creative solutions to complex problems, while keeping a watchful-eye on timelines and costs.
-  You’ll ensure consistency in deployed configurations and track exceptions for follow up.
-  You’ll drive simplification efforts in engineering and project/program management, and architectures to unblock innovation.

A day in the life

Technical Program Managers in the BERE organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen infrastructures along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.

About The Team

Within AWS Networking, the Backbone, Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. We provide the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, we have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers. We provide software tooling that allows the global AWS footprint to scale via new Region and edge location builds, automated systems that control the flow of traffic across devices, and are building our next generation network controllers to drive improved performance and efficiency across the networks that we operate.

Working at AWS the GCNA Team - Meet Robert, VP: https://youtu.be/8v5i42FL02w

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
