About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Customer Growth Team 👋
The Customer Growth team helps Trainline understand and improve how our marketing builds awareness, consideration and long-term customer growth. As a Data Scientist specialising in Marketing Measurement, you will shape how we evaluate marketing performance, turning complex and imperfect data into clear recommendations that support high-value commercial decisions.
You will take ownership of a varied portfolio of focused, fast-moving measurement projects, using Python, causal inference and geo-experimentation to understand marketing impact. Working closely with marketing, analytics and other cross-functional partners, you will combine multiple signals where no single measurement approach provides the full answer, helping stakeholders make informed decisions with confidence.


In this role as the Data Scientist, you will... 🚄

 - Design and deliver robust approaches for measuring the effectiveness and incremental impact of marketing activity.

 - Use Python, causal inference and geo-experimentation techniques to analyse performance and generate commercially relevant insights.

 - Combine evidence from multiple data sources and measurement methods to provide a clear and balanced view where no single solution is definitive.

 - Translate complex analytical findings into practical recommendations that enable marketing stakeholders to make informed investment decisions.

 - Partner closely with marketing, analytics and other cross-functional teams to define measurement questions, shape project scope and align on successful outcomes.

 - Manage several focused analytical projects at the same time, balancing pace, quality and business value across competing priorities.

 - Apply pragmatic judgement when working with incomplete or imperfect data, clearly communicating assumptions, limitations and levels of confidence.

 - Contribute to the continued development of Trainline's marketing measurement capabilities, identifying opportunities to improve methods, tools and ways of working.



We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔎

 - Strong practical experience using Python to analyse data, build measurement approaches and communicate meaningful findings.

 - Experience applying causal inference, geo-experimentation or related experimental and quasi-experimental methods to real-world business questions.

 - A pragmatic and commercially focused approach, with the ability to balance analytical rigour with the need to make timely decisions.

 - Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of analytical expertise.

 - Confidence managing several projects or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining focus on the most valuable outcomes.

 - Experience working collaboratively with marketing, analytics or other cross-functional teams to turn business questions into analytical solutions.

 - Ideally, experience in marketing measurement, marketing effectiveness or marketing mix modelling, although we also welcome applicants with relevant transferable experience.

 - Curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to work with ambiguity, test different approaches and learn from imperfect evidence.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

The European Product Insurance Business Operations team is seeking an experienced, hands-on, multi-talented Program Manager to drive operational excellence within the Product Insurance business at Amazon. You'll identify operational gaps, resolve customer-impacting issues, and develop metrics to assess performance trends. This position offers an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on both customer and partner experiences in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Working at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic planning, you'll be responsible for both "run-the-business" tasks and strategic initiatives. Your ability to multitask in an environment with numerous demands while maintaining the highest standards with our internal stakeholders and external partners will be essential. This role requires strong communication skills, business judgment, and a data-driven approach to identify and address customer pain points.

Key job responsibilities
- Facilitate relationships with third-party insurance partners and internal teams, driving cross-functional collaboration to support the product insurance purchase experience on Amazon.
- Manage program life-cycles, define objectives, and deliver projects to improve customer pain points within the larger Insurance and Payments organization.
- Identify operational gaps and develop requirements for new projects, applying relevant tools and mechanisms to measure progress.

In this role, you'll start your day monitoring key metrics and addressing any urgent customer or technical escalations from our insurance partners. Amazon Product insurance (PI) is a young and dynamic program in Europe, active in the UK, Germany, France, Italy and Spain. - Experience defining and executing program requirements

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French, Spanish, German or Italian

The Role

OVERVIEW

This role assumes responsibility for managing media sponsorship activity for multiple client
accounts. The role will also act as the main point of contact for both clients and Media Teams
surrounding the day-to-day media sponsorship management activity and supports the Head of
Media Sponsorship in fostering strong relationships with clients.

It requires the use of media planning tools, the effective management of the media sponsorship
processes (briefing, negotiating, management, reporting) and excellent attention to detail and
time management to ensure best in class delivery on behalf of the Sponsorship Practice for
clients.

It also requires strong collaboration and communication with the wider organisation across the
integral teams to ensure that delivery is to the highest standards and relevant opportunities are
brought to clients in a timely and proactive manner. A strong, collaborative working relationship
with colleagues within the practice, agency Media Teams across all levels, Investment and media
owners is a crucial element of this role. The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a fast-paced
environment with a drive to succeed and can multi-task in a deadline driven atmosphere.

Responsibilities
The role of the Sponsorship Client Director assumes the responsibility of project manager for
each media sponsorship from their assigned Media Agency/Agencies and will have the
responsibility of developing the Media Sponsorship rationale for their clients. The role will also
involve meeting and exceeding team revenue targets set in the business plan. The Sponsorship
Client Director will need to foster a strong a working relationship with our colleagues in the
Media Practices and gain a thorough understanding of their client’s key objectives. They will be
the expert in their field on which the Media Teams will rely on for recommendations, advice,
and management. This role is central to the efficient and effective running of the day to day
media sponsorship service and management. This includes the creation and tracking of
sponsorship critical paths, timely and accurate billing/spend projections, delivering relevant
sponsorship opportunities to the highest standard, presenting response to briefs, thinking
proactively and innovatively and always being on the quest to find new and exciting
opportunities for clients. The Sponsorship Client Director will work closely with Investment and
the AV Team to ensure we are offering our clients best in market value and providing insightful
reporting to both clients and Media Teams.
KPIs will include revenue targets, growing the Sponsorship Practice’s reputation internally and
externally, and the media sponsorship service scores in the annual RADAR service review.

AGENCY PERFORMANCE
• Project management of the media sponsorship process, working closely with Media Team
colleagues, Investment, Channel Planning and other integral teams to ensure Sponsorship
Practice output is of the highest standard
• Management of media sponsorship projects from start to end (dealing with client queries,
negotiating with media owners, coordinating reports, monitoring, presenting results)
• Understanding of the key business challenge for their clients and addressing these challenges
with appropriate sponsorship platforms.
• Maintaining strong relationships with media owners and having a deep understanding of their
properties.
• Analyse and understand reports. Use the data generated to provide insights and identify clear
actions to be taken
• Understand how each Practice and integral team within Core can contribute to the overall
plan
• Validate sponsorship campaign delivery and performance and create post campaign reviews
for clients
• Leading sponsorship presentations to clients and agency teams
• Coordinating media owner briefs and delivery

COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE
• Collection of client POs and manage the internal communication of POs across teams ensuring
effective and efficient month end billing for all media sponsorship activity
• Overall responsibility for billing at the end of each month
• Manage media sponsorship budgets, forecasting and aged debt
• Ensure all billing is 100% accurate and on time for all media sponsorships

TALENT MANAGEMENT
• Commit to the internal training Core Learning programme(s) and regularly attend training for
your development
• Developing understanding of client business, their Key Business Priorities for the year and lead
in creating media sponsorship strategies to deliver against them
• Ensure close collaboration with Media Sponsorship and Media Teams to ensure that they are

Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack's AI-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR's impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.

Founder-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do.

We're looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack to join our growing Search team.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack, you'll help build and evolve the customer-facing search experiences that help users discover relevant, high-quality content, along with the backend systems that power them. You'll work across the stack, with a slight emphasis on frontend development, and collaborate closely with engineers, Product, and Design to deliver intuitive search experiences backed by reliable, scalable search and data systems.

What You'll Do
Own and deliver customer-facing search features and workflows across frontend and backend systems, from technical planning through production
Build AI-powered product experiences end to end, from the services behind them to the interfaces that make their output useful and trustworthy
Build intuitive, responsive user experiences using Vue while contributing to the Python and Django services that power them
Design and improve search, indexing, and retrieval systems that support high-quality content discovery across large volumes of data
Build and maintain features and data workflows that leverage technologies such as Elasticsearch, Kafka, Celery, and MySQL
Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs that balance customer experience, delivery speed, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and engineering teammates to shape solutions, clarify requirements, and deliver high-quality customer experiences
Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive improvements to the performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability of the systems you work on
Participate in an on-call and incident response rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues and improve system reliability over time
To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have
5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software
Strong experience working across frontend and backend systems and independently delivering features throughout the application stack
Proficiency with Python or a similar programming language and experience with Django or a comparable web framework
Experience building polished, maintainable user-facing applications with Vue.js or another modern JavaScript framework
Experience with Elasticsearch or a comparable search technology, or significant experience working with data-intensive systems
Experience making technical trade-offs within complex production systems while balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term quality
Experience diagnosing production issues and contributing to the reliability and operational health of the systems you build
Experience with TypeScript in a large codebase
Experience with design systems or shared component libraries
Flexibility to adjust working hours for overlap with teammates in US time zones
If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity
Experience with Kafka or other streaming or event-driven technologies
Experience with MySQL, Postgres, or other relational databases
Experience with Celery or other asynchronous task-processing systems
Experience building search, discovery, indexing, or information-retrieval features
Experience improving frontend architecture, performance, or complex customer-facing workflows
Experience working with high-traffic SaaS applications or systems that process large volumes of data
Experience building customer-facing features backed by LLMs or other AI models
Experience judging whether an AI-backed feature is actually working, through evaluation, testing, or user feedback
Interest in journalism, news, media, or social media
In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who
Communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners
Take ownership of problems and drive work forward independently while knowing when to involve others
Take pride in building readable, testable, maintainable software while making pragmatic technical trade-offs
Approach ambiguous or complex problems thoughtfully and use sound judgment to identify effective solutions
Contribute to a strong engineering culture through thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing, feedback, and continuous improvement
Proactively incorporates AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery
Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager
Peer interviews with several team members
30-minute Bar Raiser
Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary
The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience.
The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,000+ gross per month, depending on experience.
Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Remote Work, Forever

Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup
Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

Transparent & Fair Compensation

 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation. No matter where you come from, your aspirations matter to us. We believe in the power of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds to ignite innovation and drive success. We're in the business of empowering people, and that includes you. Your journey here is not just about a job; it's about a shared vision for a brighter, more sustainable future.

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and dynamic leader to join our Energy Transition division.

This role brings program management structure to the strategic initiatives and partnerships within Eaton’s Energy Transition division across EMEA.

The Program Manager leads cross-functional teams to drive New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, deliver on go-to-market strategies, and manage the development of an inter-departmental portfolio — ensuring alignment on joint business objectives for Eaton’s Integrated Solutions (EV Charging Infrastructure and Battery Energy Storage Systems). Serving as a central point of coordination across product, finance, IT, engineering, commercial, and operations functions, the Program Manager ensures a standard, integrated NPI process is implemented consistently.

The position is envisioned as approximately 50% leading new programs and 50% supporting EMEA commercial activities and coordination.

It reports directly to the EVCI Commercial Leader, EMEA, with a functional (dotted-line) reporting relationship to the Energy Transition Manager of Program Management.

The role is available as a remote position across the European Union, with a primary focus on the following countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France, the Czech Republic.

Travel rate is up to 20%.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership (≈50%)



- Ensure effective program management tools and processes are utilized, including the use of Eaton’s PROLaunch process and agile methodologies.
- Lead the team through uncertainty and ambiguity by establishing program structure, operating cadence, objectives, and performance measurement.
- Lead portfolio prioritization for interdepartmental efforts, managing portfolio-level financials and business impact.
- Maintain accountability for program scope and successful execution within technical, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.
- Track milestone attainment, program budget, stakeholder alignment, and CTQ deliverables as needed for robust metrics reporting.
- Develop and maintain detailed schedules using Microsoft Project, highlighting interdependencies between teams and holding team members accountable.
- Maintain a robust communications plan, including regular presentations to senior leaders and external stakeholders as the primary program contact; prepare and publish formal program metrics and reports on at least a monthly basis.
- Lead teams in program risk assessment and deployment of sound mitigation strategies; monitor risk and take decisive, early action to resolve any issues.
- Work with functional leaders to secure program resources and escalate any staffing concerns.
- Share PM best practices within the PMO community and mentor other PMs as appropriate.


Commercial Support & Coordination — Integrated Solutions (≈50%)



- Partner with the EMEA EVCI commercial team to coordinate go-to-market execution and cross-functional delivery of Integrated Solutions.
- Bring program discipline to strategic partnerships by coordinating joint roadmaps, deliverables, governance, and commitments with key third parties.
- Support the successful deployment of the first EVCI and BESS projects, ensuring strong coordination across commercial, engineering, supply chain, finance, and external partners.
- Own the transition from sales to execution by translating won opportunities into clear deployment plans, roles, responsibilities, and milestones.
- Act as the central coordination point from project award through customer handover, driving alignment across all stakeholders and managing critical dependencies.
- Track deployment schedules, contractual milestones, project profitability, and change orders to ensure successful project execution.
- Develop, document, and standardize a repeatable order-to-deployment playbook based on lessons learned from early projects.
- Establish scalable processes, governance, templates, and best practices that allow future projects to be delivered through Eaton's standard PMO organization rather than requiring dedicated program management support.
- Continuously capture deployment learnings and feed them back into product development, offers, deployment processes, and customer experience improvements.


Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field from an accredited institution.
- Minimum 3-5 years of experience in program and project management, including the application of program governance methodologies, processes, and tools.
- Minimum 2 years of experience leading New Product Development (NPD) / New Product Introduction (NPI) programs within a structured stage-gate environment.
- Experience in one or more of Eaton's Integrated Solutions domains, including power distribution equipment, EV charging infrastructure, and/or battery energy storage systems (BESS).
- Comfortable working within a technical environment and coordinating across engineering, product management, operations, commercial, supply chain, finance, IT, and external partner organizations.
- Able to understand sufficient technical detail to facilitate discussions, identify dependencies, clarify ownership, manage risks, and drive decisions without acting as the technical design authority.
- General understanding of the Energy Transition ecosystem, including EV charging infrastructure, battery energy storage systems, power distribution, grid connection constraints, and customer deployment challenges.
- Demonstrated ability to navigate complex cross-functional discussions that require alignment of technical, commercial, operational, and customer requirements.
- Solid understanding of the diversity of European markets, including local regulations, grid connection processes, certification requirements, customer expectations, and deployment considerations.
- Ability to translate technical and commercial inputs into clear program plans, milestones, risks, mitigation actions, and executive-level communications.
- Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in environments characterized by ambiguity, complexity, and evolving priorities.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to deliver executive status updates, facilitate stakeholder alignment, resolve conflicts, and communicate effectively with customers and senior leadership.
- Proven ability to achieve objectives through collaboration, influence, and cross-functional teamwork.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to process discipline.
- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to balance strategic objectives and operational execution.


Why Eaton?



- Contribute to a globally strategic Energy Transition business shaping the future of electrification
- Collaborate with industry-leading partners and global teams to deliver solutions that make a real difference
- Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package
- Work on challenging, high-impact projects within a collaborative and supportive team environment
- Enjoy flexible working solutions that support balance and performance
- Grow your career with a company that champions internal mobility and encourages advancement
- Develop continuously through long-term investment in learning, including access to Eaton University
- Be part of a purpose-driven organization where reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability guide everything we do
- Thrive in a culture that prioritizes wellbeing, with tools and support designed to empower you to take care of your health and safety


All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

A quick look at the role.

As Product Delivery Manager, you'll play a key role in the day-to-day delivery and development of Biffa's Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. This is a varied, hands-on role combining Agile delivery and Scrum leadership with structured project management, from leading sprint ceremonies and backlog delivery to managing platform upgrades, major enhancements, integrations and M&A-driven change. You'll be equally comfortable leading a stand-up, unblocking a delivery team and managing a complex project through to successful delivery.

Your Core Responsibilities



- Lead the day-to-day Agile delivery of the Product team, facilitating Scrum ceremonies and ensuring effective sprint planning, execution and continuous improvement
- Own the Azure DevOps backlog and sprint boards, ensuring accurate work items, priorities and delivery data while tracking key sprint metrics and team performance
- Act as a leader, removing blockers, managing dependencies and coordinating internal teams, external resources and third-party delivery partners
- Lead the end-to-end delivery of major platform changes, including upgrades, enhancements, integrations and migrations, alongside ongoing BAU/product delivery
- Apply strong project management discipline, maintaining delivery plans, RAID logs, resource plans, budgets and governance reporting
- Coordinate key delivery activities including testing, UAT, cutover, go-live, hypercare and post-implementation support
- Partner with Product Managers to shape and sequence roadmap priorities, balancing team capacity across BAU, enhancements and major projects
- Act as a key delivery contact for business and IT stakeholders, providing clear reporting, managing risks and expectations, and leading communications for major releases and changes


Our Essential Requirements



- Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead or IT Delivery Manager, leading cross-functional teams and Agile ceremonies
- Strong experience delivering projects end-to-end, including planning, risks/issues, budgets, governance and reporting
- Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira for backlog, sprint and work-item management
- Experience delivering change across enterprise applications/platforms such as Dynamics 365, SAP or Oracle, with a good understanding of associated business processes
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to work across delivery teams and senior business/IT stakeholders
- Experience working within a Product Operating Model and comfortable flexing between Agile and traditional project delivery approaches
- A pragmatic, hands-on problem solver, able to remove blockers, manage competing priorities and bring structure to ambiguity
- A collaborative leader with a continuous improvement mindset, able to challenge existing ways of working and drive better delivery outcomes


Biffa - we're changing the way people think about waste

At Biffa, we love working with waste. Whether we're turning it into sustainable power, finding new ways to recycle it or simply keeping it off the streets, we believe every day is an opportunity to improve the lives of millions. It's a view that's shared by our 11,000+ people around the country, who trust us to provide them with a career that's always rewarding, often challenging, but never dull.

We believe different ideas, perspective and backgrounds are key to developing a creative and effective working environment which is why you'll find us championing diversity and equality at every turn

As a TPM for SRE, you will partner with SRE leaders and engineers to scale the platform that underpins all of MongoDB’s cloud products. You will drive program execution, strengthen production reliability practices, and coordinate cross-functional efforts across US and EMEA teams. Success in this role means smoother launches, clearer roadmaps, stronger reliability metrics and an SRE organization that's better-equipped to deliver predictability at scale.

This role can be based out of our Dublin or Cork office or remotely in Ireland.

What You'll Do



- Drive Program Planning & Execution – Define program scope, milestones, and success criteria with SRE engineers and leaders. Manage dependencies across platform teams, keep work clearly tracked in Jira, and deliver on time
- Strengthen Production Reliability – Lead change management and launch readiness programs. Partner with SREs and product teams to define and operationalize SLOs/SLIs, and use incident data, metrics, and capacity signals to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
- Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts
- Build Scalable Systems & Processes – Design lightweight frameworks and communication patterns that help SRE deliver reliably at scale. Work yourself out of the "hero" role by leaving teams better-equipped to execute independently

Requirements



- 8+ years in technical program management, engineering management, or a comparable technical role partnering with software engineering teams
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives through ambiguity and change
- Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
- Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies
- Able to query and interpret metrics, logs, or other data sources to inform decisions and communicate risk
- Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
- Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

Nice to Have



- Hands-on or close-partner experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, or observability stacks (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting)
- Prior experience working with or alongside SRE teams
- Background in large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform engineering
- Familiarity with MongoDB Atlas or other modern cloud database platforms

Why This Role

This role puts MongoDB's values into practice. You'll own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. You'll build together with SRE, engineering, Security, and Compliance to co-create solutions that work across the organization. And you'll think big—scaling the platform and practices that power MongoDB's next phase of growth. You'll be in the critical path of high-impact projects, working with executive stakeholders, and supported to grow in your career.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Job Description:

About Everest:

Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.

Everest is hiring a Director, Delivery Lead to drive high-impact London Market technology delivery for Everest Global Markets across underwriting workflow, market platform integrations, pricing, policy administration, data, reporting, and regulatory change.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn business priorities into clear delivery plans, keep teams focused, and give senior stakeholders transparent, decision-ready visibility of progress, risk, budget, and value.

The ideal candidate will bring strong agile delivery discipline, London Market awareness, excellent stakeholder management, and the confidence to operate across business, technology, vendor, and global delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities
Lead delivery of a portfolio of London Market technology initiatives from planning through implementation and transition to BAU.
Own delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets, resources, and governance.
Run agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery approaches based on the needs of the initiative.
Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to shape priorities, manage backlogs, and link delivery to OKRs and measurable business value.
Prepare crisp senior-level reporting, including RAG status, SteerCo packs, delivery dashboards, financial summaries, risks, issues, and decisions required.
Identify and resolve risks, issues, impediments, and cross-team dependencies before they impact delivery.
Coordinate delivery across business, engineering, QA, architecture, data, operations, vendors, and global delivery teams.
Use delivery metrics and KPIs to improve transparency, predictability, team performance, and continuous improvement.
Ensure delivery aligns with enterprise technology standards, architecture governance, information security, regulatory expectations, and operational readiness.
Champion and innovate opportunities to leverage AI to accelerate project delivery speed and quality
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong proven delivery capability across complex technology change, including scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, dependency, and stakeholder management.
Deep understanding of London Market insurance, specialty insurance, Lloyd’s, delegated authority, or broader commercial insurance processes.
Experience with underwriting workflow, placement platforms, quote-to-bind, policy administration, bordereaux, bureau processes, downstream reporting, or regulatory change.
Confident applying agile, lean, hybrid, and traditional project delivery models in the right context.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Tempo, PPM, and delivery reporting dashboards.
Strong facilitation, coaching, negotiation, and consensus-building skills.
Ability to influence senior business and technology leaders and drive clear decisions.
Clear, concise communicator who can simplify complex delivery topics for executive, business, and technical audiences.
Data-led mindset with the ability to use metrics to improve delivery performance and predictability.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities, distributed teams, and shifting demands.
Strategic enough to see the bigger picture and hands-on enough to unblock delivery.
Professional Experience and Qualifications
Extensive experience in Agile Project Management, Programme Management and managing portfolios of smaller projects is essential.
Proven track record delivering complex technology change in insurance, financial services, or regulated environments.
London Market, Lloyd’s, and specialty insurance experience is essential.
Experience of implementing Underwriting Workbench platforms for the London Market and integrations with Whitespace and PPL are essential.
Experience in enabling teams to use AI throughout the Software Delivery Lifecycle to increase productivity is essential.
Experience managing vendors, contractors, distributed teams, and global delivery models.
Qualifications such as Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PMP, or PRINCE2 or a degree in computer science/IT is advantageous but not essential.
Success in this Role Looks Like
Clear plans, strong governance, effective communications, and confident senior stakeholder engagement.
Focused teams, fast issue resolution, and sustained delivery momentum.
Transparent reporting on progress, risk, budget, priorities, and decisions.
Delivery outcomes that are aligned to Everest Global Markets business priorities, regulatory expectations, and enterprise technology standards.

What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the application or interview process.

Our Culture

At Everest, our purpose is to provide the world with protection. We help clients and businesses thrive, fuel global economies, and create sustainable value for our colleagues, shareholders and the communities that we serve. We also pride ourselves on having a unique and inclusive culture which is driven by a unified set of values and behaviors.

Our Values are the guiding principles that inform our decisions, actions and behaviors. They are an expression of our culture and an integral part of how we work: Talent. Thoughtful assumption of risk. Execution. Efficiency. Humility. Leadership. Collaboration. Inclusion and Belonging.
Our Colleague Behaviors define how we operate and interact with each other no matter our location, level or function: Respect everyone. Pursue better. Lead by example. Own our outcomes. Win together.

All colleagues are held accountable to upholding and supporting our values and behaviors across the company. This includes day to day interactions with fellow colleagues, and the global communities we serve.

Type:

Regular

Time Type:

Full time

Primary Location:

London

Additional Locations:

c217a92e594a6185.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About The Role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's How You'll Make a Difference



- Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.
- Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.
- Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.
- Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.
- Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.
- Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit



- You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.
- You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.
- You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.
- You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.
- You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.
- You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.
- You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have



- Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.
- Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.
- Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What Success Looks Like



- 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.
- 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.
- 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

What we offer*



- Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days
- Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts
- Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups
- And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ
- Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

c2712a4a497b5c7c.description:
The Opportunity

We're looking for a Head of Global Onboarding Operations to join our Global Operations team and own the health, performance, and future evolution of our global onboarding experience.

As the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, you'll be responsible for ensuring every new customer receives a consistent, efficient, and value-driven onboarding journey, regardless of region. Rather than managing day-to-day onboarding delivery, you'll focus on identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and commercial performance through data, customer insights, trend analysis, and strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Regional Onboarding teams, Product, Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Enablement, and Engineering, you'll shape the future of onboarding by creating scalable global processes, optimising tooling, and influencing the product roadmap. Success in this role is measured not just by how onboarding performs today, but by how you continually improve it for tomorrow.

If you're a strategic, customer-obsessed leader who enjoys solving complex operational challenges and delivering measurable business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do



- Strategic Enablement & Revenue Impact: Lead the four core pillars of the onboarding domain — Measure performance through metrics, Understand root causes and trends, Improve customer adoption and time-to-value, and Influence the future onboarding experience across Product and Operations.
- Process Optimisation: Design, improve, and standardise onboarding processes across regions. You will create scalable workflows, frameworks, documentation, and governance models to eliminate inefficiencies, build team productivity, and balance global consistency with local market nuances.
- Tooling & Systems Ownership: Own and optimize the onboarding tooling stack so teams operate effectively at scale. You'll partner with Operations, Product, Data, and Engineering to enhance system capabilities, reduce manual effort, improve visibility into customer health, and automate workflows.
- People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team in alignment with Phorest’s values.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a key partner across Onboarding, Customer Success, Sales, Product, Operations, Data, and Enablement. You will advocate for regional needs, align initiatives with global strategies, support Premium & Enterprise paths, and ensure a seamless customer journey.
- Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement: Define and track KPIs, build business cases, and run Domain Business Reviews to give leadership complete confidence in domain health. Use data-driven insights to reduce customer effort, accelerate live dates, increase CSAT, and drive feature activation.

What You Bring



- Ideally 8+ years prior experience in onboarding, customer operations, or customer success programmes within a SaaS environment.
- 3+ years of proven people leadership experience, with a track record of developing and coaching high-performing teams.
- Strong strategic and operational thinking with the ability to balance high-level framework creation with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.
- A data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, using customer and operational data to spot trends and drive measurable results.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional teams (Product, Sales, CS, Operations) without direct authority.
- Experience driving operational excellence, process optimisation, and continuous improvement across complex global environments.
- Strong commercial awareness and deep understanding of SaaS customer lifecycle metrics (CSAT, churn, time to value, feature activation).
- Confidence with executive presentations and leading structured business reviews to influence strategic decision-making.
- High level of ownership and accountability, with a collaborative growth mindset focused on supporting and developing teams.

c28d097c85f6ee22.description:
The Rehab Group

With over 270 locations across the Republic of Ireland, Rehab Group has deep roots in communities nationwide. Every day, individuals, families, local businesses, schools, clubs and community groups experience the impact of Rehab’s work. This role will help turn that goodwill, connection and lived experience into a strong, sustainable community fundraising programme.

Job Title: Programme Manager

10D Beckett Way, Park West Business Park, Dublin 12 (Hybrid Model Available)

Fixed Term Contract – 12 Months, 39 hours per week

Salary starting from €72,359 to €97,897, based on Qualifications and Experience.

Job Purpose:

Reporting to the Director of Corporate Affairs, the Programme Manager will lead the delivery of a portfolio of strategic transformation programmes across Rehab Group. The initial focus will include the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) Transformation Programme, Property Transformation Programme and Finance Transformation Programme, while supporting the delivery of other strategic initiatives aligned to the Group Strategy.

The role is responsible for establishing programme governance, planning, stakeholder engagement, benefits realisation, risk management and successful delivery across multiple workstreams. The Programme Manager will work with SeniorLeadership Team, Directors, operational leaders, external partners and suppliers to ensure programmes are delivered on time, within budget and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Minimum Education & Experience required:

* Third-level degree qualification in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, Finance, Operations Management or a related discipline.

* Programme or Project Management certification such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent preferred.

* Change Management certification desirable.

* Minimum 7 years' experience leading complex business transformation programmes in a complex organisation

Job Duties & Responsibilities

* Lead the successful delivery of strategic transformation programmes including Purchase-to-Pay (P2P), Property Transformation and Finance Transformation initiatives.

* Work closely with the SLT, CIO, Finance, Procurement, Property, Operations, HR and Corporate Services leadership teams.

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional programme teams and workstreams.

* Develop and maintain integrated programme plans, budgets and resource requirements.

Staff benefits:

Company Pension Scheme

Paid maternity/paternity/adoption leave

Educational leave

27 days annual leave

Bike to work scheme

Tax saver travel scheme

Income protection

Unpaid leave

Health and Wellbeing programme

Digital Doctor

Financial support for studying and study leave

Long Service Reward Scheme

Sick leave

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

Closing Date:

Please submit your application to this post by 06/09/2026

These duties and responsibilities are a reflection of the present service requirements and may be subject to review and amendment to meet the changing needs of the services.

The Rehab Group is an equal opportunity employer

Are you the kind of person who thrives on bringing complex technology projects to life? Do you enjoy turning requirements into reality and guiding clients through seamless delivery? Ready to be part of a fast‑growing automation leader shaping the future of warehouse technology?

Here at GXO, Inteq we’re are looking for a skilled Project Manager to lead on oversight and management of projects within Inteq. This position requires coordination with multiple departments to ensure the successful deployment of software and automation solutions.

This is a full-time, 12-month fixed term contract, which could lead to a permeant role, working Monday to Friday 9am to 5:30pm, in a hybrid working model. You will need to be able to commute to Milton Keynes at least 1 day per week

Pay, benefits and more:

We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £60,000 depending on experience and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes a company sponsored pension scheme and private medical cover

What you’ll do on a typical day:




- Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and budgets for IT projects related to logistics and warehouse management. 
- Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
- Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers. Ensure that vendors meet project requirements and deliverables.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including logistics, warehouse, IT, and other relevant departments, to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
- Coordinate internal teams and third‑party providers to resolve issues, oversee testing plans, and manage change requests


What you need to succeed at GXO:




- IT Project management experience, ideally within automated warehouse solutions or a similar industry
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritise tasks effectively.
- Strong understanding of project management methodologies, such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall.
- PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certification is preferred.
- Proven track record of successfully delivering IT system projects.


We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. c4e34bf4ff16f1e1.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on UK public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of UK Government and defence organisations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.

Location: UK

Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance preferred; candidates with Active Secret clearance or those who are eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.

What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:



- Own end-to-end technical program delivery for UK public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling
- Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams
- Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans
- Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication



- Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, and government leadership
- Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds
- Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives
- Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management



- Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles
- Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams
- Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, security authorisations, technical and infrastructure constraints
- Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution



- Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards
- Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support
- Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments
- Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

Required Experience

You May Be a Good Fit If:



- 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.
- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.
- Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).
- Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background



- Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)
- Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator
- Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen



- Deep understanding of how government organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology
- Familiarity with UK government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications
- Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment
- Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset
- Eligible to obtain UK government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice To Have



- Active UK government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - preference for active Top Secret clearance
- Background in or strong familiarity with UK defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors
- Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments
- Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for UK government security clearance.

Preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active UK government Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, We Will Also Consider Exceptional Candidates Who



- Currently hold UK government Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade
- Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process
- Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.

What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of the UK’s most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how the UK leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks



- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.



- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work



- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. The Engagement Manager role is a critical role within the TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) Practice Delivery organization and is responsible for managing one or more projects/engagements at a time. A successful Engagement Manager possesses skillsets for managing teams, client facing, stakeholder management, delivery processes, issue resolution for all customer engagements. The delivery function varies in responsibility from account to account, but a successful Engagement Manager is responsible for common activities such as on/off boarding of team members, people management, customer management & reporting, finance management, support project team member activities, issue resolution and supporting other Delivery leads within the account portfolio, and project/engagements. The Engagement Manager assumes accountability of meeting customer expectations, delivery assurance of scope of services, deliverables, and all-round outcomes from the engagements. The Engagement Manager is responsible for qualifying and quantifying the business value benefits from the project outcome throughout the engagement.
They are expected to have the skills required for managing complex deliverable-based, fully outsourced, or scale engagements or programs.
The responsibilities listed below are not exhaustive, as each account will state their unique requirements in the Statement of Work (SoW) or as defined with the Account team at the start of the project.


Key Responsibilities


Delivery Management:

- Delivery of the Engagement, SoW requirements and deliverables as defined by customer.
- Understand SoWs/MSAs and importance of staying on top of the engagement activities & deliverables to meet the expectations of the customer.
- Collaborate with cross functional teams to manage risk, engagement scope, and deliver according to the terms and conditions of our contracts.

- Consolidate and provide engagement delivery reporting as per the Customer engagement needs via a Monthly and/or Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR).

Account & Customer Management:

c603be15895819a9.description:
This is a remote position.

We're looking for a driven, organised and delivery focused Product Delivery Manager to make sure our product roadmap actually gets shipped, at pace and to a high standard. This role is all about ownership: once a feature or change is scoped, you make it move, through user stories, development and release, quickly and without cutting corners on quality.

You'll work closely with the development team, holding them to account for sprint commitments, removing blockers before they slow things down, and stepping in early wherever pace or quality starts to slip.

You'll be working closely with the Engineering Manager, Squad Leads and QA Lead, reporting into the CTO, so if you thrive in a fast paced environment where you're comfortable pushing a team to deliver and taking ownership of the whole delivery pipeline, this could be a great next step.

Please note that we can only accept applications from UK based candidates and are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Execution ownership and pace



- Own execution of scoped work from user story through to development completion and release, driving pace at every stage of the cycle.
- Hold the development team to account for delivery against sprint commitments, challenging slippage directly and escalating early wherever pace or quality is at risk.
- Work with the Engineering Manager and Squad Leads to plan sprints, balance capacity and maximise team throughput and flow.
- Manage scope creep and handle functional trade-offs actively during development cycles.
- Map and resolve cross-squad and platform dependencies proactively, rather than waiting for blockers to be raised, to keep delivery on track.
- Partner with the QA Lead to ensure completed work meets the definition of done and fulfils the intended business outcomes without sacrificing speed of delivery.

Backlog ownership and requirements refinement



- Translate high-level roadmap initiatives and customer change requests into well-defined epics, features and user stories, setting up each piece of work for fast, unambiguous execution.
- Partner with Product Designers, Engineers and business stakeholders to clarify acceptance criteria and edge cases before development starts.
- Maintain, monitor and prioritise the team backlog based on strategic value, urgency and technical dependencies.
- Triage reported system bugs alongside feature work to ensure the right balance of technical debt resolution and new functionality.

Process leadership and continuous improvement



- Foster an environment of high team accountability, removing operational blockers to maximise delivery flow and pace.
- Champion consistent Agile delivery practices, facilitating core planning and execution ceremonies where required.
- Monitor delivery metrics, including cycle time, velocity and release predictability, and act on them directly to keep the team executing at pace.
- Ensure engineering standards and governance guidelines are maintained throughout the delivery lifecycle, so pace is never achieved at the expense of quality.

Stakeholder communication and release planning



- Serve as the functional point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding delivery timelines, milestone progress and scope adjustments.
- Coordinate release schedules with Operations and Product Management to ensure smooth end-user deployment and change management.

Requirements



- Degree level qualification (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a software engineering related subject.
- Experience with Large-Scale Scrum or Scrum.
- 5+ years' software development experience.
- Experience in leading or managing remote teams.
- Strong people management skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and confident in managing senior stakeholders.

Benefits



- 40 days holiday (including bank holidays) because balance matters
- Remote first approach
- Ongoing development opportunities, including mentoring from senior leadership
- Supportive, approachable team culture that values initiative and ideas
- Career progression with being part of a fast growing company, bringing great opportunities. 

Who We Are

SchoolGrid provides trusted software solutions to schools, catering providers, and local authorities across the UK. Our platform supports the full meal service journey, from menu planning to meal ordering, making daily operations more efficient for thousands of users.

With deep experience in the school catering space, we pride ourselves on building long term partnerships and delivering technology that works in the real world. Our clients rely on us not just for software, but for consistent, responsive support and a commitment to ongoing improvement.

As we continue to grow and expand our offering, we remain focused on delivering the same high standards of service, training, and innovation that our clients expect.
