c621f6663aaa01c9.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

We're a leading company in video streaming, dedicated to providing exceptional solutions to enhance audio, video, and real-time communication experiences, empowering our clients to engage their audiences in meaningful ways. From the leading industry player to innovative advertising solutions, our mission is to create immersive, video experiences that invite everyone to engage and interact.

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Global Delivery Engineering leads the Delivery Engineering pillar within Customer Success — the team accountable for executing technical implementation, migrations, custom development, and Professional Services engagements for Dolby Cloud Solutions’ customers who require hands-on engineering involvement. Reporting directly to the head of Customer Success, you ensure these engagements deliver on time, to specification, and with the technical quality necessary for long-term customer success.

This is a customer-delivery role, not an engineering-service role. Not every customer requires Delivery Engineering. Your team writes code and executes technical work at real depth, but the accountability points at the customer. You work closely with Engineering as a partner: consulting on complex problems, escalating defects, coordinating on production changes.

This is a hybrid manager + IC role. You lead a team of staff-level Delivery Engineers across geographies while engaging personally on complex projects and escalations. You partner closely with the Customer Success program management, who owns onboarding program mechanisms, checkpoint operational mechanics, PS customer-facing coordination, and new customer intake. You own substantive delivery decisions, PS governance, portfolio capacity, and the onboarding checkpoint decision when it applies.

Key Responsibilities



- Lead the Delivery Engineering team — a globally distributed group of staff-level Delivery Engineers. Define the operating model, hold the team accountable to on-time delivery and post-go-live stability, and engage directly on complex onboardings requiring senior technical leadership
- Own the project portfolio and PS governance — manage capacity, sequencing, and queue health; push back on Sales when timelines exceed capacity; own SOWs, exit criteria, and execution accountability for all PS engagements regardless of who delivers
- Position Delivery Engineering as a solution design partner to Presales — Delivery Engineers engage as expert technical partners on integration patterns, common architectures, third-party integrations, and operational realities at scale
- Partner across CS and cross-functionally — the TPM, Technical Account Management, Customer Success Management, Support Operations, and Sales/AEs on engagements, capacity, handoffs, and readiness; represent the pillar in DCS leadership forums
- Drive AI adoption and continuous improvement — apply AI across project tracking, technical execution, and checkpoint review; aggregate improvement opportunities and route to the right builder (Product/Engineering, Program Management, or internal team tooling)

Required Skills & Experience



- 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Delivery, Solutions, or Implementation Engineering) with at least 2 years in a leadership or senior IC role
- Proven experience leading complex technical implementations — managing stakeholders, hitting aggressive go-live dates, navigating ambiguity
- Hands-on technical capability across several of: Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Swift, React; HLS/MPEG-DASH/DRM/ad insertion; REST APIs and webhooks; Docker, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure; observability stacks
- Deep understanding of end-to-end media delivery workflows — content encoding, transport protocols (HLS, DASH, CMAF, RTMP, SRT, WebRTC), DRM, and CDN distribution architectures — with hands-on experience troubleshooting and optimizing across the delivery chain
- Strong project portfolio management discipline — managing variable workload, prioritizing across competing demands, pushing back when warranted
- AI-native mindset — actively use AI to amplify delivery capacity; lead teams to do the same
- Cross-functional leadership — partnering with Sales, TAM, CSM, Support, Product, and Engineering as peers
- Comfort with significant ambiguity — energized by establishing process where it does not yet exist

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in video streaming, AdTech, broadcast, or media SaaS; familiarity with monitoring/observability tooling; experience leading globally distributed delivery teams
- Background managing PS engagements with formal scoping and exit criteria; high-growth SaaS experience where processes were built, not inherited

Overview

At Microsoft AI, our Health team is on a mission to help millions of users better understand and proactively manage their health and wellbeing. We’re responsible for ensuring that Microsoft AI’s models and services are useful, trusted and safe across diverse customer health journeys.

We’re assembling a world-class team of builders with backgrounds in healthcare, big tech, and frontier AI research labs. Our goal is to translate cutting-edge research - like MAI-DxO (microsoft.ai/new/the-path-to-medical-superintelligence) - into transformative products for millions of users across Microsoft’s consumer ecosystem.

We're looking for an exceptional Technical Program Manager to lead health AI research programs end-to-end, turning research goals into measurable outcomes. You'll bring deep technical fluency and partner closely with applied AI scientists, researchers, engineers, product managers, and partners across Responsible AI, Compliance, and Legal, among others, to bring structure, drive alignment, and accelerate execution.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realise our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities



- Partner with research and applied AI science to shape goals, priorities, and success metrics, and own end-to-end execution of complex health AI research programs - managing planning, milestones, dependencies, and risks across the model development lifecycle.
- Drive cross-functional execution across research, engineering, clinical, product, and compliance, acting as the connective tissue between teams - translating requirements, managing trade-offs, and keeping critical paths unblocked.
- Steer model development and launch readiness against clear safety, quality, privacy, and clinical criteria, and own the operational health of training and evaluation runs, including compute and resource planning.
- Bring structure and enablement to fast-moving research - establishing lightweight operating mechanisms and maintaining the artefacts that keep teams aligned.
- Communicate progress, risks, and plans, distilling complex technical information into clear insights for leadership, and advocate for the resourcing and focus the team needs to deliver.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring:



- Several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs.
- Experience delivering AI/ML programs spanning research (pretraining, post-training, and/or evaluation), partnering directly with researchers and applied scientists.
- Technical fluency to reason about model training, evaluation methodology, data, and infrastructure trade-offs, engage credibly with researchers and engineers, and stay current on emerging AI approaches.
- Ability to bring clarity to complex, ambiguous, and changing research challenges, and comfort doing so at pace.
- Strength in translating requirements across research, product, engineering, clinical, and partners such as Compliance, Legal, and Responsible AI, sustaining strong relationships under pressure.
- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence without authority and align stakeholders with different priorities.

Additional Experience That Helps



- Experience in health AI, healthcare technology, or other regulated software environments.

Proactivity.
Attention to details.
Mindset for continuous learning.
Team oriented, enthusiastic, and flexible.
Good interpersonal and communication skills.

What we offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.

An attractive salary and benefits package.

Amentum is a global leader in engineering, project and programme management, and solutions integration. Founded on programme, project, and engineering experience—combined with deep-seated specialist capabilities—Amentum has become a recognised delivery partner across major UK Government and commercial programmes.

Our Defence & Security business supports the UK Ministry of Defence in the delivery of their capabilities and objectives via a host of frameworks, not least the Project Delivery Partner framework, which sees us delivering Project Management, Project Controls, and Operational Delivery support across the land, sea, air, and corporate domains. The work we do is of international importance in ensuring our national security and that of our allies—something our team is proud to support. The framework enables our employees to traverse a range of innovative programmes and projects, which challenge them and ensure they develop their skills to the highest levels. The support structures we have in place ensure our employee welfare and career development are achieved to the highest standards.

People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. In addition to the benefits you would expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and a digital GP service; family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes; plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships. We also give back to our communities through programmes that incorporate matched funding, paid volunteering time, and charitable donations.

About the Opportunity:

We are seeking enthusiastic Project Managers with a strong track record of delivering infrastructure and built environment projects within the defence sector to join our expanding team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting clients across complex, security-sensitive programmes, contributing to the planning, coordination, and execution of critical defence infrastructure initiatives.

You will bring experience operating within highly regulated environments, with a clear understanding of the governance, assurance, and delivery challenges associated with defence estates and secure facilities. Working closely with stakeholders across government and industry, you will help enable the successful delivery of strategically important programmes that underpin national capability and operational readiness.

This role is focused across the North of the country, offering the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of defence infrastructure projects in locations including Manchester, Cumbria, the North East and beyond.

When deployed, you’ll spend the majority of your week on client sites, giving you direct exposure to high-profile programmes and the opportunity to work alongside key stakeholders at the heart of delivery. When project demands allow, you will also benefit from hybrid and remote working flexibility.

Travel across the region is a core part of the role, providing variety and the chance to contribute to a range of impactful and strategically important programmes. Occasional overnight stays may be required.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Understand, and deliver in accordance with, organisational policies, processes, and procedures.

Support the development and assurance of business cases as part of wider approval processes.

Analyse, develop, support, and manage the timely and cost-effective delivery of client projects, meeting business and environmental objectives.

Influence, support, and expedite client project delivery through effective planning, monitoring, controlling, and reporting of project performance.

Identify and effectively manage project assumptions and dependencies.

Support identification of slippage and risk, and implement remedial or mitigating actions, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety, environmental, and management procedures.

Champion the application of appropriate programme and project delivery strategies and commercial vehicles to secure successful business outcomes.

Ensure appropriate services to the project are coordinated and delivered through technical, engineering, project controls, commercial, and financial support functions.

Maintain project records, information, and history accurately and in line with policy.

Ensure learning from experience is captured and apply continuous improvement techniques to project delivery.

Here’s What You’ll Need:

Significant track record of successfully delivering projects in line with time, cost, and quality constraints.

Ability to operate autonomously, with authority, and skilled in developing and maintaining key relationships.

Consultancy focus with a proven history of identifying and delivering client requirements, and the ability to scope wider business opportunities.

Expertise in P3M practices, methodologies, and techniques, and their appropriate application to varied environments.

Highly skilled in the provision of coaching and mentoring.

Ability and willingness to attain security clearance, which includes being resident in the UK for the preceding 5 years.

Desirable Skills and Qualifications:

Educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant subject.

APM PFQ/PMQ qualification.

Strong knowledge of the Defence industry and experience working in a high-profile Tier 1, Prime, and/or subcontractor organisation.

Membership of the Association for Project Management (MAPM) is advantageous.

PRINCE2 or Agile Practitioner qualification.

Managing Successful Programmes (MSP) Practitioner (desirable but not essential).

What’s in It for You:

Competitive salary and benefits package, with unrivalled salary sacrifice schemes available.

Free single medical cover and digital GP service.

Generous pension contributions.

Enhanced parental leave and family-friendly policies.

Professional development support and membership reimbursement.

Access to a flexible benefits programme tailored to your needs, including buying or selling up to 10 days’ extra holiday.

Hybrid and flexible working options to support work–life balance.

Our Culture:

We partner with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain diverse talent. For greater online accessibility, please visit Promoting Equality & Diversity in Jobs and Career - VERCIDA to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

Your application experience is important to us and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. We welcome feedback on our recruitment process and if you need more from us before deciding to join us then please, contact us.

Our People Function works across brands, geographies, and cultures to support one global Maersk. Taking care of their issues, whether big or small, and making sure they get a great employee experience in every interaction with HR.

You have a lot of empathy and drive to take care of every employee’s query.

Great collaboration and communication skills

Solution-oriented, focusing on quality and improvements

Fluency in written and verbal English

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

At Plaid, our mission is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. There has never been a better time than now to start building the future of fintech with us. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo and SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 11,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Washington D.C., London and Amsterdam.

The BizOps team is focused on solving some of Plaid's most pressing business issues. We are a small team of high-impact, low-ego generalist problem solvers. This role partners directly with leaders across Product and GTM on a mix of strategic and operational work with a direct, quantifiable impact on our customers, partners, and P&L. You will work on problems that directly shape how Plaid operates across its largest revenue lines and most critical partnerships - owning analysis, operating cadences, and cross-functional projects that span Product, GTM, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Partnerships. Responsibilities

- Owning foundational operating rhythms - monthly business reports, QBRs, OKRs and KPIs, executive reporting - and evolving them as the business scales
- Building out dashboards, metrics, and success measures that give leadership visibility and enable data-driven decisions
- Using AI tools and agents as a default part of how you work - not as an experiment, but as a force multiplier

- Strong analytical and structured-thinking skills; comfort translating ambiguity into frameworks, plans, and decisions

- Ability to build relationships at all levels and drive cross-functional teams to action
- Familiarity with AI tools and agents to accelerate workflows is a plus
- Knowledge of SQL and Tableau preferred
- Experience in fintech, payments, or high-growth SaaS preferred

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Supply Platform & AI Enablement Team 👋

The Supply Platform & AI Enablement team sits within Trainline’s Core Experience pillar and plays a critical role in shaping how supply is integrated, managed, and scaled across the Trainline platform. As rail liberalisation accelerates across Europe and new operators continue to enter the market, the team is focused on building scalable, resilient, and future-ready platform capabilities that enable Trainline to onboard and manage supply efficiently across rail and coach markets.

As the Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for evolving the architecture, tooling, and operational capabilities that power Trainline’s supply ecosystem. This is a highly strategic leadership role focused on platform modernisation, organisational scalability, and the adoption of AI-enabled and agentic workflows to improve engineering efficiency and operational effectiveness. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Commercial, and Supply stakeholders, you will help shape the long-term technical vision for the domain while fostering high-performing, collaborative teams that can confidently navigate complexity, growth, and change.



In this role as the Senior Engineering Manager, Supply Platform & AI Enablement, you will...🚄

 - Lead multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers, supporting growth and development through coaching, feedback, and inclusive leadership practices

 - Define and drive the long-term technical vision for how supply is integrated, managed, and scaled across the Trainline platform

 - Own end-to-end delivery across the Supply Platform domain, ensuring initiatives deliver measurable operational and business impact

 - Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Commercial, and Supply stakeholders to align technical strategy with evolving customer, platform, and business needs

 - Drive the adoption of AI-enabled and agentic workflows across engineering and operational processes, identifying practical opportunities to improve scalability, automation, and efficiency

 - Lead large-scale platform modernisation and architectural transformation initiatives, balancing long-term strategic investment with pragmatic delivery priorities

 - Provide technical leadership across platform architecture, APIs, system interactions, and operational workflows, helping teams make effective and sustainable technical decisions

 - Champion engineering excellence by promoting resilient, observable, and scalable systems, while fostering a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and operational improvement

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Significant experience leading multiple engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives within platform, distributed systems, or large-scale technology environments

 - A strong track record of building inclusive, high-performing engineering organisations and developing future engineering leaders through coaching and mentorship

 - Experience leading platform modernisation, architectural transformation, or large-scale technical change programmes within operationally complex environments

 - The ability to balance long-term technical strategy with pragmatic delivery, operational excellence, and evolving business priorities

 - Experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent workflow capabilities within engineering or operational domains, with an interest in how emerging technologies can improve scalability and efficiency

 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Data Science, Commercial, and Operational teams

 - Confidence navigating ambiguity and complexity, bringing clarity, alignment, and momentum across teams and initiatives

 - Experience working with APIs, distributed systems, platform architectures, or integration-heavy environments, and ideally exposure to platform engineering, workflow orchestration, or operational automation capabilities



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

About the Role

This role provides the opportunity to lead significant components of a high-profile global transformation of investor onboarding, shaping future processes, controls, data, technology and operating models across regions and platforms.

The Specialist will apply deep transformation and business expertise to lead complex workstreams, solve challenging problems and translate strategy into delivery. The role will work across operations, technology, product, risk and control partners to improve service delivery, strengthen controls and support implementation of the global target operating model.

Why Apply

The role offers direct exposure to senior forums, cross-regional delivery and strategic decision-making, with accountability for complex transformation outcomes and the opportunity to influence priorities, implementation approaches and adoption.

It provides the chance to make a visible contribution to better client outcomes, stronger controls and more consistent ways of working across a core global capability. This is an opportunity to lead meaningful components of a global transformation, influence strategic decisions and support delivery of a more consistent, controlled and scalable investor onboarding model.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced transformation professional with strong judgement, analytical capability and the confidence to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders. They will take ownership, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively and convert complex issues into practical recommendations and executable plans. They will build strategic relationships, influence decisions and provide work leadership without formal supervisory responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Workstream Leadership

Lead multiple complex transformation processes, programmes or workstreams aligned to global investor onboarding priorities and business objectives.

Shape implementation approaches and translate transformation strategy into clear plans, decisions, milestones and measurable outcomes.

Lead significant components of target operating model design and implementation, including process, control, data, technology and organisational change considerations.

Coordinate activities, dependencies, risks and resources across stakeholders to deliver agreed outcomes on time and within scope.

Apply knowledge of business drivers and departmental priorities to recommend improvements to performance, service delivery, operational effectiveness and transformation progress.

Analysis, Problem Solving & Solution Delivery

Assess complex or less-defined issues, evaluate multiple business, operational, data, control and regulatory considerations, and identify innovative, practical solutions.

Lead and support current-state assessment, gap analysis, solution evaluation and future-state definition across investor onboarding, transfer agency and AML/KYC processes.

Use data and evidence to test assumptions, identify root causes and support informed decision-making.

Exercise discretion within functional policies to adapt approaches, improve processes and resolve escalated transformation issues.

Support implementation readiness, testing, change execution, adoption and post-implementation review.

Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Communication

Build strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff and cross-functional partners across operations, technology, product, risk and compliance.

Facilitate senior workshops and working sessions to align priorities, resolve issues, support decisions and maintain delivery momentum.

Communicate findings, recommendations, risks, dependencies and progress clearly through governance materials, presentations and executive updates.

Influence stakeholders and senior functional partners to secure alignment and support execution across regional and global teams.

Contribute to functional planning and budget-related activities by providing input aligned to transformation priorities and strategy.

Subject Matter Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Provide subject matter guidance, direction and work leadership to colleagues on complex transformation activities.

Improve transformation standards, governance, controls, templates and ways of working across the portfolio.

Promote effective knowledge transfer, consistent execution and sustainable adoption of improved processes, tools and operating models.

Perform all duties in accordance with established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

Specialised depth and breadth of experience in transformation, change delivery, investor onboarding, transfer agency, AML/KYC, funds or financial services operations.

Proven ability to lead complex functional projects or workstreams with moderate risk, resource requirements and cross-functional dependencies.

Advanced analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to develop practical solutions in less-defined situations.

Strong understanding of business drivers, operating models, controls, service delivery and regulatory considerations.

Confident stakeholder leadership, including the ability to influence peers and senior staff, facilitate workshops and communicate complex matters clearly.

Sound judgement and decision-making skills when balancing policy, business needs, risk and delivery priorities.

Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with experience producing executive and governance materials.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential. Experience with Visio, Power BI, SharePoint, Aha!, Azure DevOps, Jira or Confluence is beneficial.

Bachelor’s or university degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience. Relevant change, project, process improvement or Agile certification is beneficial.

Work Authorization

Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

About us

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.

About ExxonMobil Global Trading

ExxonMobil Global Trading is where we trade oil, natural gas, and energy products safely and responsibly around the world. We leverage our expertise in analytics, logistics, origination, and knowledge of energy markets to maximize the value of our global assets and deliver industry-leading results. This is an exciting time to join our growing trading team and be an integral part of ExxonMobil.

What role you will play in our team

If successful you will be an integral part of our Global Trading team, supporting our commodity traders throughout a deal life-cycle from conception to realization.

London, England, United Kingdom at the London Trading Office (LTO)

What you will do

Job Duties include the following:

Member of cross-discipline team with strong business knowledge and systems understanding, partnering with the Gas & Power Trading business & IT to effectively utilize systems & data to deliver value.
Focal point for queries for European flowing gas and power trading business users related to Allegro ETRM.
SME or Advisor in system projects and enhancement initiatives, across Europe and Americas regions.
Recognized as an expert in business process knowledge, process/controls requirements, systems usage.
Focal point for master data maintenance in Allegro ETRM and related systems.
Aware of upcoming business, process and system changes and identifies implementation needs.
Proactively looks for ways to increase effectiveness and efficiency in our systems (eliminate, simplify, automate, standardize).
Testing of new system functionality as part of regular system upgrades and for new functionality releases.
Mentors and coaches others, including preparing and delivering training to the broader Trading team and IT.

About you

To be eligible for this role, you must possess the following:

A good degree in a STEM subject from a recognized university.
A strong functional and technical resource with extensive years of experience in Allegro implementation and support for gas and/or power trading.

Preferred Qualifications/ Experience

In-depth knowledge of trade lifecycle including Deal Entry, Positions Reporting, Exposures, Mark to Market, P&L, Accounting, Logistics, Settlement, Valuation & Operations.
Strong issue diagnosis and resolution skills, with proactive attitude to take ownership of tasks.

Your Benefits

An ExxonMobil career is one designated to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life.

We offer you:

Competitive salary
Defined Benefit Pension scheme.
Private healthcare for employees and their families

Please note benefits may be changed from time to time without notice, subject to applicable law.

Stay connected with us

Learn more at our website
Subscribe our channel at YouTube
Follow us on Twitter at @ExxonMobil_UK

Nothing herein is intended to override the corporate separateness of local entities. Working relationships discussed herein do not necessarily represent a reporting connection, but may reflect a functional guidance, stewardship, or service relationship.

Exxon Mobil Corporation has numerous affiliates, many with names that include ExxonMobil, Exxon, Esso and Mobil. For convenience and simplicity, those terms and terms like corporation, company, our, we and its are sometimes used as abbreviated references to specific affiliates or affiliate groups. Abbreviated references describing global or regional operational organizations and global or regional business lines are also sometimes used for convenience and simplicity. Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our Protection & Analytics product team have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Product Owner (APO) to join Primark Technology’s transformation journey. In this role, you will own a mature product or a portfolio of smaller products that either protect our customers, colleagues, business or drive insights into our customer base and behaviours to drive real business value at the forefront of innovation in Retail. This role is working alongside senior Product Owners and Product Managers to translate strategy into clear roadmaps and prioritised backlogs. You will ensure delivery teams build the right solutions at the right time to deliver measurable value, this will be through innovative proof of concepts, projects to rollout new capabilities or on-going development in existing products. This opportunity is ideal for Project Managers, Business Analysts, or Delivery Leads looking to expand their responsibilities across the full product lifecycle and progress towards end-to-end product ownership.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as Associate Product Owner 

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:



- Understand business challenges and translate them into test-and-learn opportunities through proof of concepts.
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and design through development, optimisation and operational support, leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver desired outcomes.
- Define, maintain and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs and strategic priorities.
- Create and manage user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria to enable clear and effective delivery.
- Use customer, colleague, market and data insights to prioritise features and enhancements based on value, business impact and cost efficiency.
- Lead sprint and release planning, manage cross-team dependencies, drive continuous delivery and product improvements, communicate progress, risks and opportunities to stakeholders, support product adoption and ensure compliance with governance frameworks.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:



- Experience in technology delivery, product management, delivery management, or business analysis.
- Understanding of backlog and roadmap management with experience working in multidisciplinary delivery teams.
- Experience writing user stories and business requirements to support successful product delivery.
- Knowledge of Agile frameworks such as Scrum or SAFe and an understanding of product management practices.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance cost, value, and customer experience while identifying business opportunities from emerging technologies.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to influence business partners, suppliers, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders across global delivery teams.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Chief of Staff, EMEA Sales

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

Sales is looking for a Chief of Staff, EMEA Sales to serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier for the SVP of Sales, driving the rhythm of the business, translating strategy into execution, and ensuring the sales organization runs with discipline and focus.

Operating as an extension of the SVP across Mimecast’s EMEA cybersecurity business, you’ll combine operating-cadence ownership, high-priority project leadership, and direct contribution to go-to-market strategy. This is a high-visibility role with direct access to the SVP, regular exposure to the executive leadership team, and significant influence over how the division sells, grows, and scales.

What You'll Do

Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the SVP on strategic decisions, organizational design, resourcing, and priority trade-offs.
Prepare the SVP for board meetings, executive leadership reviews, QBRs, and all-hands by synthesizing data, framing decisions, anticipating questions, and drafting clear executive communications.
Represent the SVP in meetings when needed, triage priorities, and protect their time without creating bottlenecks.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Finance, HR, and Revenue Operations leaders to shape and execute EMEA go-to-market strategy, including segmentation, territory design, coverage models, capacity planning, quota setting, and pricing and packaging input.
Help launch and operationalize new go-to-market motions, including channel and partner initiatives, new products, and vertical strategies, from concept through field enablement.
Identify, prioritize, and lead a portfolio of strategic cross-functional initiatives, defining scope, milestones, success metrics, and accountability from strategy through execution.
Diagnose performance gaps across pipeline, conversion, attainment, and churn, translating root-cause analysis into concrete action plans with the sales leadership team.
Own the EMEA sales operating rhythm in support of the Global Sales organization, including forecast calls, pipeline oversight, large-deal reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly QBRs.
Partner with Sales Operations and Revenue Operations to maintain dashboards and executive reporting on pipeline health, bookings, quota attainment, productivity, budget, and headcount, flagging risks early.
Support the EMEA sales leadership team by aligning priorities, removing cross-team friction, leading change adoption, and helping execute culture, recognition, organizational planning, promotion, and talent-review initiatives.

What You'll Bring

Extensive experience operating at a strategic level across strategy consulting, investment banking, sales or revenue operations, go-to-market strategy, Chief of Staff, or business operations roles, with the autonomy to advise senior executives and lead complex initiatives.
A demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional programs from strategy through execution and delivering measurable business impact.
Strong understanding of sales methodology, pipeline and forecast management, and revenue operations concepts and tools, such as Salesforce, Gong, MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, ARR and NRR, and pipeline coverage ratios.
Meaningful experience using AI tools to create business value and an interest in helping build an AI-enabled sales intelligence and operating motion; experience with Claude would be advantageous.
Executive presence and exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the credibility to present to a board and coach a frontline seller.
Sharp analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to build and interrogate models, dashboards, and board-level narratives.
High emotional intelligence and political awareness, with the ability to build trust and influence across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, HR, and Customer Success without formal authority.
A bias for action, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to move fluidly between high-level strategy and detailed execution in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information, including organizational changes, performance issues, and M&A-adjacent topics.
Experience supporting a senior sales or revenue executive at SVP or CRO level is strongly preferred; experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity is a significant advantage.
The ability to commute to Mimecast’s London headquarters; being based within commuting distance would be beneficial.

The base salary range for this position is £124,000 - £186,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

What will you be doing?



- Own the operating model for the full product organisation: planning cadences, roadmap governance, OKR cycles, and the rituals that keep a distributed, senior team aligned without drowning them in process
- Define how Primer measures product performance across the portfolio — build the instrumentation, the dashboards, and the feedback loops that give leadership clarity on what is shipping, what is slipping, and what it means for the business
- Set the strategy and direction for product tooling: what the team uses, how it integrates, and how it evolves as the company scales from Series C to a much larger organisation
- Lead go-to-market readiness across the product function — coordinating across Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Marketing to ensure launches land with the right preparation and the right people informed
- Identify and resolve systemic friction across the product org, not one-off fixes but durable structural changes that remove the same class of problem from recurring
- Build the knowledge infrastructure for the product function: documentation standards, onboarding, decision records, and shared frameworks that mean institutional knowledge survives people leaving and scales with hiring
- Act as a strategic partner to Theo, owning the operational detail and the cross-functional coordination that lets him stay focused on product direction

What we're looking for



- Substantial experience in a senior Product Operations, Chief of Staff, or equivalent role inside a B2B technology company — you have built or significantly rebuilt a product operating model before
- Genuine analytical capability: you can work directly with data, build dashboards, and turn numbers into clear narratives without depending on a data team to do it for you
- Track record of creating systems and processes that people actually adopt and maintain over time — you know the difference between documentation and infrastructure
- Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, and GTM without a clear lane — you influence through the quality of your thinking and the usefulness of what you build
- Multi-quarter strategic thinking: you can hold the big picture of how the product function should operate in eighteen months while executing in the present
- Highly autonomous in ambiguous environments — you do not need the problem to be fully defined before you start making progress on it
- Nice to have: experience in payments, fintech, or developer-facing infrastructure products

✅ A typical interview process



- An initial intro call with a Talent Partner
- An interview with the Hiring Manager
- Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role
- A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?

We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one

💰 Competitive share options

🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken

🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities

📅 Workations & Company Retreat

💻 The best equipment for your role

🏠 £500 towards your home office setup

🔎 Generous learning budget

🏥 Private Medical Insurance

📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

Wahl Empowers People To Be Their Best!

Drive Global Transformation at Wahl Clipper

At Wahl Clipper, innovation doesn't stop at our products, it powers the way we work across the globe. As a trusted leader in grooming and personal care for over 100 years, we're investing in digital transformation that enhances efficiency, strengthens our global operations, and creates exceptional experiences for our teams and customers. We're looking for a Global Digital Program Manager who thrives on turning strategy into action. In this role, you'll lead large-scale, cross-functional digital initiatives that impact teams around the world. If you excel at bringing people together, managing complexity, and delivering results that drive business value, we'd love to meet you.

This role can be based in either the US or Europe.

What You'll Do

-  Leads all aspects of the program and/or project lifecycle - planning, scope definition, budgeting, staffing, design, execution, and delivery - coordinating work activities across multiple project managers and functions to meet evolving business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:



-  PMP Certification 

Why You'll Love Wahl Clipper

But that's just the beginning. At Wahl, you'll also enjoy:



-  A legacy of quality and innovation. 
-  A team that values your expertise and ideas. 
-  Opportunities to grow and contribute to meaningful projects. 
-  A culture built on respect, precision, and progress. 

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're passionate about leading strategic initiatives, connecting people and technology, and delivering results that matter, apply today and help shape the future of Wahl Clipper's global digital journey.

Job Description

Role: Product Operations Manager

Location: Holborn, London

Reports to: Product Operations Director

The opportunity

We're MiQ, a programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. We're experts in data science, analytics and programmatic trading, and we're always ready to react and solve challenges quickly so our clients are always spending their media investments on the right things in the right places.

Our business keeps growing because we keep hiring smart people who challenge conventions, connect teams and make great things happen.

This role sits within Global Product Operations and is designed to help bring together the product organisation as a cohesive unit, making it easier for teams to execute strategy efficiently and improving the experience of doing product work at MiQ.

We're looking for a Product Operations Manager who will work alongside the Product Operations Director as a broad Product Ops generalist - someone who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves on day-to-day operational improvement and stepping up to independently lead key cross-functional initiatives. You'll help improve the health of how the organisation works, create momentum around important initiatives and make sure execution stays current across the board.

You'll focus on supporting core processes, operating rhythms, tooling, communication and day-to-day operational effectiveness across Global Product and its adjacent teams, while also taking clear ownership of a key initiative or two at any given time.

This is a role for someone who is practical, hands-on and highly collaborative, with the confidence to drive meaningful projects independently and bring structure to complex cross-functional work.

What This Role Is Here To Do

Product Operations at MiQ focuses on people, process and systems, helping the product organisation operate effectively and consistently as it scales.

This role is therefore best suited to someone who enjoys:



- Taking ownership of key operational improvement projects and driving them through to completion
- Spotting where ways of working are unclear, inconsistent or out of date, and helping keep them effective and current
- Bringing structure, visibility and momentum to cross-functional work involving multiple teams and stakeholders
- Working closely with Product Managers and adjacent teams to understand friction, identify improvement opportunities and translate those into action
- Balancing immediate execution support with broader operational improvement across the Product organisation

Job Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

Process health and continuous improvement



- Support established Product processes and help keep them current, effective and easy for teams to follow
- Take ownership of reviewing and continuously improving key Product processes where needed, ensuring they remain clear, lightweight and useful in practice
- Identify where workflows, handoffs or responsibilities are unclear and help teams close those gaps
- Keep operational processes up to date as team needs, tools and priorities evolve
- Help teams adopt and maintain shared and repeatable ways of working

Rituals, planning and operating cadence



- Review and improve the health of Product rituals and operating cadences
- Help maintain the calendars, checkpoints and recurring workflows that keep Product and Tech operating effectively
- Ensure key operational processes happen consistently, with the right visibility, follow-through and accountability
- Support teams in making execution status, decisions, dependencies and next steps easier to understand

Tooling, systems and operational enablement



- Own and improve the day-to-day operational setup of Product tools and systems
- Identify friction in current tooling or ways of working and work with relevant partners to improve usage, structure, adoption and effectiveness
- Help ensure teams have the right operational support, information and structure to execute effectively
- Contribute to lightweight governance around templates, workflows and operational setup across key tools
- Support practical improvements that make cross-functional work easier to coordinate and maintain

Cross-team coordination



- Stay close to Product Managers and other adjacent teams to understand day-to-day friction, emerging problems and opportunities for improvement
- Help connect the dots across teams so that process changes, priorities and expectations are understood consistently
- Facilitate working sessions and discussions needed to move cross-functional initiatives forward
- Support stronger alignment across Product, Tech and adjacent functions

Project delivery and leadership



- Lead 1–2 key Product Ops projects at any given time, with responsibility for shaping plans, aligning stakeholders and driving progress
- Support the planning and delivery of broader Product Ops projects, helping keep work structured, coordinated and moving forward
- Proactively identify blockers, risks or dependencies and work through them with the right people
- Ensure projects land well operationally, not just on paper
- 

Documentation and enablement



- Maintain high-quality documentation where it is needed to support execution, visibility and consistency
- Create or refine templates, guides and playbooks that help teams adopt good practice
- Ensure operational information, knowledge bases and playbooks are easy to find, easy to understand and kept appropriately up to date
- Support regular operational communications and the rollout of updated ways of working 

Required Experience



- 4+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Project Management or a similar operations-focused role
- Strong track record of driving and leading cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders to success
- Experience independently scoping or improving processes and operational practices, preferably for Product Management teams
- Comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives while keeping quality high
- Background in programmatic, ad tech or a similarly complex product environment is desirable

Required Skills



- Clear and engaging communicator who can align stakeholders and keep operational updates easy to understand
- Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple workstreams, routines and follow-ups moving
- Structured problem-solver with good judgement and attention to detail
- Able to turn broad goals or ambiguous issues into clear plans and practical next steps
- Able to keep documentation, playbooks and operational information clear, current and easy to use
- Reliable in managing recurring operational tasks, cadences and communications with strong follow-through

Benefits



- 6 months fully paid parental leave for all new mothers, fathers and adoptive parents
- Private health cover for you and your family
- Free lunch provided in the office, in addition to complimentary snacks, fruits and drinks
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- 2 extra paid days of Inclusion Leave per year to acknowledge and celebrate cultural holidays, community endeavours and inclusive initiatives that are meaningful to our employees beyond the standard holidays
- The chance to apply for internal roles domestically after 12 months service, and international roles after 18 months of service
- Company contributions toward eye tests and/or optician approved eyewear
- 4% pension contribution
- Lump sum life insurance paid to the person of your choice
- Referral bonus scheme
- Discounted gym memberships
- Annual season ticket loan
- CycleScheme & TechScheme
- Early finishes on Fridays
- 

What We Value In Our People



- Passion – We love and live what we do
- Determination – We always find a way to figure it out
- Unity – We hold each other accountable. We win and lose as a team
- Agility – We anticipate the unexpected, embrace and adapt to change
- Courage – We dare to think unconventionally

At MiQ, we don’t just accept the differences of our people; it is what builds us as a community. MiQ is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and we are focused on diversity and inclusion so that all employees feel a sense of belonging and can thrive throughout their careers at MiQ.

Police Digital Service (PDS) is recruiting on behalf of the NPCC National Data & Analytics Office - a dedicated national capability transforming data use in policing.

NDAO - Records Manager. Permanent, Full time. Salary £50,000 per annum.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a ground-breaking function within policing which will shape the future of data and analytics in UK law enforcement and help to utilise policing data to better protect the public. The NDAO will ensure:

Responsible data use across law enforcement
Improved data governance and standardised datasets
Enhanced data analytics services to support operational decision-making
Professionalisation of data roles within policing
A more integrated data-sharing ecosystem across forces

For the first time, UK policing will have a recognised, accredited approach to data and analytics, helping forces to work smarter and more effectively without compromising security or integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain national policies, standards, and procedures for records management across UK policing, ensuring alignment with MoPI, APP Information Management, DPA/GDPR, and NPDAB strategic direction, deputising for the Senior Record Manager as applicable.
Support forces to adopt consistent lifecycle management practices by providing guidance, frameworks, self-assessment tools, and targeted improvement support.
Provide national leadership on the creation, classification, retention, archiving, review, and disposal of police records, ensuring that processes reduce risk, support operational effectiveness, and align with statutory requirements.
Work closely with PDS, Home Office programmes, and NDAO specialists to ensure records management requirements are embedded in national systems, data models, and digital capabilities. Chairs subgroups of the Records Managers Practitioners Group (RMPG) ensuring delivery of these groups. Acts as deputy chair of the RMPG.
Provide expertise with national audit, assurance, and compliance activities relating to record management, identifying risks, gaps, and force level issues requiring escalation or targeted support.
Ensure records management practices support efficient and accurate responses to SARs, FOI requests, legal disclosure, public inquiries, and other statutory obligations.
Promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and integrity across all records, ensuring compliance with information assurance, security classification, and retention requirements.
Deliver a guidance, learning materials, and awareness programmes to improve recordkeeping capability and culture across forces and national bodies.
Engage with forces, NPCC portfolios, NPDAB groups, PDS, Home Office, and external partners to ensure national alignment and collective ownership of records management needs.
Work collaboratively with technology and data teams to embed records management principles into new digital systems, ensuring metadata, accessibility, and retention needs are met.

What you need to succeed in the role

Qualifications: A relevant degree in data management, computer science, or a related field is preferred. Professional certifications in records management Professional certifications in records management (e.g. professional qualification from and/or membership of a relevant professional body or association (e.g. ASLIB, Records Management Society, CILIP), project management (e.g., PRINCE2, Agile), or relevant data-related qualifications are advantageous.
Data Strategy and Transformation: Comprehensive understanding of data-related transformation programs at a national level, including complex dependencies and external relationships. Ability to develop strategies that drive significant change in data capabilities.
Legal Compliance: In-depth knowledge of relevant data-related legislation and legal compliance frameworks, e.g., Freedom of Information (FOI Act 2000), Management of Police Information (MoPI), Investigatory Powers Act 2016 etc, ensuring adherence to data protection and privacy laws, ensuring adherence to data protection and privacy laws.
Data Architecture and Security: Familiarity with data architecture, data assurance, ethics, and security frameworks that govern record management practices including a demonstrable understanding of digital records systems, metadata standards, digital preservation, and information assurance principles.
Data Performance Metrics: Ability to define, track, and interpret metrics that demonstrate progress, improvements, and the value derived from investments in data infrastructure.
Ethics and Proportionality: Understanding of ethical considerations regarding the use of data, advanced analytics, and data science within the policing and national security contexts.

cf2b846a7e7fecf3.description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 5 to 15 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

Requirements:

7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
Work experience at a recognizable company.
Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

Brand:
TripleTen

What you will do:

Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

What we can offer you:

Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!
